import { useState } from 'react'
import { useRestaurant } from '../context/RestaurantContext'
import type { Bill, PaymentRecord, Session, Table } from '../context/RestaurantContext'
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext'
import {
  ChevronLeft,
  ChevronRight,
  Eye,
  Receipt,
  Download,
  CheckCircle2,
  ArrowUpDown,
  CalendarDays,
} from 'lucide-react'
import PrintPreview from './PrintPreview'
import { createPrintPreviewJob } from '../services/print/printService'
import type { PrintJob } from '../services/print/printService'
import type { BillPrintPayload } from '../services/print/printFormatters'
import { toBusinessDayStr, isSameBusinessDay } from '../lib/businessDay'
import { servingSuffix } from '../lib/servingType'
import { downloadHistoricalBillPdf } from '../services/pdf/billPdfService'

type SortKey = 'newest' | 'oldest' | 'amountHigh' | 'amountLow' | 'billNo'

const SORT_OPTIONS: { id: SortKey; label: string }[] = [
  { id: 'newest', label: 'Newest First' },
  { id: 'oldest', label: 'Oldest First' },
  { id: 'amountHigh', label: 'Amount: High → Low' },
  { id: 'amountLow', label: 'Amount: Low → High' },
  { id: 'billNo', label: 'Bill Number' },
]

const toDateStr = (d: Date) => toBusinessDayStr(d.getTime())

const sameDay = (ts: number, dateStr: string) =>
  isSameBusinessDay(ts, dateStr)

/**
 * Label-only tax rate derived from the STORED bill amounts.
 * No bill amount is recalculated.
 */
const rateFromStored = (amount: number, base: number) =>
  base > 0 ? Number(((amount / base) * 100).toFixed(2)) : 0

/**
 * Build the 58mm reprint payload for a HISTORICAL bill.
 *
 * All money-related values come directly from the stored bill.
 * Current menu prices are never used.
 */
const buildHistoricalBillPayload = (
  bill: Bill,
  historical: {
    table?: Table
    session?: Session
    waiterName?: string
  },
  payment: PaymentRecord | undefined,
  header: {
    restaurantName: string
    address: string
    gstin: string
    fssaiLicenseNumber: string
  },
): BillPrintPayload => ({
  billNumber: bill.billNumber,

  date: new Date(bill.generatedAt).toLocaleDateString(),

  time: new Date(bill.generatedAt).toLocaleTimeString(),

  table: historical.table?.name ?? bill.tableId,

  waiter: historical.waiterName ?? '',

  lines: bill.lines.map((line) => ({
    name: line.nameSnapshot + servingSuffix(line.servingType),
    quantity: line.quantity,
    amount: line.priceSnapshot,
  })),

  subtotal: bill.subtotal,

  cgstRate: rateFromStored(bill.cgst, bill.subtotal),
  cgst: bill.cgst,

  sgstRate: rateFromStored(bill.sgst, bill.subtotal),
  sgst: bill.sgst,

  discount: bill.discount,

  serviceCharge: bill.serviceCharge,

  parcelCharge: bill.parcelCharge,

  grandTotal: bill.grandTotal,

  guests: historical.session?.guestCount,

  paymentStatus: payment ? 'PAID' : 'PENDING',

  paymentMode: payment?.paymentMode,

  restaurantName: header.restaurantName,

  address: header.address,

  gstin: header.gstin,

  fssaiLicenseNumber: header.fssaiLicenseNumber,
})

export default function AdminBillingView() {
  const {
    bills,
    tables,
    sessions,
    paymentRecords,
    settings,
  } = useRestaurant()

  const { users, user } = useAuth()

  const [selectedDate, setSelectedDate] = useState(
    toDateStr(new Date()),
  )

  const [sortKey, setSortKey] =
    useState<SortKey>('newest')

  const [showAllTime, setShowAllTime] =
    useState(false)

  const [expandedBill, setExpandedBill] =
    useState<string | null>(null)

  const [previewJobId, setPreviewJobId] =
    useState<string | null>(null)

  const [previewJob, setPreviewJob] =
    useState<PrintJob | null>(null)

  const [downloadingBillId, setDownloadingBillId] =
    useState<string | null>(null)

  const [downloadedBillId, setDownloadedBillId] =
  useState<string | null>(null)

  // Reprint is an ADMIN-only capability.
  const isAdmin = user?.role === 'admin'

  /**
   * Resolve the historical context of one billing-history record.
   */
  const historicalContextOf = (bill: Bill) => {
    const session = sessions.find(
      (s) => s.id === bill.sessionId,
    )

    return {
      table: tables.find(
        (t) => t.id === bill.tableId,
      ),

      session,

      waiterName: session?.waiterId
        ? users.find(
            (u) => u.id === session.waiterId,
          )?.name ?? ''
        : '',

      payment: paymentRecords.find(
        (p) => p.billId === bill.id,
      ),
    }
  }

  /**
   * Reprint the exact historical bill to the
   * ADMIN customer-bill printer.
   */
  const printReceipt = (bill: Bill) => {
    const ctx = historicalContextOf(bill)

    const payload = buildHistoricalBillPayload(
      bill,
      ctx,
      ctx.payment,
      {
        restaurantName:
          settings.restaurantName,

        address:
          settings.address,

        gstin:
          settings.gstin,

        fssaiLicenseNumber:
          settings.fssaiLicenseNumber,
      },
    )

    const job = createPrintPreviewJob(
      'bill',
      'counter_bill',
      payload,
      bill.id,
    )

    setPreviewJob(job)
    setPreviewJobId(job.id)
  }

  /**
   * Download historical bill as PDF.
   *
   * Nothing is recalculated from current menu data.
   */
  const downloadBill = async (bill: Bill) => {
  if (downloadingBillId) {
    return
  }

  setDownloadedBillId(null)
  setDownloadingBillId(bill.id)

  try {
    const ctx = historicalContextOf(bill)

    await downloadHistoricalBillPdf(
      bill,
      ctx,
      ctx.payment,
      {
        restaurantName:
          settings.restaurantName,

        address:
          settings.address,

        gstin:
          settings.gstin,

        fssaiLicenseNumber:
          settings.fssaiLicenseNumber,
      },
    )

    // PDF generation/download completed successfully.
    setDownloadedBillId(bill.id)

    // Return the button to the normal download icon
    // after a short success indication.
    window.setTimeout(() => {
      setDownloadedBillId((current) =>
        current === bill.id ? null : current,
      )
    }, 2000)
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      'Failed to download bill PDF:',
      error,
    )

    window.alert(
      'Unable to generate the bill PDF. Please try again.',
    )
  } finally {
    setDownloadingBillId(null)
  }
}

  const dateFiltered = showAllTime
    ? bills
    : bills.filter((b) =>
        sameDay(
          b.generatedAt,
          selectedDate,
        ),
      )

  const filteredBills = [...dateFiltered].sort(
    (a, b) => {
      switch (sortKey) {
        case 'oldest':
          return (
            a.generatedAt -
            b.generatedAt
          )

        case 'amountHigh':
          return (
            b.grandTotal -
            a.grandTotal
          )

        case 'amountLow':
          return (
            a.grandTotal -
            b.grandTotal
          )

        case 'billNo':
          return a.billNumber.localeCompare(
            b.billNumber,
          )

        default:
          return (
            b.generatedAt -
            a.generatedAt
          )
      }
    },
  )

  const prevDay = () => {
    const d = new Date(selectedDate)

    d.setDate(
      d.getDate() - 1,
    )

    setSelectedDate(
      toDateStr(d),
    )
  }

  const nextDay = () => {
    const d = new Date(selectedDate)

    d.setDate(
      d.getDate() + 1,
    )

    setSelectedDate(
      toDateStr(d),
    )
  }

  const goToday = () =>
    setSelectedDate(
      toDateStr(new Date()),
    )

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">

      {/* HEADER */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">

        <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-900">
          Billing History
        </h2>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">

          <button
            onClick={prevDay}
            className="rounded-lg border border-slate-200 p-2 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50"
            title="Previous Day"
            aria-label="Previous Day"
          >
            <ChevronLeft size={16} />
          </button>

          <input
            type="date"
            value={selectedDate}
            onChange={(e) =>
              setSelectedDate(
                e.target.value,
              )
            }
            className="rounded-lg border border-slate-200 px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-orange-400"
          />

          <button
            onClick={nextDay}
            className="rounded-lg border border-slate-200 p-2 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50"
            title="Next Day"
            aria-label="Next Day"
          >
            <ChevronRight size={16} />
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={goToday}
            className="rounded-lg bg-orange-100 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-orange-700 hover:bg-orange-200"
          >
            Today
          </button>

        </div>
      </div>

      {/* FILTERS */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">

        <p className="text-sm text-slate-500">
          {showAllTime
            ? 'All Time'
            : selectedDate}{' '}
          · {filteredBills.length} bill(s)
        </p>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">

          <button
            onClick={() =>
              setShowAllTime(
                (v) => !v,
              )
            }
            className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border px-3 py-2 text-xs font-bold ${
              showAllTime
                ? 'border-orange-300 bg-orange-100 text-orange-700'
                : 'border-slate-200 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50'
            }`}
          >
            <CalendarDays size={14} />
            All Time
          </button>

          <div className="relative flex items-center">

            <ArrowUpDown
              size={14}
              className="pointer-events-none absolute left-2.5 text-slate-400"
            />

            <select
              value={sortKey}
              onChange={(e) =>
                setSortKey(
                  e.target.value as SortKey,
                )
              }
              className="appearance-none rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white py-2 pl-8 pr-7 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 outline-none focus:border-orange-400"
            >
              {SORT_OPTIONS.map(
                (o) => (
                  <option
                    key={o.id}
                    value={o.id}
                  >
                    {o.label}
                  </option>
                ),
              )}
            </select>

          </div>

        </div>
      </div>

      {/* BILL LIST */}
      {filteredBills.length === 0 ? (

        <div className="rounded-[20px] border border-dashed border-slate-300 bg-white p-8 text-center">

          <p className="text-slate-500">
            No bills generated on this date.
          </p>

        </div>

      ) : (

        <div className="space-y-3">

          {filteredBills.map(
            (bill) => {

              const table =
                tables.find(
                  (t) =>
                    t.id ===
                    bill.tableId,
                )

              const session =
                sessions.find(
                  (s) =>
                    s.id ===
                    bill.sessionId,
                )

              const isExpanded =
                expandedBill ===
                bill.id

              const isDownloading =
                downloadingBillId ===
                bill.id

              return (
                <div
                  key={bill.id}
                  className="rounded-[20px] border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4"
                >

                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">

                    {/* BILL INFORMATION */}
                    <div className="min-w-0">

                      <p className="font-bold text-slate-900">
                        {bill.billNumber}
                      </p>

                      <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                        {table?.name ??
                          'Unknown'}{' '}
                        ·{' '}
                        {session?.guestCount ??
                          0}{' '}
                        guests ·{' '}
                        {new Date(
                          bill.generatedAt,
                        ).toLocaleTimeString()}
                      </p>

                    </div>

                    {/* ACTIONS */}
                    <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-3">

                      <span className="text-lg font-black text-slate-900">
                        ₹
                        {bill.grandTotal.toFixed(
                          2,
                        )}
                      </span>

                      {/* 1. VIEW */}
                      <button
                        onClick={() =>
                          setExpandedBill(
                            isExpanded
                              ? null
                              : bill.id,
                          )
                        }
                        title="View Bill"
                        aria-label="View Bill"
                        className="rounded-lg bg-slate-100 p-2 text-slate-600 hover:bg-orange-100 hover:text-orange-600"
                      >
                        <Eye size={14} />
                      </button>

                      {/* 2. DOWNLOAD PDF */}
                      {isAdmin && (
  <button
    onClick={() =>
      void downloadBill(bill)
    }
    disabled={
      isDownloading ||
      downloadedBillId === bill.id
    }
    title={
      isDownloading
        ? 'Generating PDF...'
        : downloadedBillId === bill.id
          ? 'Downloaded successfully'
          : 'Download Bill PDF'
    }
    aria-label={
      isDownloading
        ? 'Generating PDF'
        : downloadedBillId === bill.id
          ? 'Downloaded successfully'
          : 'Download Bill PDF'
    }
    className={`flex min-h-10 min-w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-lg p-2 transition sm:min-h-0 sm:min-w-0 ${
      downloadedBillId === bill.id
        ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-600'
        : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 hover:bg-orange-100 hover:text-orange-600'
    } ${
      isDownloading
        ? 'cursor-wait opacity-70'
        : ''
    }`}
  >
    {downloadedBillId === bill.id ? (
      <CheckCircle2
        size={15}
        className="animate-in zoom-in"
      />
    ) : (
      <Download
        size={14}
        className={
          isDownloading
            ? 'animate-pulse'
            : ''
        }
      />
    )}
  </button>
)}

                      {/* 3. PRINT RECEIPT */}
                      {isAdmin && (
                        <button
                          onClick={() =>
                            printReceipt(
                              bill,
                            )
                          }
                          title="Print Receipt"
                          aria-label="Print Receipt"
                          className="flex min-h-10 min-w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-slate-100 p-2 text-slate-600 hover:bg-orange-100 hover:text-orange-600 sm:min-h-0 sm:min-w-0"
                        >
                          <Receipt size={14} />
                        </button>
                      )}

                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* EXPANDED BILL DETAILS */}
                  {isExpanded && (
                    <div className="mt-3 border-t pt-3">

                      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-xs text-slate-600">

                        <div>
                          <span className="font-semibold">
                            Subtotal:
                          </span>{' '}
                          ₹
                          {bill.subtotal.toFixed(
                            2,
                          )}
                        </div>

                        <div>
                          <span className="font-semibold">
                            CGST:
                          </span>{' '}
                          ₹
                          {bill.cgst.toFixed(
                            2,
                          )}
                        </div>

                        <div>
                          <span className="font-semibold">
                            SGST:
                          </span>{' '}
                          ₹
                          {bill.sgst.toFixed(
                            2,
                          )}
                        </div>

                        <div>
                          <span className="font-semibold">
                            Service:
                          </span>{' '}
                          ₹
                          {bill.serviceCharge.toFixed(
                            2,
                          )}
                        </div>

                        <div>
                          <span className="font-semibold">
                            Discount:
                          </span>{' '}
                          ₹
                          {bill.discount.toFixed(
                            2,
                          )}
                        </div>

                        <div>
                          <span className="font-semibold">
                            Payment:
                          </span>{' '}
                          {paymentRecords.find(
                            (p) =>
                              p.billId ===
                              bill.id,
                          )?.paymentMode ??
                            'Pending'}
                        </div>

                      </div>

                      <div className="mt-2">

                        <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
                          Items:
                        </p>

                        {bill.lines.map(
                          (
                            item,
                            idx: number,
                          ) => (
                            <div
                              key={idx}
                              className="flex justify-between text-xs text-slate-600"
                            >

                              <span>
                                {
                                  item.nameSnapshot
                                }
                                {
                                  servingSuffix(
                                    item.servingType,
                                  )
                                }{' '}
                                x
                                {
                                  item.quantity
                                }
                              </span>

                              <span>
                                ₹
                                {(
                                  item.priceSnapshot *
                                  item.quantity
                                ).toFixed(
                                  2,
                                )}
                              </span>

                            </div>
                          ),
                        )}

                      </div>

                    </div>
                  )}

                </div>
              )
            },
          )}

        </div>
      )}

      {/* EXISTING PRINT PREVIEW */}
      {previewJobId && previewJob && (
        <PrintPreview
          previewJob={previewJob}
          onCancel={() => {
            setPreviewJobId(null)
            setPreviewJob(null)
          }}
        />
      )}

    </div>
  )
}

import { useState } from 'react'
import { useRestaurant } from '../context/RestaurantContext'
import type { DailySummary } from '../context/RestaurantContext'
import { CalendarDays, Receipt, Ticket, TrendingUp, Users } from 'lucide-react'

const money = (value: number): string =>
  `₹${value.toLocaleString('en-IN', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}`

const prettyDate = (date: string): string => {
  const [y, m, d] = date.split('-').map(Number)
  const parsed = new Date(y, (m ?? 1) - 1, d ?? 1)
  return parsed.toLocaleDateString('en-IN', { weekday: 'short', day: 'numeric', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' })
}

const RANGES: { value: 7 | 30 | 90; label: string }[] = [
  { value: 7, label: 'Last 7 days' },
  { value: 30, label: 'Last 30 days' },
  { value: 90, label: 'Last 90 days' },
]

/**
 * Day-wise history of everything that was recorded — revenue, orders, tokens,
 * guests and bills for each business day. Totals are derived from the persisted
 * records (orders / sessions / bills / payments), so past days stay reviewable
 * even after the registers were reset or the device was replaced.
 */
export default function AdminDayHistory() {
  const { getDailyHistory } = useRestaurant()
  const [range, setRange] = useState<7 | 30 | 90>(30)
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState<string | null>(null)

  const days = getDailyHistory(range)
  const totals = days.reduce(
    (acc, day) => ({
      collected: acc.collected + day.collectedRevenue,
      billed: acc.billed + day.billedRevenue,
      orders: acc.orders + day.orders,
      guests: acc.guests + day.guests,
    }),
    { collected: 0, billed: 0, orders: 0, guests: 0 },
  )
  const best = days.reduce<DailySummary | null>(
    (top, day) => (top === null || day.collectedRevenue > top.collectedRevenue ? day : top),
    null,
  )
  const expandedDay = expanded ? days.find((d) => d.date === expanded) : undefined

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-900">Day History</h2>
          <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-slate-500">Every day with recorded activity — newest first.</p>
        </div>
        <div className="bh-scroll-x flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl border border-orange-100 bg-white p-1.5">
          {RANGES.map((option) => (
            <button
              key={option.value}
              onClick={() => setRange(option.value)}
              className={`whitespace-nowrap rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold transition ${
                range === option.value
                  ? 'bg-linear-to-br from-orange-500 to-amber-500 text-white'
                  : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-200'
              }`}
            >
              {option.label}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-5">
        <SummaryTile icon={<TrendingUp size={15} />} label="Collected" value={money(totals.collected)} tone="text-emerald-600" />
        <SummaryTile icon={<Receipt size={15} />} label="Billed" value={money(totals.billed)} tone="text-orange-600" />
        <SummaryTile icon={<Ticket size={15} />} label="Orders" value={String(totals.orders)} tone="text-slate-800" />
        <SummaryTile icon={<Users size={15} />} label="Guests" value={String(totals.guests)} tone="text-blue-600" />
        <SummaryTile
          icon={<CalendarDays size={15} />}
          label="Best day"
          value={best ? money(best.collectedRevenue) : '—'}
          hint={best ? best.date : undefined}
          tone="text-violet-600"
        />
      </div>

      {days.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="rounded-[20px] border border-dashed border-slate-300 bg-white p-8 text-center">
          <p className="text-slate-500">No recorded activity in this period yet.</p>
          <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-400">
            Orders, bills and payments appear here as soon as the floor starts working.
          </p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <>
          <MobileDayCards days={days} />
          <DesktopDayTable days={days} expanded={expanded} onToggle={setExpanded} />
          {expandedDay && (
            <div className="hidden rounded-[20px] border border-orange-100 bg-white p-4 md:block">
              <p className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-800">Payment split · {prettyDate(expandedDay.date)}</p>
              <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                {Object.entries(expandedDay.byMode).length === 0 ? (
                  <p className="text-sm text-slate-500">No payments recorded.</p>
                ) : (
                  Object.entries(expandedDay.byMode).map(([mode, amount]) => (
                    <span
                      key={mode}
                      className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700"
                    >
                      {mode.replace(/_/g, ' ')} · {money(Number(amount))}
                    </span>
                  ))
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

function SummaryTile({
  icon,
  label,
  value,
  hint,
  tone,
}: {
  icon: React.ReactNode
  label: string
  value: string
  hint?: string
  tone: string
}) {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-[18px] border border-slate-200 bg-white p-3 shadow-sm">
      <div className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 ${tone}`}>
        {icon}
        <span className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide">{label}</span>
      </div>
      <p className="mt-1.5 truncate text-base font-extrabold text-slate-900 sm:text-lg">{value}</p>
      {hint && <p className="mt-0.5 truncate text-[10px] text-slate-400">{hint}</p>}
    </div>
  )
}

function MobileDayCards({ days }: { days: DailySummary[] }) {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-3 md:hidden">
      {days.map((day) => (
        <div key={day.date} className="rounded-[18px] border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <p className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900">{prettyDate(day.date)}</p>
            <span className="rounded-lg bg-emerald-50 px-2 py-1 text-xs font-bold text-emerald-700">
              {money(day.collectedRevenue)}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="mt-2 grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 text-center">
            <div>
              <p className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase text-slate-400">Orders</p>
              <p className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-800">{day.orders}</p>
            </div>
            <div>
              <p className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase text-slate-400">Guests</p>
              <p className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-800">{day.guests}</p>
            </div>
            <div>
              <p className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase text-slate-400">Billed</p>
              <p className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-800">{money(day.billedRevenue)}</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          {Object.entries(day.byMode).length > 0 && (
            <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
              {Object.entries(day.byMode).map(([mode, amount]) => (
                <span key={mode} className="rounded-lg bg-slate-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold text-slate-600">
                  {mode.replace(/_/g, ' ')} · {money(Number(amount))}
                </span>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  )
}

function DesktopDayTable({
  days,
  expanded,
  onToggle,
}: {
  days: DailySummary[]
  expanded: string | null
  onToggle: (date: string | null) => void
}) {
  return (
    <div className="hidden overflow-hidden rounded-[20px] border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-sm md:block">
      <table className="w-full text-left text-sm">
        <thead>
          <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-500">
            <th className="px-4 py-3">Date</th>
            <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">Collected</th>
            <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">Billed</th>
            <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">Orders</th>
            <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">Guests</th>
            <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">Payments</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {days.map((day) => (
            <tr
              key={day.date}
              onClick={() => onToggle(expanded === day.date ? null : day.date)}
              className={`cursor-pointer border-b border-slate-100 transition last:border-0 hover:bg-orange-50/50 ${
                expanded === day.date ? 'bg-orange-50' : ''
              }`}
            >
              <td className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold text-slate-800">{prettyDate(day.date)}</td>
              <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-bold text-emerald-600">{money(day.collectedRevenue)}</td>
              <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right text-orange-600">{money(day.billedRevenue)}</td>
              <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right text-slate-700">{day.orders}</td>
              <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right text-slate-700">{day.guests}</td>
              <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right text-xs text-slate-500">
                {Object.entries(day.byMode).length === 0
                  ? '—'
                  : Object.entries(day.byMode)
                      .map(([mode, amount]) => `${mode.replace(/_/g, ' ')} ${money(Number(amount))}`)
                      .join(', ')}
              </td>
            </tr>
          ))}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  )
}

FILE: src\components\AdminInventoryManagement.tsx

import { useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import { useRestaurant } from '../context/RestaurantContext'
import type { InventoryItem, StockStatus } from '../context/RestaurantContext'
import { Plus, Edit2, X, AlertTriangle, LayoutGrid, List, Rows3, CheckCircle2 } from 'lucide-react'
import { latestStockChangeByItem, purchaseStatusFor } from '../lib/inventoryPurchase'
import InventoryEditModal from './InventoryEditModal'

export default function AdminInventoryManagement() {
  const { inventory, addInventoryItem, settings, updateSettings, stockHistory } = useRestaurant()
  const viewMode = settings.inventoryViewMode ?? 'large'
  const [showForm, setShowForm] = useState(false)
  const [editingItem, setEditingItem] = useState<InventoryItem | null>(null)
  const [addSaved, setAddSaved] = useState(false)
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    name: '',
    quantity: 0,
    unit: 'kg',
    minimumThreshold: 5,
    category: 'General',
  })

  const resetForm = () => {
    setFormData({ name: '', quantity: 0, unit: 'kg', minimumThreshold: 5, category: 'General' })
    setShowForm(false)
    setAddSaved(false)
  }

  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
  e.preventDefault()

  if (addSaved) return

  addInventoryItem(formData)
  setAddSaved(true)

  window.setTimeout(() => {
    resetForm()
  }, 900)
}

  const getStatusColor = (status: StockStatus) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'GOOD': return 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700'
      case 'LOW': return 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700'
      case 'CRITICAL': return 'bg-red-100 text-red-700'
      case 'OUT_OF_STOCK': return 'bg-slate-200 text-slate-700'
      default: return 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600'
    }
  }

  const lowStockCount = inventory.filter((item) => item.status === 'LOW' || item.status === 'CRITICAL' || item.status === 'OUT_OF_STOCK').length
  const outOfStockCount = inventory.filter((item) => item.status === 'OUT_OF_STOCK').length
  const lowCount = inventory.filter((item) => item.status === 'LOW' || item.status === 'CRITICAL').length
  const [stockFilter, setStockFilter] = useState<'all' | 'out' | 'low'>('all')

  // Visual priority: OUT OF STOCK first, then LOW, then NORMAL/GOOD — the
  // actual quantity/minimum-stock state decides, never a fabricated order.
  const stockPriority = (status: StockStatus) =>
    status === 'OUT_OF_STOCK' ? 0 : status === 'LOW' || status === 'CRITICAL' ? 1 : 2
  const visibleItems = inventory
    .filter((item) =>
      stockFilter === 'all'
        ? true
        : stockFilter === 'out'
          ? item.status === 'OUT_OF_STOCK'
          : item.status === 'LOW' || item.status === 'CRITICAL',
    )
    .slice()
    .sort((a, b) => stockPriority(a.status) - stockPriority(b.status) || a.name.localeCompare(b.name))

  /**
   * "Quantity updated · purchase not recorded" / "Purchase recorded" — derived
   * from the SAME authoritative Firestore data the Supervisor screen uses (one
   * shared helper, no per-role flag, no duplicate counter), so the admin can see
   * that physical stock exists while its purchase is still unrecorded.
   */
  const latestStockChange = useMemo(() => latestStockChangeByItem(stockHistory), [stockHistory])
  const purchaseCaption = (itemId: string) => {
    const status = purchaseStatusFor(latestStockChange.get(itemId))
    if (!status) return null
    return (
      <p className={`text-[10px] font-bold ${status === 'RECORDED' ? 'text-emerald-600' : 'text-slate-400'}`}>
        {status === 'RECORDED' ? 'Purchase recorded' : 'Quantity updated · purchase not recorded'}
      </p>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <h2 className="text-xl font-bold leading-tight text-slate-900">Inventory Management</h2>
          {lowStockCount > 0 && (
            <p className="mt-1 flex items-center gap-1 text-sm text-amber-600">
              <AlertTriangle size={14} />
              {lowStockCount} item(s) need attention
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-2 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
          <div className="flex w-full items-center justify-between rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-1 sm:w-auto sm:justify-start" aria-label="Inventory tile size">
            {([
              ['large', 'Large', <LayoutGrid key="large-icon" size={17} />],
              ['medium', 'Medium', <LayoutGrid key="medium-icon" size={15} />],
              ['small', 'Small', <LayoutGrid key="small-icon" size={13} />],
              ['smaller', 'Smaller', <Rows3 key="smaller-icon" size={14} />],
              ['list', 'List', <List key="list-icon" size={16} />],
            ] as const).map(([mode, label, icon]) => (
              <button
                key={mode}
                onClick={() => {
                  // A display preference is a settings write. A failed write is
                  // non-critical: `updateSettings` reports it through its own
                  // error path (the UI keeps the previous view mode) and it must
                  // never surface as an unhandled rejection.
                  void updateSettings({ inventoryViewMode: mode }).catch(() => {})
                }}
                className={`flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-center justify-center gap-1 rounded-lg px-1.5 py-2 text-[10px] font-bold transition sm:flex-none sm:px-2.5 ${viewMode === mode ? 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-700' : 'text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700'}`}
                title={`${label} view`}
                aria-label={`${label} view`}
              >
                {icon}
                <span className="hidden sm:inline">{label}</span>
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
          <button onClick={() => setShowForm(true)} className="flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-orange-500 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-orange-600 sm:w-auto sm:px-4 sm:py-2">
            <Plus size={16} /> Add Item
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Stock filters — counts are computed from the SAME authoritative
          Firebase-backed inventory state (no separate counters). */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
        {(
          [
            ['all', `All (${inventory.length})`],
            ['out', `Out of Stock (${outOfStockCount})`],
            ['low', `Low Stock (${lowCount})`],
          ] as const
        ).map(([id, label]) => (
          <button
            key={id}
            onClick={() => setStockFilter(id)}
            className={`rounded-full px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold transition ${
              stockFilter === id
                ? id === 'out'
                  ? 'bg-slate-700 text-white'
                  : id === 'low'
                    ? 'bg-amber-500 text-white'
                    : 'bg-linear-to-br from-orange-500 to-amber-500 text-white shadow'
                : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 hover:bg-orange-100'
            }`}
          >
            {label}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {showForm && (
        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-orange-200 bg-orange-50 p-5">
          <div className="mb-4 flex items-center justify-between">
            <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900">Add Inventory Item</h3>
            <button onClick={resetForm} className="text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-700">
              <X size={20} />
            </button>
          </div>
          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
              <div>
                <label className="mb-1 block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700">Item Name</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={formData.name}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, name: e.target.value })}
                  placeholder="e.g., Cooking Oil"
                  required
                  className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-orange-400"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="mb-1 block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700">Category</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={formData.category}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, category: e.target.value })}
                  placeholder="e.g., Dry Goods"
                  className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-orange-400"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="mb-1 block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700">Current Quantity</label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  value={formData.quantity}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, quantity: parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0 })}
                  min="0"
                  step="0.1"
                  required
                  className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-orange-400"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="mb-1 block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700">Unit</label>
                <select
                  value={formData.unit}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, unit: e.target.value })}
                  className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-orange-400"
                >
                  <option value="kg">Kilograms (kg)</option>
                  <option value="g">Grams (g)</option>
                  <option value="L">Liters (L)</option>
                  <option value="ml">Milliliters (ml)</option>
                  <option value="pcs">Pieces (pcs)</option>
                  <option value="boxes">Boxes</option>
                </select>
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="mb-1 block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700">Minimum Threshold</label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  value={formData.minimumThreshold}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, minimumThreshold: parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0 })}
                  min="0"
                  step="0.1"
                  required
                  className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-orange-400"
                />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <button
  type="submit"
  disabled={addSaved}
  className={`flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-4 py-2 text-sm font-bold text-white transition ${
    addSaved
      ? 'bg-emerald-500'
      : 'bg-orange-500 hover:bg-orange-600'
  } disabled:cursor-not-allowed`}
>
  {addSaved ? (
    <>
      <CheckCircle2 size={16} />
      Added
    </>
  ) : (
    <>
      <Plus size={16} />
      Add Item
    </>
  )}
</button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={resetForm}
                className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-600 transition hover:bg-slate-50"
              >
                Cancel
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </div>
      )}

      {inventory.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="rounded-[20px] border border-dashed border-slate-300 bg-white p-8 text-center">
          <p className="text-slate-500">No inventory items configured.</p>
          <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-400">Click "Add Item" to start tracking inventory.</p>
        </div>
      ) : visibleItems.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="rounded-[20px] border border-dashed border-slate-300 bg-white p-8 text-center">
          <p className="text-slate-500">No items match this filter.</p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className={
          viewMode === 'list'
            ? 'space-y-2'
            : viewMode === 'smaller'
              ? 'grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 sm:gap-3 md:grid-cols-4 xl:grid-cols-5'
              : viewMode === 'small'
                ? 'grid grid-cols-2 gap-2.5 sm:gap-3 md:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4'
                : viewMode === 'medium'
                  ? 'grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 md:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4'
                  : 'grid grid-cols-1 gap-5 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3'
        }>
          {visibleItems.map((item) => (
            <div
              key={item.id}
              className={
                viewMode === 'list'
                  ? 'flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-2.5 shadow-sm'
                  : viewMode === 'smaller'
                    ? 'rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-2 shadow-sm'
                    : viewMode === 'small'
                      ? 'rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-2.5 shadow-sm'
                      : viewMode === 'medium'
                        ? 'rounded-[18px] border border-slate-200 bg-white p-3 shadow-sm'
                        : 'rounded-[22px] border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm'
              }
            >
              <div className={`flex items-start justify-between ${viewMode === 'smaller' ? 'mb-1.5' : viewMode === 'small' ? 'mb-2' : viewMode === 'list' ? '' : 'mb-3'}`}>
                <div>
                  <h3 className={`font-bold text-slate-900 ${viewMode === 'smaller' ? 'truncate text-xs' : viewMode === 'small' ? 'truncate text-sm' : viewMode === 'medium' ? 'text-base' : 'text-lg'}`}>{item.name}</h3>
                  <p className={`text-slate-500 ${viewMode === 'smaller' ? 'hidden' : viewMode === 'small' ? 'truncate text-[10px]' : 'text-sm'}`}>{item.category}</p>
                </div>
                <div className="flex flex-col items-end gap-1">
                  <span className={`rounded-full font-bold ${viewMode === 'smaller' ? 'px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[8px]' : viewMode === 'small' ? 'px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[9px]' : 'px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px]'} ${getStatusColor(item.status)}`}>
                    {item.status.replace(/_/g, ' ')}
                  </span>
                  {item.active === false && (
                    <span className="rounded-full bg-slate-200 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-600">Deactivated</span>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className={`${viewMode === 'list' ? 'hidden sm:block' : viewMode === 'smaller' ? 'mb-1.5' : viewMode === 'small' ? 'mb-2' : 'mb-3'}`}>
                <div className="flex items-baseline gap-1">
                  <span className={`font-black text-slate-900 ${viewMode === 'smaller' ? 'text-base' : viewMode === 'small' ? 'text-lg' : viewMode === 'medium' ? 'text-xl' : 'text-2xl'}`}>{item.quantity}</span>
                  <span className={`${viewMode === 'smaller' ? 'text-[9px]' : 'text-sm'} text-slate-500`}>{item.unit}</span>
                </div>
                <p className={`${viewMode === 'smaller' ? 'hidden' : 'text-xs'} text-slate-500`}>Min: {item.minimumThreshold} {item.unit}</p>
                {purchaseCaption(item.id)}
                {item.notes && <p className="mt-1 truncate text-xs text-slate-400">{item.notes}</p>}
              </div>
              <div className={`flex items-center gap-2 ${viewMode === 'list' ? 'ml-auto' : ''}`}>
                <button
                  onClick={() => setEditingItem(item)}
                  className={`flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg bg-orange-50 font-semibold text-orange-600 transition hover:bg-orange-100 ${viewMode === 'smaller' ? 'p-1.5 text-[9px]' : viewMode === 'small' ? 'px-2 py-1 text-[10px]' : 'px-3 py-1.5 text-xs'}`}
                >
                  <Edit2 size={12} />
                  <span className={viewMode === 'smaller' ? 'hidden' : ''}>Edit</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {editingItem && (
        <InventoryEditModal item={editingItem} showDangerActions onClose={() => setEditingItem(null)} />
      )}
    </div>
  )
}
