import { useState } from 'react'
import { useRestaurant } from '../context/RestaurantContext'
import type { InventoryItem, PaymentMode, PurchaseRequest } from '../context/RestaurantContext'
import { CheckCircle, XCircle, Clock, Package, ShoppingCart, X, Search, ArrowUpDown, CheckCircle2 } from 'lucide-react'

const PAYMENT_MODES: PaymentMode[] = ['CASH', 'UPI', 'PHONE_UPI', 'DEBIT_CARD', 'CREDIT_CARD', 'QR_CODE', 'WALLET']

type PurchaseDraft = { quantity: string; unitCost: string; vendor: string; note: string; paymentMode: PaymentMode }
const emptyDraft: PurchaseDraft = { quantity: '', unitCost: '', vendor: '', note: '', paymentMode: 'CASH' }

function RecordPurchaseModal({
  title, itemName, unit, defaultQty, itemId, requireItem, inventory, onSubmit, onClose,
}: {
  title: string
  itemName: string
  unit: string
  defaultQty?: number
  itemId?: string
  requireItem?: boolean
  inventory: InventoryItem[]
  onSubmit: (d: {
  quantity: number
  unitCost: number
  totalCost: number
  vendor: string
  note: string
  paymentMode: PaymentMode
  target?: {
    itemId: string
  } | {
    newItem: {
      name: string
      unit: string
      minimumThreshold: number
      category?: string
    }
  }
}) => boolean
  onClose: () => void
}) {
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<PurchaseDraft>({ ...emptyDraft, quantity: defaultQty ? String(defaultQty) : '' })
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState(false)
  const [invChoice, setInvChoice] = useState<'none' | 'existing' | 'new'>('none')
  const [invItemId, setInvItemId] = useState('')
  const [newName, setNewName] = useState('')
  const [newUnit, setNewUnit] = useState(unit || 'kg')
  const [newMin, setNewMin] = useState('0')
  const qty = parseFloat(draft.quantity) || 0
  const unitCost = parseFloat(draft.unitCost) || 0
  const totalCost = Math.round(qty * unitCost * 100) / 100
  // Only direct purchases REQUIRE a linked inventory item; request-based
  // purchases can still be saved even when the request has no linked item.
  const valid = qty > 0 && (!requireItem || itemId != null)

  const buildTarget = () => {
    if (requireItem && itemId) return { itemId }
    if (invChoice === 'existing' && invItemId) return { itemId: invItemId }
    if (invChoice === 'new' && newName.trim()) return { newItem: { name: newName.trim(), unit: newUnit, minimumThreshold: parseFloat(newMin) || 0 } }
    return undefined
  }

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/40 p-4" onClick={onClose}>
      <div className="w-full max-w-md rounded-[20px] bg-white p-5 shadow-xl" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
        <div className="mb-4 flex items-center justify-between">
          <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900">{title}</h3>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600"><X size={18} /></button>
        </div>
        <p className="mb-3 text-sm text-slate-600">
          <span className="font-semibold text-slate-800">{itemName}</span>{unit ? ` · ${unit}` : ''}
        </p>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600">
            Quantity purchased
            <input type="number" min="0" step="any" value={draft.quantity} onChange={(e) => setDraft({ ...draft, quantity: e.target.value })}
              className="mt-1 w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-200 px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-orange-400" />
          </label>
          <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600">
            Unit cost (₹)
            <input type="number" min="0" step="any" value={draft.unitCost} onChange={(e) => setDraft({ ...draft, unitCost: e.target.value })}
              className="mt-1 w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-200 px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-orange-400" />
          </label>
          <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600">
            Vendor
            <input value={draft.vendor} onChange={(e) => setDraft({ ...draft, vendor: e.target.value })}
              className="mt-1 w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-200 px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-orange-400" />
          </label>
          <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600">
            Payment mode
            <select value={draft.paymentMode} onChange={(e) => setDraft({ ...draft, paymentMode: e.target.value as PaymentMode })}
              className="mt-1 w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-200 px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-orange-400">
              {PAYMENT_MODES.map((m) => <option key={m} value={m}>{m.replace(/_/g, ' ')}</option>)}
            </select>
          </label>
          <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 sm:col-span-2">
            Note
            <input value={draft.note} onChange={(e) => setDraft({ ...draft, note: e.target.value })}
              className="mt-1 w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-200 px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-orange-400" />
          </label>
        </div>
        {/* Add to inventory */}
        <div className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-orange-100 bg-orange-50/60 p-3">
          <p className="mb-2 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-500">Add to inventory</p>
          <div className="mb-2 flex gap-2">
            {(['none', 'existing', 'new'] as const).map((c) => (
              <button key={c} onClick={() => setInvChoice(c)}
                className={`rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-bold transition ${invChoice === c ? 'bg-orange-500 text-white' : 'bg-white text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100'}`}>
                {c === 'none' ? 'Only record' : c === 'existing' ? 'Existing item' : 'New item'}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
          {invChoice === 'existing' && (
            <select value={invItemId} onChange={(e) => setInvItemId(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-orange-400">
              <option value="">Choose inventory item…</option>
              {inventory.map((i) => (
                <option key={i.id} value={i.id}>{i.name} ({i.quantity} {i.unit} in stock)</option>
              ))}
            </select>
          )}
          {invChoice === 'new' && (
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-3">
              <input value={newName} onChange={(e) => setNewName(e.target.value)} placeholder={`Item name (e.g. ${itemName})`}
                className="rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-orange-400 sm:col-span-3" />
              <select value={newUnit} onChange={(e) => setNewUnit(e.target.value)}
                className="rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white px-2 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-orange-400">
                {['kg', 'g', 'l', 'ml', 'pcs', 'boxes'].map((u) => <option key={u}>{u}</option>)}
              </select>
              <input type="number" min="0" value={newMin} onChange={(e) => setNewMin(e.target.value)} placeholder="Min threshold"
                className="rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-orange-400 sm:col-span-2" />
            </div>
          )}
          <p className="mt-1.5 text-[11px] text-slate-500">
            {invChoice === 'none' && 'Purchase is only recorded in payment history — stock is not changed.'}
            {invChoice === 'existing' && 'Purchased quantity will be added to the selected inventory item.'}
            {invChoice === 'new' && 'A new inventory item will be created with the purchased quantity as its starting stock.'}
          </p>
        </div>
        <p className="mt-3 text-sm text-slate-700">
          Total cost: <span className="text-lg font-black text-orange-600">₹{totalCost.toLocaleString()}</span>
        </p>
        <div className="mt-4 flex justify-end gap-2">
          <button onClick={onClose} className="rounded-lg border border-slate-200 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50">Cancel</button>
          <button
  type="button"
  disabled={!valid || saved}
  onClick={() => {
    if (saved) return

    const success = onSubmit({
      quantity: qty,
      unitCost,
      totalCost,
      vendor: draft.vendor.trim(),
      note: draft.note.trim(),
      paymentMode: draft.paymentMode,
      target: buildTarget(),
    })

    if (!success) return

    setSaved(true)

    window.setTimeout(() => {
      onClose()
    }, 900)
  }}
  className={`flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-4 py-2 text-sm font-bold text-white transition ${
    saved
      ? 'bg-emerald-500'
      : 'bg-orange-500 hover:bg-orange-600'
  } disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-90`}
>
  {saved ? (
    <>
      <CheckCircle2 size={16} />
      Saved
    </>
  ) : (
    'Save Purchase'
  )}
</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

export default function AdminPurchaseRequests() {
  const { purchaseRequests, updatePurchaseRequestStatus, markPurchaseRequestPurchased, recordInventoryPurchase, inventory } = useRestaurant()
  const [purchasing, setPurchasing] = useState<PurchaseRequest | null>(null)
  const [directPurchase, setDirectPurchase] = useState<InventoryItem | null>(null)
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('')
  const [sortBy, setSortBy] = useState<'newest' | 'oldest' | 'priority'>('newest')

  const visibleRequests = purchaseRequests
    .filter((r) => r.itemName.toLowerCase().includes(search.trim().toLowerCase()))
    .sort((a, b) => {
      if (sortBy === 'oldest') return a.createdAt - b.createdAt
      if (sortBy === 'priority') {
        const rank = { URGENT: 0, MEDIUM: 1, LOW: 2 }
        return rank[a.priority] - rank[b.priority]
      }
      return b.createdAt - a.createdAt
    })
  const pendingRequests = visibleRequests.filter((r) => r.status === 'PENDING')
  const approvedRequests = visibleRequests.filter((r) => r.status === 'APPROVED')
  const processedRequests = visibleRequests.filter((r) => r.status !== 'PENDING' && r.status !== 'APPROVED')
  const pendingCount = purchaseRequests.filter((r) => r.status === 'PENDING').length

  const getPriorityColor = (priority: PurchaseRequest['priority']) => {
    switch (priority) {
      case 'URGENT': return 'bg-red-100 text-red-700'
      case 'MEDIUM': return 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700'
      case 'LOW': return 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600'
      default: return 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600'
    }
  }

  const getStatusColor = (status: PurchaseRequest['status']) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'PENDING': return 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700'
      case 'APPROVED': return 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700'
      case 'REJECTED': return 'bg-red-100 text-red-700'
      case 'PURCHASED': return 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700'
      case 'RECEIVED': return 'bg-violet-100 text-violet-700'
      default: return 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600'
    }
  }

  const handleSave = (d: {
  quantity: number
  unitCost: number
  totalCost: number
  vendor: string
  note: string
  paymentMode: PaymentMode
  target?: {
    itemId: string
  } | {
    newItem: {
      name: string
      unit: string
      minimumThreshold: number
      category?: string
    }
  }
}): boolean => {
  setError(null)

  try {
    if (purchasing) {
      markPurchaseRequestPurchased(purchasing.id, {
        quantity: d.quantity,
        unitCost: d.unitCost,
        totalCost: d.totalCost,
        vendor: d.vendor,
        note: d.note,
        paymentMode: d.paymentMode,
        newItem: d.target && 'newItem' in d.target
          ? d.target.newItem
          : undefined,
        targetItemId: d.target && 'itemId' in d.target
          ? d.target.itemId
          : undefined,
      })

      return true
    }

    if (directPurchase) {
      recordInventoryPurchase({
        itemId: directPurchase.id,
        quantity: d.quantity,
        unitCost: d.unitCost,
        totalCost: d.totalCost,
        vendor: d.vendor,
        note: d.note,
        paymentMode: d.paymentMode,
      })

      return true
    }

    return false
  } catch (err) {
    setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err))
    return false
  }
}

  return (
    <div className="space-y-5">
      <div className="rounded-2xl border border-orange-100 bg-linear-to-br from-white to-orange-50/60 p-4 shadow-sm sm:p-5">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-xl font-black text-slate-900">Purchase Requests</h2>
            <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">Review supply requests, record purchases, and keep inventory synchronized.</p>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-amber-100 px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-bold text-amber-700">
          <Clock size={16} className="text-amber-500" />
          <span>{pendingCount} pending</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="mt-4 flex flex-col gap-2 sm:flex-row">
          <label className="relative min-w-0 flex-1">
            <Search size={15} className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400" />
            <input value={search} onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)} placeholder="Search requests by item name"
              className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white py-2.5 pl-9 pr-3 text-sm outline-none focus:border-orange-400" />
          </label>
          <label className="relative flex shrink-0 items-center">
            <ArrowUpDown size={14} className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 text-slate-400" />
            <select value={sortBy} onChange={(e) => setSortBy(e.target.value as typeof sortBy)} aria-label="Sort purchase requests"
              className="w-full appearance-none rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white py-2.5 pl-9 pr-8 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-600 outline-none focus:border-orange-400 sm:w-auto">
              <option value="newest">Newest first</option>
              <option value="oldest">Oldest first</option>
              <option value="priority">Priority first</option>
            </select>
          </label>
        </div>
      </div>

      {error && <p className="rounded-lg bg-red-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-red-700">{error}</p>}

      {purchaseRequests.length === 0 && inventory.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="rounded-[20px] border border-dashed border-slate-300 bg-white p-8 text-center">
          <Package className="mx-auto mb-2 text-slate-400" size={32} />
          <p className="text-slate-500">No purchase requests.</p>
          <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-400">Supervisor can create requests for supplies.</p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <>
          {pendingRequests.length > 0 && (
            <div>
              <h3 className="mb-3 text-lg font-bold text-amber-600">Pending Approval</h3>
              <div className="space-y-3">
                {pendingRequests.map((request) => (
                  <div key={request.id} className="rounded-2xl border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50/70 p-4 shadow-sm">
                    <div className="mb-3 flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-start sm:justify-between">
                      <div>
                        <h4 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900">{request.itemName}</h4>
                        <p className="text-sm text-slate-600">
                          Current: {request.currentQuantity} {request.unit} → Request: {request.requestedQuantity} {request.unit}
                        </p>
                      </div>
                      <span className={`rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold ${getPriorityColor(request.priority)}`}>
                        {request.priority}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    {request.reason && (
                      <p className="mb-3 text-sm text-slate-600">
                        <span className="font-semibold">Reason:</span> {request.reason}
                      </p>
                    )}
                    <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 sm:flex-row">
                      <button
                        onClick={() => updatePurchaseRequestStatus(request.id, 'APPROVED')}
                        className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg bg-emerald-500 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-emerald-600"
                      >
                        <CheckCircle size={14} />
                        Approve
                      </button>
                      <button
                        onClick={() => updatePurchaseRequestStatus(request.id, 'REJECTED')}
                        className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg bg-red-500 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-red-600"
                      >
                        <XCircle size={14} />
                        Reject
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {approvedRequests.length > 0 && (
            <div>
              <h3 className="mb-3 text-lg font-bold text-emerald-600">Approved — Waiting for Purchase</h3>
              <div className="space-y-3">
                {approvedRequests.map((request) => (
                  <div key={request.id} className="rounded-2xl border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50/70 p-4 shadow-sm">
                    <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-start sm:justify-between">
                      <div>
                        <h4 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900">{request.itemName}</h4>
                        <p className="text-sm text-slate-600">
                          Request: {request.requestedQuantity} {request.unit}
                          {request.itemId ? ' · linked to inventory' : ''}
                        </p>
                      </div>
                      <span className={`rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold ${getStatusColor(request.status)}`}>{request.status}</span>
                    </div>
                    <button
                      onClick={() => setPurchasing(request)}
                      className="mt-3 flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-1 rounded-lg bg-orange-500 px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-orange-600 sm:w-auto"
                    >
                      <ShoppingCart size={14} />
                      Record Purchase
                    </button>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          <div>
            <div className="mb-3 flex flex-col gap-2 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
              <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-700">Direct Purchase (no request)</h3>
              <select
                value=""
                onChange={(e) => {
                  const item = inventory.find((i) => i.id === e.target.value)
                  if (item) setDirectPurchase(item)
                }}
                className="w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-200 px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-orange-400 sm:w-auto"
              >
                <option value="">+ Record purchase for inventory item…</option>
                {inventory.map((i) => (
                  <option key={i.id} value={i.id}>{i.name} ({i.quantity} {i.unit} in stock)</option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>

          {processedRequests.length > 0 && (
            <div>
              <h3 className="mb-3 text-lg font-bold text-slate-700">Processed Requests</h3>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                {processedRequests.map((request) => (
                  <div key={request.id} className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-3">
                    <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
                      <div>
                        <p className="font-semibold text-slate-900">{request.itemName}</p>
                        <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                          {request.requestedQuantity} {request.unit} • {new Date(request.createdAt).toLocaleDateString()}
                          {request.processedByName ? ` • by ${request.processedByName}` : ''}
                        </p>
                        {request.purchasedQuantity != null && (
                          <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-blue-700">
                            Bought {request.purchasedQuantity} {request.unit} · ₹{request.purchaseUnitCost}/{request.unit} · total ₹{request.purchaseTotalCost?.toLocaleString()}
                            {request.purchaseVendor ? ` · ${request.purchaseVendor}` : ''}{request.purchaseMode ? ` · ${request.purchaseMode.replace(/_/g, ' ')}` : ''}
                          </p>
                        )}
                      </div>
                      <span className={`rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold ${getStatusColor(request.status)}`}>
                        {request.status}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </>
      )}

      {purchasing && (
        <RecordPurchaseModal
          title="Record Purchase"
          itemName={purchasing.itemName}
          unit={purchasing.unit}
          defaultQty={purchasing.requestedQuantity}
          itemId={purchasing.itemId}
          inventory={inventory}
          onSubmit={handleSave}
          onClose={() => { setPurchasing(null); setError(null) }}
        />
      )}
      {directPurchase && (
        <RecordPurchaseModal
          title="Direct Inventory Purchase"
          itemName={directPurchase.name}
          unit={directPurchase.unit}
          itemId={directPurchase.id}
          requireItem
          inventory={inventory}
          onSubmit={handleSave}
          onClose={() => { setDirectPurchase(null); setError(null) }}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

/**
 * Bee's Hive — ADMIN session billing modal (used from the Admin dashboard for
 * sessions the waiter created).
 *
 * Flow: session orders → "Generate Bill" → bill preview (thermal receipt via
 * PrintPreview) → payment-mode selection (CASH / UPI / PHONE UPI / DEBIT /
 * CREDIT / QR / WALLET — manual restaurant methods only) → payment recorded →
 * receipt reprinted as PAID. Waiters never see this modal: billing, payment
 * collection and reprints are ADMIN-only (see firestore.rules).
 */
import { useState } from 'react'
import { useRestaurant, PAYMENT_MODES } from '../context/RestaurantContext'
import type { PaymentMode } from '../context/RestaurantContext'
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext'
import { createPrintPreviewJob } from '../services/print/printService'
import type { BillPrintPayload } from '../services/print/printFormatters'
import PrintPreview from './PrintPreview'
import { servingSuffix } from '../lib/servingType'
import { CheckCircle2, Printer, X, Plus, Minus, UtensilsCrossed } from 'lucide-react'

const round2 = (n: number) => Math.round(n * 100) / 100

type AdminBillingViewMode = 'menu' | 'orders'

interface AdminSessionBillingProps { sessionId: string; tableId: string; onClose: () => void; viewMode?: AdminBillingViewMode }

interface CartItem {
  id: string
  menuItemId: string
  name: string
  price: number
  imageUrl?: string
  quantity: number
}

export default function AdminSessionBilling({ sessionId, tableId, onClose, viewMode = 'menu' }: AdminSessionBillingProps) {
  const { sessions, orders, menu, categories, bills, paymentRecords, settings, tables, generateBill, recordPayment, completeCleaning, closeSession } = useRestaurant()
  const { user } = useAuth()
  const [error, setError] = useState('')
  const [previewJobId, setPreviewJobId] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [previewJob, setPreviewJob] = useState<import('../services/print/printService').PrintJob | null>(null)
  const [cart, setCart] = useState<CartItem[]>([])
  const [selectedCategory, setSelectedCategory] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [paymentMode, setPaymentMode] = useState<PaymentMode | null>(null)

  const availableMenuItems = menu.filter((item) => item.available && item.active)
  const availableCategories = categories.filter((c) => c.active)
  const filteredMenuItems = selectedCategory
    ? availableMenuItems.filter((item) => item.categoryId === selectedCategory)
    : availableMenuItems
  const cartCount = cart.reduce((s, i) => s + i.quantity, 0)
  const cartTotal = cart.reduce((s, i) => s + i.price * i.quantity, 0)

  const session = sessions.find((s) => s.id === sessionId)
  const sessionOrders = orders.filter((o) => o.sessionId === sessionId)
  const hasOrders = sessionOrders.some((o) => o.status !== 'cancelled' && o.items.length > 0)
  const bill = bills.find((b) => b.sessionId === sessionId)
  const record = paymentRecords.find((p) => p.sessionId === sessionId)

  const subtotal = sessionOrders.reduce((sum, o) => sum + o.totalAmount, 0)
  const gstRate = Math.max(0, Number(settings.taxRate) || 0)
  const cgstRate = round2(gstRate / 2)
  const sgstRate = round2(gstRate / 2)
  const cgst = round2(subtotal * cgstRate / 100)
  const sgst = round2(subtotal * sgstRate / 100)
  const serviceCharge = settings.serviceChargeMode === 'rupees'
    ? round2(Math.max(0, Number(settings.serviceCharge) || 0))
    : round2(subtotal * (Number(settings.serviceCharge) || 0) / 100)
  const total = round2(subtotal + cgst + sgst + serviceCharge)
  const buildBillPrintPayload = (targetBill: typeof bill, status: string, mode?: string): BillPrintPayload | undefined => {
    if (!targetBill) return undefined
    return {
      billNumber: targetBill.billNumber,
      date: new Date(targetBill.generatedAt).toLocaleDateString(),
      time: new Date(targetBill.generatedAt).toLocaleTimeString(),
      table: tables.find((table) => table.id === targetBill.tableId)?.name ?? targetBill.tableId,
      waiter: user?.name ?? '',
      lines: targetBill.lines.map((line) => ({
        name: line.nameSnapshot + servingSuffix(line.servingType),
        quantity: line.quantity,
        amount: line.priceSnapshot,
      })),
      subtotal: targetBill.subtotal,
      cgstRate: gstRate / 2,
      cgst: targetBill.cgst,
      sgstRate: gstRate / 2,
      sgst: targetBill.sgst,
      discount: targetBill.discount,
      serviceCharge: targetBill.serviceCharge,
      parcelCharge: targetBill.parcelCharge,
      grandTotal: targetBill.grandTotal,
      paymentStatus: status,
      paymentMode: mode,
      restaurantName: settings.restaurantName,
      address: settings.address,
      gstin: settings.gstin,
      fssaiLicenseNumber: settings.fssaiLicenseNumber,
    }
  }
  
  const openBillPreview = (targetBill: typeof bill, status: string, mode?: string) => {
    if (!targetBill) return
    const payload = buildBillPrintPayload(targetBill, status, mode)
    if (!payload) return
    const preview = createPrintPreviewJob('bill', 'counter_bill', payload, targetBill.id)
    setPreviewJobId(preview.id)
    setPreviewJob(preview)
  }

  const handleGenerate = () => {
    setError('')
    try {
      const generated = generateBill(sessionId)
      if (!generated?.id) throw new Error('Could not generate bill')
      // Generate Bill NEVER prints. The operator explicitly opens the preview
      // and then presses PRINT if a physical bill is required.
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Could not generate bill')
    }
  }

  const handleCollectPayment = () => {
    setError('')
    if (!bill) return
    if (!paymentMode) { setError('Please select a payment method'); return }
    if (!user) { setError('Not signed in — cannot record payment'); return }
    try {
      recordPayment({ billId: bill.id, sessionId, tableId, amount: bill.grandTotal, paymentMode, recordedBy: user.id })
      setPaymentMode(null)
      // Payment Done does not print automatically. It opens the updated PAID
      // preview; the operator must press PRINT to send it to the Admin PT-210.
      const payload = buildBillPrintPayload(bill, 'PAID', paymentMode)
      if (payload) {
        const preview = createPrintPreviewJob('bill', 'counter_bill', payload, bill.id)
        setPreviewJobId(preview.id)
        setPreviewJob(preview)
      }
    } catch (err) { setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Could not record payment') }
  }

  const addToCart = (menuItem: (typeof menu)[0]) => {
    setCart((prev) => {
      const existing = prev.find((item) => item.menuItemId === menuItem.id)
      if (existing) {
        return prev.map((item) =>
          item.menuItemId === menuItem.id ? { ...item, quantity: item.quantity + 1 } : item
        )
      }
      return [...prev, {
        id: `cart_${Date.now().toString(36)}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7)}`,
        menuItemId: menuItem.id,
        name: menuItem.name,
        price: menuItem.price,
        imageUrl: menuItem.imageUrl,
        quantity: 1,
      }]
    })
  }

  const updateQuantity = (cartItemId: string, delta: number) => {
    setCart((prev) =>
      prev.map((item) =>
        item.id === cartItemId ? { ...item, quantity: Math.max(0, item.quantity + delta) } : item
      ).filter((item) => item.quantity > 0)
    )
  }

  const removeFromCart = (cartItemId: string) => {
    setCart((prev) => prev.filter((item) => item.id !== cartItemId))
  }

  if (!session) return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-start justify-center overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain bg-black/40 p-3 sm:p-4 py-4 sm:py-6 sm:items-center bh-modal-overlay">
      <div className="rounded-2xl bg-white p-5 shadow-2xl">
        <p className="text-slate-500">Session not found.</p>
        <button onClick={onClose} className="mt-4 min-h-11 w-full rounded-xl bg-slate-100 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold">Close</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  )

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-start justify-center overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain bg-black/40 p-3 sm:p-4 py-4 sm:py-6 sm:items-center bh-modal-overlay">
      <div className="relative max-h-[90vh] sm:max-h-[92vh] w-full max-w-md overflow-y-auto rounded-2xl bg-white p-3.5 sm:p-5 shadow-2xl">
        {/* Close (X) button with generous 44px touch area */}
        {!bill && (
          <button 
            onClick={onClose} 
            className="absolute right-3 top-3 z-10 flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-slate-100 text-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-200 active:scale-95" 
            aria-label="Close"
          >
            <X size={20} />
          </button>
        )}

        {/* Guest review: food items summary */}
        {!bill && (
          <div className="mb-3">
            <p className="mb-1 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">Confirm with guest — food & total</p>
            <div className="max-h-36 space-y-1.5 overflow-y-auto rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 p-2.5 text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-700">
              {((() => {
                const agg = new Map<string, { qty: number; amt: number }>()
                sessionOrders.filter((o) => o.status !== 'cancelled').forEach((o) =>
                  o.items.forEach((i) => {
                    // Key includes the serving variant so a HALF and a FULL line
                    // of the same dish are never merged into one row.
                    const key = i.nameSnapshot + servingSuffix(i.servingType)
                    const e = agg.get(key) ?? { qty: 0, amt: 0 }
                    e.qty += i.quantity; e.amt += i.priceSnapshot * i.quantity
                    agg.set(key, e)
                  }))
                const rows = [...agg.entries()]
                return rows.length === 0
                  ? <p className="py-2 text-center text-xs text-slate-400">No food ordered this session.</p>
                  : rows.map(([name, e]) => (
                    <div key={name} className="flex justify-between items-center">
                      <span className="font-medium truncate pr-2">{name} × {e.qty}</span>
                      <span className="font-semibold shrink-0">₹{e.amt.toFixed(2)}</span>
                    </div>
                  ))
              })())}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Menu grid */}
        {viewMode === 'menu' && (
          <div className="mb-3">
            <div className="mb-2 flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
              <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">Add items to cart</p>
              {cartCount > 0 && (
                <span className="rounded-full bg-orange-100 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-bold text-orange-700">
                  {cartCount} in cart · ₹{cartTotal.toFixed(0)}
                </span>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Horizontal scrollable category filters */}
            {availableCategories.length > 0 && (
              <div className="mb-2.5 flex items-center gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto pb-1 scrollbar-none">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setSelectedCategory(null)}
                  className={`shrink-0 rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold transition min-h-9 ${selectedCategory === null ? 'bg-orange-500 text-white' : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-200'}`}
                >
                  All
                </button>
                {availableCategories.map((cat) => (
                  <button
                    key={cat.id}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setSelectedCategory(cat.id)}
                    className={`shrink-0 rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold transition min-h-9 ${selectedCategory === cat.id ? 'bg-orange-500 text-white' : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-200'}`}
                  >
                    {cat.name}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Menu items list/grid */}
            {filteredMenuItems.length === 0 ? (
              <p className="py-4 text-center text-xs text-slate-400">No menu items available.</p>
            ) : (
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2 max-h-60 overflow-y-auto rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 p-2">
                {filteredMenuItems.map((item) => {
                  const inCart = cart.find((c) => c.menuItemId === item.id)
                  return (
                    <div key={item.id} className="flex items-center gap-2.5 rounded-xl bg-white p-2 shadow-sm border border-slate-100">
                      {item.imageUrl ? (
                        <img src={item.imageUrl} alt={item.name} className="h-11 w-11 shrink-0 rounded-lg object-cover" />
                      ) : (
                        <div className="flex h-11 w-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-slate-100 text-slate-400">
                          <UtensilsCrossed size={16} />
                        </div>
                      )}
                      <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                        <p className="truncate text-xs font-bold text-slate-900">{item.name}</p>
                        <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-500">₹{item.price.toFixed(0)}</p>
                      </div>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => addToCart(item)}
                        className="flex h-9 w-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-orange-500 font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-orange-600 active:scale-95"
                        aria-label={`Add ${item.name}`}
                      >
                        {inCart ? '✓' : <Plus size={16} />}
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  )
                })}
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Mini cart */}
            {cart.length > 0 && (
              <div className="mt-2.5 space-y-2 rounded-xl border border-orange-100 bg-white p-2.5 shadow-sm">
                <p className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">
                  <span>Cart</span>
                  <span className="text-orange-600">₹{cartTotal.toFixed(2)}</span>
                </p>
                <div className="max-h-28 space-y-1.5 overflow-y-auto">
                  {cart.map((item) => (
                    <div key={item.id} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-lg bg-slate-50 px-2.5 py-1.5">
                      <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                        <p className="truncate text-xs font-semibold text-slate-900">{item.name}</p>
                        <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">₹{item.price.toFixed(0)} × {item.quantity}</p>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0">
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => updateQuantity(item.id, -1)}
                          className="flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-md bg-white text-slate-600 shadow-sm border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-100 active:scale-95"
                          aria-label="Decrease quantity"
                        >
                          <Minus size={12} />
                        </button>
                        <span className="w-5 text-center text-xs font-bold">{item.quantity}</span>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => updateQuantity(item.id, 1)}
                          className="flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-md bg-white text-slate-600 shadow-sm border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-100 active:scale-95"
                          aria-label="Increase quantity"
                        >
                          <Plus size={12} />
                        </button>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => removeFromCart(item.id)}
                          className="ml-1 flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-md text-slate-400 hover:bg-red-50 hover:text-red-500"
                          aria-label="Remove item"
                        >
                          <X size={14} />
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setCart([])}
                  className="w-full min-h-9 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-50"
                >
                  Clear cart
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Bill calculation details */}
        <div className="mb-3 space-y-1.5 text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-700 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 p-2.5 border border-slate-100">
          <div className="flex justify-between"><span>Subtotal</span><span>₹{subtotal.toFixed(2)}</span></div>
          <div className="flex justify-between text-slate-500"><span>CGST {cgstRate}%</span><span>₹{cgst.toFixed(2)}</span></div>
          <div className="flex justify-between text-slate-500"><span>SGST {sgstRate}%</span><span>₹{sgst.toFixed(2)}</span></div>
          <div className="flex justify-between text-slate-500"><span>Service</span><span>₹{serviceCharge.toFixed(2)}</span></div>
          <div className="flex justify-between border-t border-slate-200 pt-1.5 font-bold text-slate-900 text-sm sm:text-base">
            <span>Total</span>
            <span>₹{total.toFixed(2)}</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {bill && (
          <div className="mb-3 rounded-xl bg-orange-50 p-3 text-xs sm:text-sm border border-orange-100">
            <p className="font-bold text-orange-900">BILL NO : {bill.billNumber}</p>
            <p className={`text-xs font-bold mt-0.5 ${record ? 'text-emerald-700' : 'text-orange-700'}`}>
              {record ? `PAID · ${record.paymentMode.replace(/_/g, ' ').toUpperCase()}` : 'PAYMENT PENDING'}
            </p>
            <button
              onClick={() => openBillPreview(bill, record ? 'PAID' : 'PENDING', record?.paymentMode)}
              className="mt-2 flex min-h-8 items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-orange-700 hover:underline"
            >
              <Printer size={14} /> Bill Preview / Print
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {error && (
          <p className="mb-3 rounded-xl bg-red-50 px-3 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-red-600 border border-red-100">{error}</p>
        )}

        {/* Step Actions */}
        {!bill ? (
          hasOrders ? (
            <button 
              onClick={handleGenerate} 
              className="w-full min-h-12 rounded-xl bg-orange-500 px-4 py-3 font-bold text-white shadow-md transition hover:bg-orange-600 active:scale-[0.98]"
            >
              Generate Bill
            </button>
          ) : (
            <>
              <p className="mb-2 rounded-xl bg-amber-50 px-3 py-2.5 text-center text-xs font-semibold text-amber-700 border border-amber-100">
                There is no order yet — please take the food order first.
              </p>
              <button disabled className="w-full min-h-12 cursor-not-allowed rounded-xl bg-slate-300 px-4 py-3 font-bold text-white">
                Generate Bill
              </button>
            </>
          )
        ) : record ? (
          <>
            <div className="mb-3 flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-50 px-3 py-2.5 text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-100">
              <CheckCircle2 size={16} className="shrink-0 text-emerald-600" /> Bill settled — session PAID.
            </div>
            <p className="mt-2 text-center text-xs text-slate-500">Guests have paid. Clean the table to close the session and free capacity.</p>
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                setError('')
                try {
                  if (session.status !== 'closed') closeSession(sessionId)
                  completeCleaning(tableId, sessionId)
                  onClose()
                } catch (err) {
                  setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Could not close the session')
                }
              }}
              className="mt-2 w-full min-h-12 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 px-4 py-3 font-bold text-white shadow-md transition hover:bg-blue-700 active:scale-[0.98]"
            >
              Complete Table Cleaning
            </button>
          </>
        ) : (
          <>
            <div className="mb-2.5 rounded-xl bg-amber-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-amber-800 border border-amber-100">
              Bill generated — select payment method to settle.
            </div>

            <p className="mb-1.5 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">Payment method</p>
            <div className="mb-3 grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
              {PAYMENT_MODES.map((mode) => (
                <button
                  key={mode}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setPaymentMode(mode)}
                  className={`min-h-11 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-xs font-bold capitalize transition ${paymentMode === mode ? 'bg-orange-500 text-white shadow-sm' : 'bg-white text-slate-700 ring-1 ring-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50'}`}
                >
                  {mode.replace(/_/g, ' ')}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>

            <button
              onClick={handleCollectPayment}
              disabled={!paymentMode}
              className="w-full min-h-12 rounded-xl bg-emerald-600 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-white shadow-md transition hover:bg-emerald-700 active:scale-[0.98] disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:bg-slate-300"
            >
              {paymentMode ? `Collect ₹${bill.grandTotal.toFixed(2)} · Confirm Payment` : 'Select a payment method'}
            </button>
          </>
        )}

      </div>

      {previewJobId && previewJob && <PrintPreview previewJob={previewJob} onCancel={() => { setPreviewJobId(null); setPreviewJob(null) }} />}
    </div>
  )
}

import { useState } from 'react';
import { useAuth, MAX_SUPERVISORS, type UserAccount } from '../context/AuthContext';
import Avatar from './Avatar';
import AvatarUpload from './AvatarUpload';
import { isValidContactEmailFormat, isValidPhone } from '../services/firebase/userService';
import { validateUsername } from '../lib/username';
import {
  UserPlus,
  Edit2,
  Trash2,
  Mail,
  Phone,
  Lock,
  User,
  X,
  Calendar,
  BadgeCheck,
  CheckCircle2,
  Circle,
  AlertCircle,
  AlertTriangle,
} from 'lucide-react';

type StaffFormData = {
  name: string;
  username: string;
  email: string;
  phone: string;
  password: string;
  confirmPassword: string;
  role: 'waiter' | 'supervisor';
  active: boolean;
  avatarUrl?: string;
};

const emptyForm: StaffFormData = {
  name: '',
  username: '',
  email: '',
  phone: '',
  password: '',
  confirmPassword: '',
  role: 'waiter',
  active: true,
  avatarUrl: '',
};

const PASSWORD_RULES: { label: string; test: (pwd: string) => boolean }[] = [
  { label: 'At least 8 characters', test: (p) => p.length >= 8 },
  { label: 'One uppercase letter (A-Z)', test: (p) => /[A-Z]/.test(p) },
  { label: 'One lowercase letter (a-z)', test: (p) => /[a-z]/.test(p) },
  { label: 'One number (0-9)', test: (p) => /[0-9]/.test(p) },
  { label: 'One special character (!@#$…)', test: (p) => /[!@#$%^&*(),.?":{}|<>]/.test(p) },
];

export default function AdminStaffManagement() {
  const { createStaff, updateStaff, deleteStaff, listStaff, users } = useAuth();
  const [showForm, setShowForm] = useState(false);
  const [editingId, setEditingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [form, setForm] = useState<StaffFormData>(emptyForm);
  const [formAvatarFile, setFormAvatarFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [editSaved, setEditSaved] = useState(false);
  const [detailsMember, setDetailsMember] = useState<UserAccount | null>(null);

  const staff = listStaff();
  const supervisorCount = users.filter((u) => u.role === 'supervisor').length;
  const supervisorsFull = supervisorCount >= MAX_SUPERVISORS;

  const passwordChecks = PASSWORD_RULES.map((rule) => ({ ...rule, ok: rule.test(form.password) }));
  const passwordValid = form.password.length > 0 && passwordChecks.every((r) => r.ok);
  const passwordsMismatch =
    form.confirmPassword.length > 0 && form.confirmPassword !== form.password;
  const passwordRequired = !editingId || form.password.length > 0;
  const passwordOk = !passwordRequired || passwordValid;
  const confirmOk = !passwordRequired || (!passwordsMismatch && form.confirmPassword.length > 0);
  const canSubmit = passwordOk && confirmOk;

  const openCreate = () => {
    setEditingId(null);
    setForm(emptyForm);
    setFormAvatarFile(null);
    setShowForm(true);
    setError('');
    setEditSaved(false);
  };

  const openEdit = (member: UserAccount) => {
    setEditingId(member.id);
    setForm({
      name: member.name,
      username: member.username,
      email: member.email,
      phone: member.phone,
      password: '',
      confirmPassword: '',
      role: member.role as 'waiter' | 'supervisor',
      active: member.active,
      avatarUrl: member.avatarUrl ?? '',
    });
    setFormAvatarFile(null);
    setShowForm(true);
    setError('');
    setEditSaved(false);
  };

  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    if (!form.name || !form.username || !form.email || !form.phone) {
      setError('Name, username, email and phone number are all required');
      return;
    }
    const usernameError = validateUsername(form.username);
    if (usernameError) {
      setError(usernameError);
      return;
    }
    if (!isValidContactEmailFormat(form.email)) {
      setError('Enter a valid email address.');
      return;
    }
    if (!isValidPhone(form.phone)) {
      setError('Phone number must be exactly 10 digits.');
      return;
    }
    if (passwordRequired && !passwordValid) {
      setError(
        'Password must meet all strength requirements (8+ characters, upper & lower case, number and special character).'
      );
      return;
    }
    if (passwordRequired && passwordsMismatch) {
      setError('Password and Confirm Password do not match.');
      return;
    }
    if (!editingId && form.role === 'supervisor' && supervisorsFull) {
      setError(
        `Maximum ${MAX_SUPERVISORS} Supervisor accounts allowed — deactivate or remove one first.`
      );
      return;
    }
    const editingMember = editingId ? users.find((u) => u.id === editingId) : undefined;
    if (
      editingMember &&
      form.role === 'supervisor' &&
      editingMember.role !== 'supervisor' &&
      supervisorsFull
    ) {
      setError(
        `Maximum ${MAX_SUPERVISORS} Supervisor accounts allowed — deactivate or remove one first.`
      );
      return;
    }
    const normalizedUsername = form.username.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (
      users.some(
        (u) => u.id !== editingId && (u.username ?? '').toLowerCase() === normalizedUsername
      )
    ) {
      setError('That username is already taken by another account.');
      return;
    }
    if (
      users.some(
        (u) =>
          u.id !== editingId && (u.email ?? '').toLowerCase() === form.email.trim().toLowerCase()
      )
    ) {
      setError('That email address is already in use by another account.');
      return;
    }
    if (users.some((u) => u.id !== editingId && u.phone === form.phone)) {
      setError('That phone number is already in use by another account.');
      return;
    }

    setSaving(true);
    setError('');
    try {
  if (editingId) {
    // Password is optional on edit: only sent when the admin typed a new one.
    const rest: Parameters<typeof updateStaff>[1] = {
      name: form.name,
      username: normalizedUsername,
      email: form.email,
      phone: form.phone,
      role: form.role,
      active: form.active,
      avatarUrl: form.avatarUrl,
    };

    if (form.password.length > 0) {
      rest.password = form.password;
    }

    await updateStaff(editingId, rest);

    // Keep Edit Staff modal open and show Saved.
    setEditSaved(true);
  } else {
    const rest = {
      name: form.name,
      username: normalizedUsername,
      email: form.email,
      phone: form.phone,
      password: form.password,
      role: form.role,
      active: form.active,
      avatarUrl: formAvatarFile ? undefined : form.avatarUrl || undefined,
    };

    await createStaff({
      ...rest,
      avatarFile: formAvatarFile ?? undefined,
    });

    // Create Staff keeps the existing behavior.
    setShowForm(false);
    setEditingId(null);
    setForm(emptyForm);
    setFormAvatarFile(null);
  }
} catch (err) {
  setEditSaved(false);
  setError(
    err instanceof Error
      ? err.message
      : 'Could not save the staff account.'
  );
} finally {
  setSaving(false);
}
  };

  const [deleteConfirm, setDeleteConfirm] = useState<{ id: string; name: string } | null>(null);

  const handleDelete = (id: string, name: string) => {
    setDeleteConfirm({ id, name });
  };

  const confirmDelete = async () => {
    if (!deleteConfirm) return;
    const { id } = deleteConfirm;
    setDeleteConfirm(null);
    setError('');
    try {
      await deleteStaff(id);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Could not delete the staff account.');
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-900">Staff Accounts</h2>
        <button
          onClick={openCreate}
          className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-orange-500 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-bold text-white hover:bg-orange-600"
        >
          <UserPlus size={16} /> Add Staff
        </button>
      </div>
      {staff.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="rounded-[20px] border border-dashed border-slate-300 bg-white p-8 text-center">
          <User size={40} className="mx-auto mb-3 text-slate-300" />
          <p className="text-slate-500">No staff accounts yet. Add waiters or supervisors.</p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-2">
          {staff.map((member) => (
            <div
              key={member.id}
              className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-xl bg-white p-4 shadow-sm"
            >
              <button
                onClick={() => setDetailsMember(member)}

</button>

                {detailsMember.role}

                {detailsMember.email}
              </div>

                  <Phone size={15} className="shrink-0 text-slate-400" />
                  {detailsMember.phone}

              )}
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-slate-600">
                <BadgeCheck size={15} className="shrink-0 text-slate-400" />
                <span className="capitalize">{detailsMember.id}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-slate-600">
                <Calendar size={15} className="shrink-0 text-slate-400" />
                {new Date(detailsMember.createdAt).toLocaleDateString('en-IN', {
                  day: 'numeric',
                  month: 'short',
                  year: 'numeric',
                })}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="mt-3 flex items-center justify-center">
              <span
                className={`rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-bold ${

                    ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700'
                    : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-500'
                }`}
              >
                {detailsMember.active ? 'Active' : 'Inactive'}

                onClick={() => {

                }}

              >
                <Edit2 size={16} /> Edit
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={() => {
                  const member = detailsMember;
                  setDetailsMember(null);
                  handleDelete(member.id, member.name);
                }}

                <Trash2 size={16} /> Delete

        </div>
      )}

      {deleteConfirm && (
        <div
          className="fixed inset-0 z-70 flex items-center justify-center overflow-y-auto bg-black/40 p-4 bh-modal-overlay"

            className="w-full max-w-sm rounded-2xl bg-white p-6 shadow-2xl"
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          >
            <div className="mb-4 flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-rose-100">
              <AlertTriangle className="text-rose-600" size={24} />
            </div>
            <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900">Delete staff account?</h3>
            <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">
              Delete staff account "{deleteConfirm.name}"?
            </p>
            <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-400">This action cannot be undone.</p>
            <div className="mt-6 flex justify-end gap-2">
              <button
                onClick={() => setDeleteConfirm(null)}

              >
                Cancel
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={confirmDelete}
                className="rounded-xl bg-rose-600 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-bold text-white hover:bg-rose-700"
              >
                Delete
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState } from 'react'
import { useRestaurant } from '../context/RestaurantContext'
import { ClipboardList, Package, ShoppingCart, AlertTriangle } from 'lucide-react'
import {
  toBusinessDayStr,
  todayBusinessDayStr,
  businessDayStart,
  businessMonthStart,
  businessYearStart,
} from '../lib/businessDay'

type RangeKey = 'today' | 'week' | 'month' | 'year' | 'all'
const RANGES: { id: RangeKey; label: string }[] = [
  { id: 'today', label: 'Today' },
  { id: 'week', label: '7 Days' },
  { id: 'month', label: 'Month' },
  { id: 'year', label: 'Year' },
  { id: 'all', label: 'All' },
]
const r1 = (n: number) => Math.round(n * 100) / 100
const toDateStr = (d: Date) => toBusinessDayStr(d.getTime())
// IST day/month bucket keys (identical bucketing on every device).
const dayKey = (d: Date) => {
  const key = toBusinessDayStr(d.getTime())
  return `${key.slice(0, 4)}-${Number(key.slice(5, 7)) - 1}-${Number(key.slice(8, 10))}`
}
const monKey = (d: Date) => {
  const key = toBusinessDayStr(d.getTime())
  return `${key.slice(0, 4)}-${Number(key.slice(5, 7)) - 1}`
}
const MONTHS = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec']
const timestampNumber = (value: unknown): number => {
  if (typeof value === 'number') return value
  if (typeof value === 'string') {
    const parsed = Date.parse(value)
    return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : 0
  }
  if (value && typeof value === 'object' && 'toMillis' in value && typeof value.toMillis === 'function') {
    return value.toMillis()
  }
  if (value && typeof value === 'object' && 'seconds' in value && typeof value.seconds === 'number') {
    return value.seconds * 1000
  }
  return 0
}

function bucketFor(ts: number, key: RangeKey): string {
  const d = new Date(ts)
  if (key === 'today') return `${dayKey(d)}-${d.getHours()}`
  if (key === 'week' || key === 'month') return dayKey(d)
  return monKey(d)
}

function rangeStart(key: RangeKey): number | null {
  const today = todayBusinessDayStr()
  if (key === 'today') return businessDayStart(today)
  if (key === 'week') {
    // Rolling 7-day window ending at the start of today (IST).
    const [y, m, d] = today.split('-').map(Number)
    const from = new Date(Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d))
    from.setUTCDate(from.getUTCDate() - 6)
    return businessDayStart(`${from.getUTCFullYear()}-${String(from.getUTCMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(from.getUTCDate()).padStart(2, '0')}`)
  }
  if (key === 'month') return businessMonthStart(today)
  if (key === 'year') return businessYearStart(today)
  return null
}

const statusChip = (s: string) =>
  ({
    GOOD: 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700',
    LOW: 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700',
    CRITICAL: 'bg-red-100 text-red-700',
    OUT_OF_STOCK: 'bg-slate-200 text-slate-600',
  }[s] ?? 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600')
const statusColor = (s: string) =>
  ({ GOOD: '#22c55e', LOW: '#f59e0b', CRITICAL: '#ef4444', OUT_OF_STOCK: '#94a3b8' }[s] ?? '#cbd5e1')

export default function AdminStockAnalytics() {
  const { inventory, inventoryUsage, stockHistory, purchaseRequests, paymentRecords } = useRestaurant()
  const [range, setRange] = useState<RangeKey>('month')
  // Optional exact-day filter: overrides the range buttons when set.
  const [selectedDate, setSelectedDate] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const from = rangeStart(range)
  const inRange = (t: unknown) => {
    const timestamp = timestampNumber(t)
    return timestamp > 0 && (selectedDate ? toDateStr(new Date(timestamp)) === selectedDate : from == null || timestamp >= from)
  }

  const usage = inventoryUsage.filter((u) => inRange(u.timestamp)).sort((a, b) => timestampNumber(b.timestamp) - timestampNumber(a.timestamp))
  const replUpdates = stockHistory.filter((h) => inRange(h.timestamp) && Number(h.difference) >= 0)
  const conUpdates = stockHistory.filter((h) => inRange(h.timestamp) && Number(h.difference) < 0)
  const purchases = purchaseRequests
    .filter((p) => (p.status === 'PURCHASED' || p.status === 'RECEIVED') && inRange(p.createdAt))
    .sort((a, b) => b.createdAt - a.createdAt)
  const stockUpdates = stockHistory.filter((h) => inRange(h.timestamp)).sort((a, b) => b.timestamp - a.timestamp)

  // Recorded purchase payments (from Requests → Record Purchase / direct purchases).
  const purchasePayments = paymentRecords
    .filter((p) => p.kind === 'purchase' && inRange(p.recordedAt))
    .sort((a, b) => b.recordedAt - a.recordedAt)
  const purchaseSpend = purchasePayments.reduce((s, p) => s + p.amount, 0)

  // Unified consumption feed: recipe-based usage (inventoryUsage) AND manual
  // stock decreases (daily counts / consumption entries) both count as consumed.
  const consumption = [
    ...usage.map((u) => ({ name: u.itemName || u.menuItemName, qty: Number(u.quantity) || 0, unit: u.unit, ts: timestampNumber(u.timestamp) })),
    ...conUpdates.map((h) => ({ name: h.itemName, qty: Math.abs(Number(h.difference) || 0), unit: h.unit, ts: timestampNumber(h.timestamp) })),
  ].sort((a, b) => b.ts - a.ts)

  const sumConsumed = r1(consumption.reduce((s, u) => s + u.qty, 0))
  const sumReplenish = r1(replUpdates.reduce((s, h) => s + (Number(h.difference) || 0), 0))
  const sumPurchased = r1(purchases.reduce((s, p) => s + p.requestedQuantity, 0))
  const low = inventory.filter((i) => i.status === 'LOW').length
  const critical = inventory.filter((i) => i.status === 'CRITICAL').length
  const out = inventory.filter((i) => i.status === 'OUT_OF_STOCK').length

  const now = new Date()
  const bucketRange: RangeKey = selectedDate ? 'today' : range
  const bucketNow = selectedDate ? new Date(`${selectedDate}T12:00:00`) : now
  const rawBuckets: { key: string; label: string }[] = []
  if (bucketRange === 'today') {
    for (let h = 0; h < 24; h++) rawBuckets.push({ key: `${dayKey(bucketNow)}-${h}`, label: h === 0 ? '12a' : h < 12 ? `${h}a` : h === 12 ? '12p' : `${h - 12}p` })
  } else if (bucketRange === 'week' || bucketRange === 'month') {
    const last = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() + 1, 0).getDate()
    const start = bucketRange === 'week' ? now.getDate() - 6 : 1
    const end = bucketRange === 'week' ? now.getDate() : last
    for (let dd = start; dd <= end; dd++) {
      const d = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), dd)
      rawBuckets.push({ key: dayKey(d), label: `${d.getDate()}/${d.getMonth() + 1}` })
    }
  } else {
    for (let i = 11; i >= 0; i--) {
      const d = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() - i, 1)
      rawBuckets.push({ key: monKey(d), label: `${MONTHS[d.getMonth()]} '${String(d.getFullYear()).slice(2)}` })
    }
  }
  const buckets = rawBuckets.map((b) => ({
    label: b.label,
    usage: r1(consumption.filter((u) => bucketFor(u.ts, bucketRange) === b.key).reduce((s, u) => s + u.qty, 0)),
    replenish: r1(replUpdates.filter((h) => bucketFor(timestampNumber(h.timestamp), bucketRange) === b.key).reduce((s, h) => s + (Number(h.difference) || 0), 0)),
  }))
  const topMap = new Map<string, { qty: number; unit: string }>()
  for (const u of consumption) {
    const e = topMap.get(u.name) || { qty: 0, unit: u.unit }
    e.qty += u.qty
    e.unit = u.unit
    topMap.set(u.name, e)
  }
  const top = [...topMap.entries()].map(([name, v]) => ({ name, ...v })).sort((a, b) => b.qty - a.qty).slice(0, 8)

  return (
    <div className="space-y-5">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-900">Stock &amp; Usage Analytics</h2>
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-500">Purchases, daily stock updates and consumption across time</p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <div className="flex items-center rounded-xl bg-slate-100 p-1">
            {RANGES.map((r) => (
              <button key={r.id} onClick={() => { setRange(r.id); setSelectedDate(null) }} className={`rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold transition ${range === r.id && !selectedDate ? 'bg-white text-orange-700 shadow-sm' : 'text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-700'}`}>
                {r.label}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
          <input
            type="date"
            value={selectedDate ?? ''}
            onChange={(e) => setSelectedDate(e.target.value || null)}
            className="rounded-lg border border-slate-200 px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-orange-400"
          />
          {selectedDate && (
            <button onClick={() => setSelectedDate(null)} className="rounded-lg bg-slate-100 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-200">
              Clear date
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
      <p className="-mt-3 text-xs text-slate-400">
        {selectedDate ? `Showing data for ${selectedDate} only (hourly view)` : `Showing: ${RANGES.find((r) => r.id === range)?.label ?? 'period'} — pick a date above to focus a single day`}
      </p>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 md:grid-cols-4">
        <BigCard label="Consumed" value={`${sumConsumed}`} sub="units this period" icon={<ClipboardList size={18} />} tone="bg-orange-50 text-orange-600" />
        <BigCard label="Replenished" value={`${sumReplenish}`} sub="units added" icon={<Package size={18} />} tone="bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-600" />
        <BigCard label="Purchased" value={`${sumPurchased}`} sub={`${purchases.length} orders`} icon={<ShoppingCart size={18} />} tone="bg-sky-50 text-sky-600" />
        <BigCard label="Purchase Spend" value={`₹${purchaseSpend.toLocaleString()}`} sub={`${purchasePayments.length} recorded purchase(s)`} icon={<ShoppingCart size={18} />} tone="bg-amber-50 text-amber-600" />
        <BigCard label="Stock Alerts" value={`${low + critical + out}`} sub={`${low} low · ${critical} crit · ${out} out`} icon={<AlertTriangle size={18} />} tone="bg-red-50 text-red-600" />
      </div>
{/* movement chart + top consumed */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 lg:grid-cols-3">
        <div className="rounded-[20px] border border-orange-100 bg-white p-4 lg:col-span-2">
          <h3 className="mb-2 text-sm font-bold text-slate-900">Consumption vs Replenishment</h3>
          <MovementChart data={buckets} />
          <div className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-4 text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-500">
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1"><span className="h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-sm bg-orange-500" /> Consumed</span>
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1"><span className="h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-sm bg-emerald-500" /> Replenished</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="rounded-[20px] border border-orange-100 bg-white p-4">
          <h3 className="mb-2 text-sm font-bold text-slate-900">Top consumed</h3>
          {top.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="text-sm text-slate-400">No usage in this period.</p>
          ) : (
            <div className="space-y-2">
              {top.map((t) => (
                <div key={t.name} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs">
                  <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-slate-700">{t.name}</span>
                  <span className="font-bold text-orange-600">{r1(t.qty)} {t.unit}</span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* current stock health */}
      <div className="rounded-[20px] border border-orange-100 bg-white p-4">
        <h3 className="mb-2 text-sm font-bold text-slate-900">Current stock health</h3>
        {inventory.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-400">No inventory configured.</p>
        ) : (
          <div className="space-y-2">
            {inventory.map((i) => (
              <div key={i.id} className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <span className="w-44 truncate text-sm text-slate-700">{i.name}</span>
                <span className={`rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold ${statusChip(i.status)}`}>{i.status}</span>
                <div className="h-2 flex-1 rounded-full bg-slate-100">
                  <div className="h-2 rounded-full" style={{ width: `${Math.min(100, (i.quantity / Math.max(1, i.minimumThreshold * 2)) * 100)}%`, background: statusColor(i.status) }} />
                </div>
                <span className="w-28 text-right text-xs text-slate-500">{r1(i.quantity)} / {r1(i.minimumThreshold)} {i.unit}</span>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* purchases table */}
      <div className="rounded-[20px] border border-orange-100 bg-white p-4">
        <h3 className="mb-2 text-sm font-bold text-slate-900">Purchases ({purchases.length})</h3>
        {purchases.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-400">No purchases in this period.</p>
        ) : (
          <div className="max-h-64 space-y-1.5 overflow-y-auto">
            {purchases.map((p) => (
              <div key={p.id} className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-x-3 gap-y-0.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-50 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-600">
                <span className="font-semibold text-slate-800">{p.itemName}</span>
                <span>Qty {p.requestedQuantity} {p.unit}</span>
                {p.purchaseTotalCost != null && <span className="font-bold text-amber-600">₹{p.purchaseTotalCost.toLocaleString()}</span>}
                {p.purchaseVendor && <span>{p.purchaseVendor}</span>}
                <span className="rounded-full bg-sky-100 px-2 py-0.5 font-bold text-sky-700">{p.status}</span>
                <span>{new Date(p.createdAt).toLocaleString()}</span>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* recorded purchase payments with full cost details */}
      <div className="rounded-[20px] border border-orange-100 bg-white p-4">
        <h3 className="mb-2 text-sm font-bold text-slate-900">Purchase spend ({purchasePayments.length}) · ₹{purchaseSpend.toLocaleString()}</h3>
        {purchasePayments.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-400">No recorded purchase payments in this period.</p>
        ) : (
          <div className="max-h-64 space-y-1.5 overflow-y-auto">
            {purchasePayments.map((p) => (
              <div key={p.id} className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-x-3 gap-y-0.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-50 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-600">
                <span className="font-semibold text-slate-800">{p.itemName}</span>
                <span>{p.quantity} {p.unit} × ₹{p.unitCost}</span>
                <span className="font-bold text-amber-600">₹{p.amount.toLocaleString()}</span>
                {p.vendor && <span>{p.vendor}</span>}
                <span className="capitalize">{p.paymentMode.replace(/_/g, ' ').toLowerCase()}</span>
                <span>{new Date(p.recordedAt).toLocaleString()}</span>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* daily stock updates */}
      <div className="rounded-[20px] border border-orange-100 bg-white p-4">
        <h3 className="mb-2 text-sm font-bold text-slate-900">Daily stock updates ({stockUpdates.length})</h3>
        {stockUpdates.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-400">No stock updates in this period.</p>
        ) : (
          <div className="max-h-64 space-y-1.5 overflow-y-auto">
            {stockUpdates.slice(0, 60).map((h) => (
              <div key={h.id} className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-x-3 gap-y-0.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-50 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-600">
                <span className="font-semibold text-slate-800">{h.itemName}</span>
                <span>{r1(h.previousQty)} to {r1(h.newQty)} {h.unit}</span>
                <span className="font-bold text-slate-700">{h.difference >= 0 ? '+' : ''}{r1(h.difference)} {h.unit}</span>
                <span className="capitalize">{h.updatedByName || h.updatedBy}</span>
                <span>{new Date(h.timestamp).toLocaleString()}</span>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* usage log */}
      <div className="rounded-[20px] border border-orange-100 bg-white p-4">
        <h3 className="mb-2 text-sm font-bold text-slate-900">Usage log ({consumption.length})</h3>
        {consumption.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-400">Nothing consumed in this period.</p>
        ) : (
          <div className="max-h-64 space-y-1.5 overflow-y-auto">
            {consumption.slice(0, 80).map((u, i) => (
              <div key={i} className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-x-3 gap-y-0.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-50 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-600">
                <span className="font-semibold text-slate-800">{u.name}</span>
                <span className="font-bold text-red-600">-{r1(u.qty)} {u.unit}</span>
                <span>{new Date(u.ts).toLocaleString()}</span>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
function BigCard({ label, value, sub, icon, tone }: { label: string; value: string; sub: string; icon: React.ReactNode; tone: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-[20px] border border-orange-100/70 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <p className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-slate-400">{label}</p>
        <span className={`flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-xl ${tone}`}>{icon}</span>
      </div>
      <p className="mt-2 text-[26px] font-black leading-none text-slate-900">{value}</p>
      <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-slate-400">{sub}</p>
    </div>
  )
}

function MovementChart({ data }: { data: { label: string; usage: number; replenish: number }[] }) {
  const W = 640
  const H = 180
  const pad = 22
  const max = Math.max(1, ...data.map((d) => Math.max(d.usage, d.replenish)))
  const step = data.length > 0 ? (W - pad * 2) / data.length : 1
  const bw = 7
  const gap = 2
  const toY = (v: number) => pad + (H - pad * 2) * (1 - v / max)
  const labelEvery = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(data.length / 10))
  return (
    <svg viewBox={`0 0 ${W} ${H}`} className="h-44 w-full">
      {data.map((d, i) => {
        const cx = pad + i * step + step / 2
        const uY = toY(d.usage)
        const rY = toY(d.replenish)
        return (
          <g key={i}>
            <rect x={cx - bw - gap} y={uY} width={bw} height={Math.max(0, H - pad - uY)} rx={2} fill="#f97316" />
            <rect x={cx} y={rY} width={bw} height={Math.max(0, H - pad - rY)} rx={2} fill="#22c55e" />
            {i % labelEvery === 0 && (
              <text x={cx} y={H - 5} fontSize={9} textAnchor="middle" fill="#94a3b8">
                {d.label}
              </text>
            )}
          </g>
        )
      })}
    </svg>
  )
}
