import { useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import { useRestaurant } from '../context/RestaurantContext'
import type { Table, TableStatus } from '../context/RestaurantContext'
import { Plus, Edit2, Trash2, X, MapPin, CheckCircle2 } from 'lucide-react'
import { TABLE_AREAS, tableArea, groupTablesByArea } from '../lib/tableAreas'
import { applyTableFilters, useTableFilter } from '../lib/tableFilters'
import TableFilterBar from './TableFilterBar'

const FEATURES = ['AC', 'Non-AC', 'Window', 'Corner', 'Family', 'VIP']

export default function AdminTableManagement() {
  const { tables, addTable, updateTable, deactivateTable, activateTable, deleteTable } = useRestaurant()
  const [showForm, setShowForm] = useState(false)
  const [editingTable, setEditingTable] = useState<Table | null>(null)
  const [deleteCandidate, setDeleteCandidate] = useState<Table | null>(null)
  const [deleteError, setDeleteError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [actionError, setActionError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false)
  const [savedAction, setSavedAction] = useState<'added' | 'updated' | null>(null)

 const handleAction = (action: () => void, message: string) => {
  try {
    action()
    setFeedback(message)
    setActionError(null)

    window.setTimeout(() => {
      setFeedback(null)
    }, 2500)
  } catch (err) {
    setActionError(
      err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Action failed'
    )
  }
}

  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    name: '',
    capacity: 4,
    area: 'Indoor',
    features: [] as string[],
    status: 'available' as TableStatus,
  })

  // Shared table filter (area / status / seats / VIP / sort) + free-text search.
  const { filter, updateFilter, resetFilter, search: tableSearch, setSearch: setTableSearch } = useTableFilter()

  // Distinct areas present in the current tables (for the chip row), ordered like TABLE_AREAS.
  const areaOptions: string[] = useMemo(() => {
    const seen = new Set<string>()
    const ordered = TABLE_AREAS.filter((a) => {
      if (tables.some((t) => tableArea(t) === a)) {
        seen.add(a)
        return true
      }
      return false
    })
    const custom = Array.from(new Set(tables.map((t) => tableArea(t))))
      .filter((a) => !TABLE_AREAS.includes(a) && !seen.has(a))
      .sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b))
    return [...ordered, ...custom]
  }, [tables])

  // Table count per area, shown next to each area chip in the filter bar.
  const areaCounts: Record<string, number> = useMemo(() => {
    const counts: Record<string, number> = {}
    tables.forEach((t) => {
      const area = tableArea(t)
      counts[area] = (counts[area] ?? 0) + 1
    })
    return counts
  }, [tables])

  const resetForm = () => {
    setFormData({ name: '', capacity: 4, area: 'Indoor', features: [], status: 'available' })
    setEditingTable(null)
    setShowForm(false)
  }

  // Tables after applying the shared filter (area / status / seats / VIP) + search.
  const filteredTables: Table[] = useMemo(
    () => applyTableFilters(tables, filter, tableSearch),
    [tables, filter, tableSearch],
  )

  const handleEdit = (table: Table) => {
    setEditingTable(table)
    setFormData({
      name: table.name,
      capacity: table.capacity,
      area: table.area ?? 'Indoor',
      features: table.features ?? [],
      status: table.status,
    })
    setShowForm(true)
  }

  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
  e.preventDefault()

  if (saving) return

  setActionError(null)
  setSavedAction(null)
  setSaving(true)

  try {
    if (editingTable) {
      updateTable(editingTable.id, formData)
      setSavedAction('updated')
    } else {
      addTable({
        ...formData,
        status: 'available',
        active: true,
      })
      setSavedAction('added')
    }

    setSaving(false)

    window.setTimeout(() => {
      resetForm()
      setSavedAction(null)
    }, 1000)
  } catch (err) {
    setSaving(false)
    setActionError(
      err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Could not save table'
    )
  }
}

  const toggleFeature = (feature: string) => {
    setFormData((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      features: prev.features.includes(feature)
        ? prev.features.filter((f) => f !== feature)
        : [...prev.features, feature],
    }))
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {feedback && (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 px-4 py-2 text-sm text-emerald-700">{feedback}</div>
      )}
      {(actionError || (deleteError && !deleteCandidate)) && (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-4 py-2 text-sm text-red-700">{actionError ?? deleteError}</div>
      )}

      {/* Header Container - Responsive Flex Column to Row */}
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-900">Table Management</h2>
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-500">Tables are grouped area-wise — Indoor, Garden, Terrace and so on.</p>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={() => setShowForm(true)}
          className="flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap rounded-xl bg-orange-500 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-orange-600"
        >
          <Plus size={16} />
          <span>Add Table</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {showForm && (
        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-orange-200 bg-orange-50 p-5">
          <div className="mb-4 flex items-center justify-between">
            <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900">
              {editingTable ? 'Edit Table' : 'Add New Table'}
            </h3>
            <button onClick={resetForm} className="text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-700">
              <X size={20} />
            </button>
          </div>
          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
              <div>
                <label className="mb-1 block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700">Table Name</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={formData.name}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, name: e.target.value })}
                  placeholder="e.g., T-01"
                  required
                  className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-orange-400"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="mb-1 block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700">Capacity</label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  value={formData.capacity}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, capacity: parseInt(e.target.value) || 1 })}
                  min="1"
                  required
                  className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-orange-400"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="mb-1 block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700">Area</label>
                <select
                  value={formData.area}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, area: e.target.value })}
                  className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-orange-400"
                >
                  {TABLE_AREAS.map((area) => (
                    <option key={area} value={area}>{area}</option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>
              {editingTable && (
                <div>
                  <label className="mb-1 block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700">Status</label>
                  <select
                    value={formData.status}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, status: e.target.value as TableStatus })}
                    className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-orange-400"
                  >
                    <option value="available">Available</option>
                    <option value="reserved">Reserved</option>
                    <option value="cleaning">Cleaning</option>
                    <option value="maintenance">Maintenance</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="mb-2 block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700">Features</label>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                {FEATURES.map((feature) => (
                  <button
                    key={feature}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => toggleFeature(feature)}
                    className={`rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold transition ${
                      formData.features.includes(feature)
                        ? 'bg-orange-500 text-white'
                        : 'bg-white text-slate-600 border border-slate-200 hover:border-orange-300'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {feature}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <button
  type="submit"
  disabled={saving || savedAction !== null}
  className={`flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-4 py-2 text-sm font-bold text-white transition ${
    savedAction
      ? 'bg-emerald-500'
      : 'bg-orange-500 hover:bg-orange-600'
  } disabled:cursor-not-allowed`}
>
  {saving ? (
    'Saving…'
  ) : savedAction ? (
    <>
      <CheckCircle2 size={16} />
      {savedAction === 'added' ? 'Added' : 'Updated'}
    </>
  ) : (
    <>
      {editingTable ? <Edit2 size={16} /> : <Plus size={16} />}
      {editingTable ? 'Update Table' : 'Add Table'}
    </>
  )}
</button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={resetForm}
                className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-600 transition hover:bg-slate-50"
              >
                Cancel
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Shared filter + sort control */}
      <TableFilterBar
        filter={filter}
        updateFilter={updateFilter}
        resetFilter={resetFilter}
        search={tableSearch}
        setSearch={setTableSearch}
        areaOptions={areaOptions}
        areaCounts={areaCounts}
        matched={filteredTables.length}
        total={tables.length}
      />

      {filteredTables.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="rounded-[20px] border border-dashed border-slate-300 bg-white p-8 text-center">
          {tables.length === 0 ? (
            <>
              <p className="text-slate-500">No tables configured yet.</p>
              <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-400">Click "Add Table" to get started.</p>
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <p className="text-slate-500">No tables match your filter.</p>
              <button
                onClick={resetFilter}
                className="mt-2 rounded-lg bg-orange-100 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-orange-700 hover:bg-orange-200"
              >
                Clear filters
              </button>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-6">
          {groupTablesByArea(filteredTables).map(({ area, tables: areaTables }) => (
            <section key={area} className="space-y-3">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <MapPin size={16} className="shrink-0 text-orange-500" />
                <h3 className="text-sm font-black uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-500">{area}</h3>
                <span className="rounded-full bg-slate-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-500">
                  {areaTables.length} table{areaTables.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}
                </span>
                <span className="rounded-full bg-emerald-50 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-emerald-700">
                  {areaTables.filter((t) => t.active !== false && t.status === 'available').length} available
                </span>
                <div className="h-px flex-1 bg-slate-200" />
              </div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3">
                {areaTables.map((table) => (
                  <div key={table.id} className="rounded-[20px] border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm">
                    <div className="mb-3 flex items-start justify-between">
                      <div>
                        <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900">{table.name}</h3>
                        <p className="text-sm text-slate-500">{table.area || 'No area assigned'}</p>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex flex-col items-end gap-1">
                        <span
                          className={`rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold ${
                            table.active === false
                              ? 'bg-slate-200 text-slate-700'
                              : table.status === 'available'
                                ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700'
                                : table.status === 'occupied'
                                  ? 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-700'
                                  : table.status === 'reserved'
                                    ? 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700'
                                    : table.status === 'cleaning'
                                      ? 'bg-violet-100 text-violet-700'
                                      : 'bg-slate-200 text-slate-700'
                          }`}
                        >
                          {table.active === false ? 'Deactivated' : table.status}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <p className="mb-2 text-sm text-slate-600">Capacity: {table.capacity} guests</p>
                    {(table.features ?? []).length > 0 && (
                      <div className="mb-3 flex flex-wrap gap-1">
                        {(table.features ?? []).map((feature) => (
                          <span key={feature} className="rounded-full bg-slate-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold text-slate-600">
                            {feature}
                          </span>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    )}
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                      <button
                        onClick={() => handleEdit(table)}
                        className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 transition hover:bg-slate-200"
                      >
                        <Edit2 size={12} />
                        Edit
                      </button>
                      {table.active === false ? (
                        <button
                          onClick={() => handleAction(() => activateTable(table.id), `Table ${table.name} activated.`)}
                          className="rounded-lg bg-emerald-50 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-600 transition hover:bg-emerald-100"
                        >
                          Activate
                        </button>
                      ) : (
                        <button
                          onClick={() => handleAction(() => deactivateTable(table.id), `Table ${table.name} deactivated.`)}
                          className="rounded-lg bg-amber-50 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-amber-600 transition hover:bg-amber-100"
                        >
                          Deactivate
                        </button>
                      )}
                      <button
                        onClick={() => setDeleteCandidate(table)}
                        className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg bg-red-50 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-red-600 transition hover:bg-red-100"
                      >
                        <Trash2 size={12} />
                        Delete
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </section>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {deleteCandidate && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-start justify-center overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain bg-slate-900/40 p-4 py-6 sm:items-center bh-modal-overlay">
          <div className="w-full max-w-sm rounded-[20px] bg-white p-5 shadow-xl">
            <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900">Delete Table {deleteCandidate.name}?</h3>
            <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-slate-600">
              If this table has no historical records it will be permanently deleted.
              If it has past sessions, orders, or bills it must be deactivated instead — historical data is never destroyed.
            </p>
            {deleteError && <p className="mt-3 rounded-xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-red-700">{deleteError}</p>}
            <div className="mt-4 flex gap-2">
              <button
                onClick={() => handleAction(() => { deleteTable(deleteCandidate.id); setDeleteCandidate(null) }, `Table ${deleteCandidate.name} deleted.`)}
                className="rounded-xl bg-red-500 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-red-600"
              >
                Delete
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={() => { setDeleteCandidate(null); setDeleteError(null) }}
                className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-600 transition hover:bg-slate-50"
              >
                Cancel
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

import { useState } from 'react'
import { useRestaurant } from '../context/RestaurantContext'
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext'
import { Ticket, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, Eye } from 'lucide-react'
import { formatOrderToken } from '../lib/tokenSequence'
import { servingSuffix } from '../lib/servingType'
import { toBusinessDayStr, isSameBusinessDay } from '../lib/businessDay'

const toDateStr = (d: Date) => toBusinessDayStr(d.getTime())
const sameDay = (ts: number, dateStr: string) => isSameBusinessDay(ts, dateStr)

export default function AdminTokensView() {
  const { orders, tables } = useRestaurant()
  const { users } = useAuth()
  const [selectedDate, setSelectedDate] = useState(toDateStr(new Date()))
  const [expandedToken, setExpandedToken] = useState<string | null>(null)

  const tokens = orders.filter((o) => o.tokenNumber && sameDay(o.confirmedAt || o.createdAt, selectedDate))
    .sort((a, b) => (b.tokenNumber || 0) - (a.tokenNumber || 0))

  const goToDay = (offset: number) => {
    const d = new Date(selectedDate)
    d.setDate(d.getDate() + offset)
    setSelectedDate(toDateStr(d))
  }

  const waiterName = (id: string) => users.find((u) => u.id === id)?.name ?? id.slice(0, 8)

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-900">Token History</h2>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <button onClick={() => goToDay(-1)} className="rounded-lg bg-slate-100 p-2 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-200"><ChevronLeft size={16} /></button>
          <input type="date" value={selectedDate} onChange={(e) => setSelectedDate(e.target.value)} className="rounded-lg border border-slate-200 px-3 py-1.5 text-sm" />
          <button onClick={() => goToDay(1)} className="rounded-lg bg-slate-100 p-2 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-200"><ChevronRight size={16} /></button>
          <button onClick={() => setSelectedDate(toDateStr(new Date()))} className="rounded-lg bg-orange-100 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-orange-700">Today</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {tokens.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="rounded-[20px] border border-dashed border-slate-300 bg-white p-8 text-center">
          <Ticket className="mx-auto mb-2 text-slate-300" size={32} />
          <p className="text-slate-500">No tokens generated on {selectedDate}.</p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-3">
          {tokens.map((order) => {
            const table = tables.find((t) => t.id === order.tableId)
            const isExpanded = expandedToken === order.id
            return (
              <div key={order.id} className="rounded-[20px] border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <div className="flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-orange-100">
                      <Ticket size={18} className="text-orange-600" />
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      {/* Parcel tokens use their own series label: Parcel P-001 vs Token #001 */}
                      <p className="font-bold text-slate-900">{order.orderType === 'parcel' ? 'Parcel' : 'Token'} {formatOrderToken(order)}</p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                        {new Date(order.confirmedAt || order.createdAt).toLocaleTimeString()} • {table?.name ?? 'Unknown'} • {waiterName(order.waiterId)}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    {order.isVip && <span className="rounded-full bg-amber-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-amber-700">VIP</span>}
                    <span className={`rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold ${order.status === 'served' ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700' : order.status === 'ready' ? 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700' : order.status === 'preparing' ? 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700' : 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-700'}`}>
                      {order.status}
                    </span>
                    <button onClick={() => setExpandedToken(isExpanded ? null : order.id)} className="rounded-lg bg-slate-100 p-1.5 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-200">
                      <Eye size={14} />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
                {isExpanded && (
                  <div className="mt-3 space-y-2 border-t pt-3">
                    <div className="text-xs text-slate-600">
                      <span className="font-semibold">Items:</span>{' '}
                      {order.items.map((i) => `${i.nameSnapshot}${servingSuffix(i.servingType)} x${i.quantity}`).join(', ')}
                    </div>
                    {order.items.some((i) => i.specialRequests) && (
                      <div className="rounded-lg bg-amber-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-amber-800">
                        <span className="font-semibold">Special Instructions:</span>{' '}
                        {order.items.filter((i) => i.specialRequests).map((i) => i.specialRequests).join('; ')}
                      </div>
                    )}
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-xs text-slate-500">
                      <div>Session: {order.sessionId.slice(-8)}</div>
                      <div>Order ID: {order.id.slice(-8)}</div>
                      <div>Prep Time: {order.estimatedPreparationMinutes ?? '—'} min</div>
                      <div>Ready: {order.readyAt ? new Date(order.readyAt).toLocaleTimeString() : '—'}</div>
                      <div>Served: {order.servedAt ? new Date(order.servedAt).toLocaleTimeString() : '—'}</div>
                      <div>Confirmed: {order.confirmedAt ? new Date(order.confirmedAt).toLocaleTimeString() : '—'}</div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            )
          })}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}


============================================================
FILE: src\components\AdminWaiterAnalytics.tsx
============================================================

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import type { ReactNode } from 'react'
import { Users } from 'lucide-react'
import { useRestaurant } from '../context/RestaurantContext'
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext'
import { loadCollection, saveDoc } from '../services/firebase/dataService'
import { dataMode, isFirebaseConfigured } from '../services/firebase/config'
import { toBusinessDayStr, isSameBusinessDay } from '../lib/businessDay'

const toDateStr = (d: Date) => toBusinessDayStr(d.getTime())
const sameDay = (ts: number, dateStr: string) => isSameBusinessDay(ts, dateStr)
const monthOf = (dateStr: string) => dateStr.slice(0, 7)

// DateRange mirrors the shape passed from AdminAnalyticsView.
type DateRange = { start: number; end: number; label: string }

export type WaiterDayStat = {
  waiterId: string
  name: string
  orders: number
  completed: number
  cancelled: number
  itemsSold: number
  revenue: number
  dineIn: number
  parcel: number
  guests: number
}

type WaiterDailySnapshot = {
  id: string
  date: string
  generatedAt: number
  waiters: WaiterDayStat[]
}

const EMPTY_STAT: Omit<WaiterDayStat, 'waiterId' | 'name'> = {
  orders: 0, completed: 0, cancelled: 0, itemsSold: 0, revenue: 0, dineIn: 0, parcel: 0, guests: 0,
}

/** Compute per-waiter stats for all orders whose createdAt falls on `dateStr`. */
const computeWaiterStats = (
  orders: ReturnType<typeof useRestaurant>['orders'],
  sessions: ReturnType<typeof useRestaurant>['sessions'],
  dateStr: string,
  nameOf: (id: string) => string,
): WaiterDayStat[] => {
  const map = new Map<string, WaiterDayStat>()
  orders
    .filter((o) => sameDay(o.createdAt, dateStr) && o.waiterId)
    .forEach((o) => {
      if (!map.has(o.waiterId)) {
        map.set(o.waiterId, { waiterId: o.waiterId, name: nameOf(o.waiterId), ...EMPTY_STAT })
      }
      const s = map.get(o.waiterId)!
      s.orders += 1
      if (o.status === 'cancelled') s.cancelled += 1
      else {
        if (o.status === 'served') s.completed += 1
        s.itemsSold += o.items.reduce((n, i) => n + i.quantity, 0)
        s.revenue += o.totalAmount || 0
        if (o.orderType === 'parcel') s.parcel += 1
        else s.dineIn += 1
      }
    })
  // Guest counts from sessions opened that day, attributed to the session waiter.
  sessions
    .filter((sess) => sameDay(sess.startTime, dateStr) && sess.waiterId)
    .forEach((sess) => {
      if (!map.has(sess.waiterId)) {
        map.set(sess.waiterId, { waiterId: sess.waiterId, name: nameOf(sess.waiterId), ...EMPTY_STAT })
      }
      map.get(sess.waiterId)!.guests += sess.guestCount || 0
    })
  return [...map.values()].sort((a, b) => b.orders - a.orders || b.revenue - a.revenue)
}

const readLocalSnapshots = (): WaiterDailySnapshot[] => {
  if (dataMode !== 'mock') return []
  try {
    return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('beeshive_analytics_waiterDaily') || '[]') as WaiterDailySnapshot[]
  } catch {
    return []
  }
}

const writeLocalSnapshots = (snapshots: WaiterDailySnapshot[]) => {
  if (dataMode !== 'mock') return
  try {
    localStorage.setItem('beeshive_analytics_waiterDaily', JSON.stringify(snapshots.slice(-400)))
  } catch { /* storage full — non-critical */ }
}

/** One labelled metric inside a mobile waiter card. `wide` spans both columns
 *  (used for Revenue so a long ₹ value can never overflow the card). */
function WaiterCardMetric({ label, value, tone, wide = false }: {
  label: string
  value: ReactNode
  tone: string
  wide?: boolean
}) {
  return (
    <div className={`min-w-0 rounded-lg bg-slate-50 px-2 py-1.5 ${wide ? 'col-span-2' : ''}`}>
      <p className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-400">{label}</p>
      <p className={`mt-0.5 text-sm font-bold ${tone} ${wide ? 'wrap-break-word' : ''}`}>{value}</p>
    </div>
  )
}

/** Mobile (<768px) waiter cards. The 10-column table is unusable at 320–414px,
 *  so below md each waiter is rendered as a compact card with the same metrics. */
function MobileWaiterCards({ stats }: { stats: WaiterDayStat[] }) {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-2.5 md:hidden">
      {stats.map((s) => (
        <div key={s.waiterId} className="rounded-xl border border-orange-100 bg-white p-3 shadow-sm">
          <div className="flex min-w-0 items-start gap-2">
            <span className="flex h-7 w-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-orange-50 text-[11px] font-bold text-orange-600">
              {(s.name || '').trim().charAt(0).toUpperCase() || '?'}
            </span>
            <p className="min-w-0 flex-1 wrap-break-word text-sm font-bold leading-snug text-slate-800">{s.name || 'Unnamed waiter'}</p>
          </div>
          <div className="mt-2.5 grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
            <WaiterCardMetric label="Orders" value={s.orders} tone="text-amber-600" />
            <WaiterCardMetric label="Completed" value={s.completed} tone="text-emerald-600" />
            <WaiterCardMetric label="Cancelled" value={s.cancelled} tone="text-red-500" />
            <WaiterCardMetric label="Items Sold" value={s.itemsSold} tone="text-slate-600" />
            <WaiterCardMetric
              label="Revenue"
              value={`₹${s.revenue.toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}`}
              tone="text-slate-800"
              wide
            />
            <WaiterCardMetric
              label="Avg/Order"
              value={s.completed > 0 ? `₹${(s.revenue / s.completed).toFixed(0)}` : '-'}
              tone="text-slate-500"
            />
            <WaiterCardMetric label="Dine-in" value={s.dineIn} tone="text-slate-500" />
            <WaiterCardMetric label="Parcel" value={s.parcel} tone="text-slate-500" />
            <WaiterCardMetric label="Guests" value={s.guests} tone="text-slate-500" />
          </div>
        </div>
      ))}
      {stats.length === 0 && (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-dashed border-slate-200 bg-white py-6 text-center text-xs text-slate-400">
          No waiter activity for this period yet.
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

export default function AdminWaiterAnalytics({ dateRange, period }: { dateRange: DateRange; period: string }) {
  const { orders, sessions } = useRestaurant()
  const { users } = useAuth()
  // The global period selector drives what "view" we show.
  const view: 'day' | 'month' | 'all' = period === 'custom' ? 'day' : period === 'month' ? 'month' : 'all'
  const [dayDate, setDayDate] = useState(toDateStr(new Date(dateRange.start)).slice(0, 10))
  const [month, setMonth] = useState(monthOf(toDateStr(new Date(dateRange.start)).slice(0, 10)))
  const [snapshots, setSnapshots] = useState<WaiterDailySnapshot[]>(readLocalSnapshots)
  const saveTimer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null)

  const nameOf = useCallback((id: string) => users.find((u) => u.id === id)?.name ?? `Waiter ${id.slice(0, 6)}`, [users])

  // Keep dayDate/month in sync with the global date range.
  useEffect(() => {
    const s = toDateStr(new Date(dateRange.start)).slice(0, 10)
    setDayDate(s)
    setMonth(monthOf(s))
  }, [dateRange.start])

  // Day stats — always computed live from current order data.
  const dayStats = useMemo(
    () => computeWaiterStats(orders, sessions, dayDate, nameOf),
    [orders, sessions, dayDate, nameOf],
  )

  // Load archived snapshots from Firestore on mount (offline-safe fallback: localStorage).
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isFirebaseConfigured()) return
    let alive = true
    loadCollection<WaiterDailySnapshot>('analytics').then((docs) => {
      if (!alive) return
      const merged = [...readLocalSnapshots()]
      docs.forEach((d) => {
        const i = merged.findIndex((m) => m.date === d.date)
        if (i >= 0) merged[i] = d
        else merged.push(d)
      })
      merged.sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date))
      setSnapshots(merged)
      writeLocalSnapshots(merged)
    }).catch((err) => { if (import.meta.env.DEV) console.error('analytics load failed:', err) })
    return () => { alive = false }
  }, [])

  // Persist the selected day's snapshot to the database (debounced).
  useEffect(() => {
    if (dayStats.length === 0) return
    const snapshot: WaiterDailySnapshot = {
      id: `waiterDaily_${dayDate}`,
      date: dayDate,
      generatedAt: Date.now(),
      waiters: dayStats,
    }
    if (saveTimer.current) clearTimeout(saveTimer.current)
    saveTimer.current = setTimeout(() => {
      setSnapshots((prev) => {
        const next = [...prev.filter((s) => s.date !== dayDate), snapshot].sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date))
        writeLocalSnapshots(next)
        return next
      })
      void saveDoc('analytics', snapshot.id, snapshot).catch((err) => {
        if (import.meta.env.DEV) console.error('analytics save failed:', err)
      })
    }, 1200)
    return () => { if (saveTimer.current) clearTimeout(saveTimer.current) }
  }, [dayStats, dayDate])

  // Aggregation helper: sum archived snapshots for a period, falling back to
  // archived numbers only for days whose orders no longer exist live.
  const aggregate = useCallback((periodFilter: (date: string) => boolean) => {
    const map = new Map<string, WaiterDayStat>()
    const add = (s: WaiterDayStat) => {
      if (!map.has(s.waiterId)) map.set(s.waiterId, { waiterId: s.waiterId, name: s.name, ...EMPTY_STAT })
      const t = map.get(s.waiterId)!
      t.orders += s.orders; t.completed += s.completed; t.cancelled += s.cancelled
      t.itemsSold += s.itemsSold; t.revenue += s.revenue
      t.dineIn += s.dineIn; t.parcel += s.parcel; t.guests += s.guests
      if (s.name && s.name !== t.name) t.name = s.name
    }
    const liveDays = new Set(orders.map((o) => toDateStr(new Date(o.createdAt))).filter(periodFilter))
    const archived = new Map(snapshots.filter((s) => periodFilter(s.date)).map((s) => [s.date, s]))
    const days = new Set<string>([...liveDays, ...archived.keys()])
    days.forEach((d) => {
      const live = computeWaiterStats(orders, sessions, d, nameOf)
      const source = live.length > 0 ? live : (archived.get(d)?.waiters ?? [])
      source.forEach(add)
    })
    return [...map.values()].sort((a, b) => b.orders - a.orders || b.revenue - a.revenue)
  }, [nameOf, orders, sessions, snapshots])

  // Month stats: sum of every day in the selected month.
  const monthStats = useMemo(
    () => aggregate((d) => d.startsWith(month)),
    [aggregate, month],
  )

  // Per-day order counts per waiter for the month grid.
  const monthGrid = useMemo(() => {
    const daysInMonth = new Date(Number(month.slice(0, 4)), Number(month.slice(5, 7)), 0).getDate()
    const grid = new Map<string, number[]>() // waiterId -> [count per day 1..N]
    const ensure = (id: string) => {
      if (!grid.has(id)) grid.set(id, new Array(daysInMonth).fill(0))
      return grid.get(id)!
    }
    for (let d = 1; d <= daysInMonth; d++) {
      const dateStr = `${month}-${String(d).padStart(2, '0')}`
      computeWaiterStats(orders, sessions, dateStr, nameOf).forEach((s) => {
        if (s.orders > 0) ensure(s.waiterId)[d - 1] = s.orders
      })
    }
    return {
      daysInMonth,
      rows: [...grid.entries()]
        .map(([id, counts]) => ({ id, name: nameOf(id), counts, total: counts.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) }))
        .sort((a, b) => b.total - a.total),
    }
  }, [orders, sessions, month, nameOf])

  // For week/year (view === 'all') we filter to the selected date range,
  // not truly all-time. Re-aggregate with a date-range filter.
  const statsForView = (() => {
    if (view === 'day') return dayStats
    if (view === 'month') return monthStats
    const filtered = aggregate((d) => {
      const p = d.split('-').map(Number)
      const ts = Date.UTC(p[0], p[1] - 1, p[2])
      return ts >= dateRange.start && ts <= dateRange.end
    })
    return filtered
  })()

  return (
    <div className="rounded-[20px] border border-orange-100 bg-white p-4">
      <div className="mb-3 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <p className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-bold text-slate-700"><Users size={16} className="text-orange-500" /> Waiter Performance</p>
        <div className="flex sm:w-auto justify-end">
          <span className="rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 px-2 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
            {dateRange.label}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <p className="mb-2 text-xs text-slate-400">{dateRange.label} — waiter performance</p>

      {/* Full 10-column table — kept for md and up (unchanged desktop layout). */}
      <div className="hidden overflow-x-auto md:block">
        <table className="w-full text-sm">
          <thead>
            <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-500">
              <th className="py-2 text-left">Waiter</th>
              <th className="py-2 text-right">Orders</th>
              <th className="py-2 text-right">Completed</th>
              <th className="py-2 text-right">Cancelled</th>
              <th className="py-2 text-right">Items Sold</th>
              <th className="py-2 text-right">Revenue</th>
              <th className="py-2 text-right">Avg/Order</th>
              <th className="py-2 text-right">Dine-in</th>
              <th className="py-2 text-right">Parcel</th>
              <th className="py-2 text-right pr-2">Guests</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {statsForView.map((s) => (
              <tr key={s.waiterId} className="border-b border-slate-100 last:border-0">
                <td className="py-2 font-semibold text-slate-800">{s.name}</td>
                <td className="py-2 text-right font-bold text-amber-600">{s.orders}</td>
                <td className="py-2 text-right text-emerald-600">{s.completed}</td>
                <td className="py-2 text-right text-red-500">{s.cancelled}</td>
                <td className="py-2 text-right text-slate-600">{s.itemsSold}</td>
                <td className="py-2 text-right font-semibold text-slate-800">₹{s.revenue.toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}</td>
                <td className="py-2 text-right text-slate-500">{s.completed > 0 ? `₹${(s.revenue / s.completed).toFixed(0)}` : '-'}</td>
                <td className="py-2 text-right text-slate-500">{s.dineIn}</td>
                <td className="py-2 text-right text-slate-500">{s.parcel}</td>
                <td className="py-2 text-right pr-2 text-slate-500">{s.guests}</td>
              </tr>
            ))}
            {statsForView.length === 0 && (
              <tr><td colSpan={10} className="py-4 text-center text-slate-400">No waiter activity for this period yet.</td></tr>
            )}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>

      {/* Below md the same statsForView rows render as per-waiter cards. */}
      <MobileWaiterCards stats={statsForView} />

      {period === 'month' && monthGrid.rows.length > 0 && (
        <div className="mt-4">
          <p className="mb-2 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-500">Orders per Day — {month}</p>
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="text-xs">
              <thead>
                <tr>
                  <th className="sticky left-0 bg-white py-1 pr-2 text-left text-slate-500">Waiter</th>
                  {Array.from({ length: monthGrid.daysInMonth }, (_, i) => (
                    <th key={i} className="w-7 py-1 text-center text-slate-400">{i + 1}</th>
                  ))}
                  <th className="py-1 pl-2 text-center text-slate-600">Total</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {monthGrid.rows.map((r) => (
                  <tr key={r.id}>
                    <td className="sticky left-0 bg-white py-1 pr-2 font-semibold text-slate-700">{r.name}</td>
                    {r.counts.map((c, i) => (
                      <td key={i} className={`py-1 text-center font-semibold ${c > 0 ? 'text-amber-600' : 'text-slate-200'}`}>{c > 0 ? c : '·'}</td>
                    ))}
                    <td className="py-1 pl-2 text-center font-bold text-slate-800">{r.total}</td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

import type { UserRole } from '../context/AuthContext'

interface AvatarProps {
  name: string
  src?: string | null
  role?: UserRole | string
  /** Tailwind size classes, e.g. "h-9 w-9 text-sm" — defaults to h-10 w-10 text-base */
  className?: string
  title?: string
}

const roleFallback: Record<string, string> = {
  admin: 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-700',
  waiter: 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700',
  supervisor: 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700',
}

/**
 * User avatar that shows the uploaded photo when available and otherwise
 * falls back to the first initial of the name in a role-coloured circle.
 */
export default function Avatar({ name, src, role, className, title }: AvatarProps) {
  const sizeClass = className ?? 'h-10 w-10 text-base'
  const fallbackClass = roleFallback[role ?? ''] ?? 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600'

  if (src) {
    return (
      <img
        src={src}
        alt={title ?? name}
        title={title ?? name}
        className={`${sizeClass} shrink-0 rounded-full border border-white object-cover shadow-sm`}
      />
    )
  }

  return (
    <div
      title={title ?? name}
      className={`${sizeClass} flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full font-bold ${fallbackClass}`}
    >
      {name.charAt(0).toUpperCase() || '?'}
    </div>
  )
}

FILE: src\components\AvatarUpload.tsx

import { useRef, useState, useCallback, useEffect } from 'react'
import { Camera, X } from 'lucide-react'
import { dataMode } from '../services/firebase/config'
import { uploadMemberImage } from '../services/firebase/storageService'

interface AvatarUploadProps {
  currentImageUrl?: string
  onImageSelected: (file: File, previewUrl: string) => void
  onImageRemoved?: () => void
  label?: string
  userId?: string
}

const ALLOWED_TYPES = ['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp']
const MAX_FILE_SIZE = 5 * 1024 * 1024 // 5MB

/** Circular profile-photo picker. Produces a data-URL preview (stored with the account). */
export default function AvatarUpload({
  currentImageUrl,
  onImageSelected,
  onImageRemoved,
  label = 'Profile Photo',
  userId,
}: AvatarUploadProps) {
  const [preview, setPreview] = useState<string | null>(currentImageUrl || null)
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    setPreview(currentImageUrl || null)
  }, [currentImageUrl])

  const processFile = useCallback(
    (file: File) => {
      setError(null)
      if (!ALLOWED_TYPES.includes(file.type)) {
        setError('Only JPEG, PNG, and WEBP images are allowed.')
        return
      }
      if (file.size > MAX_FILE_SIZE) {
        setError('Image must be smaller than 5MB.')
        return
      }
      const reader = new FileReader()
      reader.onload = async (event) => {
        const result = event.target?.result as string
        setPreview(result)
        if (dataMode === 'firebase') {
          if (!userId) {
            onImageSelected(file, result)
            return
          }
          try {
            const uploaded = await uploadMemberImage(file, userId)
            setPreview(uploaded.imageUrl)
            onImageSelected(file, uploaded.imageUrl)
          } catch (err) {
            setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to upload profile photo to Firebase Storage.')
          }
          return
        }
        onImageSelected(file, result)
      }
      reader.onerror = () => setError('Failed to read the image file.')
      reader.readAsDataURL(file)
    },
    [onImageSelected, userId]
  )

  const handleFileChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0]
    if (file) processFile(file)
    if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = ''
  }

  const handleRemove = () => {
    setPreview(null)
    setError(null)
    onImageRemoved?.()
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <label className="mb-1 block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700">{label}</label>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
          title="Upload photo"
          className="group relative flex h-20 w-20 shrink-0 items-center justify-center overflow-hidden rounded-full border-2 border-dashed border-slate-300 bg-slate-50 transition hover:border-orange-400 hover:bg-orange-50"
        >
          {preview ? (
            <>
              <img src={preview} alt="Avatar preview" className="h-full w-full object-cover" />
              <span className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/40 opacity-0 transition group-hover:opacity-100">
                <Camera size={18} className="text-white" />
              </span>
            </>
          ) : (
            <Camera size={20} className="text-slate-400 transition group-hover:text-orange-500" />
          )}
        </button>

        <div className="space-y-1.5">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
            className="rounded-lg bg-slate-100 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 transition hover:bg-orange-100 hover:text-orange-700"
          >
            {preview ? 'Replace Photo' : 'Upload Photo'}
          </button>
          {preview && onImageRemoved && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleRemove}
              className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-red-500 transition hover:bg-red-50"
            >
              <X size={12} /> Remove
            </button>
          )}
          <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">JPEG, PNG, WEBP • Max 5MB</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <input
        ref={fileInputRef}
        type="file"
        accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp"
        onChange={handleFileChange}
        className="hidden"
      />

      {error && <div className="mt-1.5 rounded-lg bg-red-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-red-700">{error}</div>}
    </div>
  )
}

FILE: src\components\ErrorBoundary.tsx

import { Component, type ReactNode } from 'react'

interface ErrorBoundaryProps {
  /** Area name rendered in the fallback panel (e.g. "Tables", "Waiter Panel"). */
  label: string
  /**
   * Changing this value clears the captured error. Pass the active tab id so
   * switching menus always renders the next panel instead of a stale failure.
   */
  resetKey?: string | number
  children: ReactNode
}

interface ErrorBoundaryState {
  error: Error | null
}

/**
 * Render-error containment.
 *
 * Without a boundary, any runtime error inside a page/portal unmounts the whole
 * React tree and the user is left staring at a blank white screen (the reported
 * "clicking Tables or any other menu makes the app go blank" bug). This keeps
 * the failure inside the affected content area and always renders an actionable
 * panel with a retry / reload escape hatch.
 */
export default class ErrorBoundary extends Component<ErrorBoundaryProps, ErrorBoundaryState> {
  state: ErrorBoundaryState = { error: null }

  static getDerivedStateFromError(error: Error): ErrorBoundaryState {
    return { error }
  }

  componentDidCatch(error: Error) {
    if (import.meta.env.DEV) console.error(`[ErrorBoundary] "${this.props.label}" crashed:`, error)
  }

  componentDidUpdate(prev: ErrorBoundaryProps) {
    if (prev.resetKey !== this.props.resetKey && this.state.error) {
      this.setState({ error: null })
    }
  }

  render() {
    if (this.state.error) {
      return (
        <div className="box-border w-full max-w-full wrap-break-word rounded-2xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-4 sm:p-6">
          <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-red-700 sm:text-lg">
            Something went wrong in “{this.props.label}”
          </h2>
          <p className="mt-2 break-all font-mono text-xs text-red-600">
            {this.state.error.message}
          </p>
          <p className="mt-3 text-sm text-red-600">
            The rest of the app keeps working. Try this section again, or reload the page.
          </p>
          <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            <button
              onClick={() => this.setState({ error: null })}
              className="rounded-lg bg-red-500 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-bold text-white hover:bg-red-600"
            >
              Try again
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => window.location.reload()}
              className="rounded-lg border border-red-300 bg-white px-4 py-2 text-sm font-bold text-red-600 hover:bg-red-50"
            >
              Reload page
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )
    }
    return this.props.children
  }
}

import { resolveFoodType, foodTypeLabel, type FoodTypeCarrier } from '../lib/menuFilters'

/**
 * Veg / Non-Veg marker used on every menu surface, following the standard
 * Indian restaurant convention: a green square with a green dot for Veg and a
 * red square with a red triangle for Non-Veg. Unclassified (legacy) dishes
 * render a neutral "?" so staff can see the dish still needs classifying
 * instead of it silently looking vegetarian.
 */
export function FoodTypeDot({ className = '' }: { className?: string }) {
  return <span className={`inline-block h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 rounded-[3px] border-[1.5px] border-emerald-600 p-0.5 ${className}`} aria-hidden="true"><span className="block h-full w-full rounded-full bg-emerald-600" /></span>
}

interface FoodTypeMarkProps extends FoodTypeCarrier {
  /** Tile/list text size. */
  size?: 'sm' | 'md'
  /** Show the "Veg" / "Non-Veg" word next to the symbol. */
  withLabel?: boolean
}

/**
 * Compact Veg / Non-Veg marker for dish rows and tiles.
 * `title` carries the full label so hovering explains the symbol.
 */
export default function FoodTypeMark({ foodType, isVeg, size = 'md', withLabel = false }: FoodTypeMarkProps) {
  const type = resolveFoodType({ foodType, isVeg })
  const label = foodTypeLabel(type)
  const box = size === 'sm' ? 'h-3 w-3' : 'h-3.5 w-3.5'

  if (type === null) {
    return (
      <span
        title={`Food type: ${label}`}
        className={`inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-[3px] border-[1.5px] border-slate-400 ${box} text-[8px] font-black leading-none text-slate-400`}
      >
        ?
      </span>
    )
  }

  const veg = type === 'veg'
  const color = veg ? 'border-emerald-600' : 'border-rose-600'

  return (
    <span className="inline-flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1" title={`Food type: ${label}`}>
      <span className={`inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-[3px] border-[1.5px] p-0.5 ${box} ${color}`}>
        {veg
          ? <span className="block h-full w-full rounded-full bg-emerald-600" />
          : (
            <svg viewBox="0 0 10 10" className="h-full w-full fill-rose-600" aria-hidden="true">
              <polygon points="5,0.5 9.5,9.5 0.5,9.5" />
            </svg>
          )}
      </span>
      {withLabel && <span className={`text-[11px] font-bold ${veg ? 'text-emerald-700' : 'text-rose-700'}`}>{label}</span>}
    </span>
  )
}

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'

import { useSidebar } from '../context/SidebarContext'
import Avatar from './Avatar'
import BeeLogo from './BeeLogo'
import { roleLabel } from '../lib/roleLabel'

export default function Header() {
  const { logout, user } = useAuth()
  const { notifications } = useRestaurant()
  const { mobileOpen, toggleMobile } = useSidebar()
  const [showProfile, setShowProfile] = useState(false)
  const profileRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const navigate = useNavigate()

  const myNotifications = user ? notifications.filter((n) => n.role === user.role) : []
  const unreadCount = myNotifications.filter((n) => !n.read).length

  // Close the profile panel when clicking outside of it or pressing Escape.
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleOutsideClick = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      const target = event.target as Node
      if (profileRef.current && !profileRef.current.contains(target)) {
        setShowProfile(false)
      }
    }
    const handleEscape = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (event.key === 'Escape') {
        setShowProfile(false)
      }
    }
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleOutsideClick)
    document.addEventListener('keydown', handleEscape)
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleOutsideClick)
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', handleEscape)
    }
  }, [])

  return (
    <header className="sticky top-0 z-40 border-b border-slate-200/80 bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-md shadow-[0_10px_30px_rgba(15,23,42,0.08)]">

              onClick={() => toggleMobile()}

                  ? 'border-orange-300 bg-orange-100 text-orange-700'
                  : 'border-orange-100 bg-orange-50 text-orange-600 hover:bg-orange-100'
              }`}
              aria-label={mobileOpen ? 'Close menu' : 'Open menu'}
              title={mobileOpen ? 'Close menu' : 'Open menu'}
            >
              {mobileOpen ? <X size={18} /> : <Menu size={18} />}
              <span className="hidden min-[360px]:inline">{mobileOpen ? 'Close' : 'Menu'}</span>
            </button>
            <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2 drop-shadow-[0_6px_14px_rgba(30,58,138,0.25)] md:gap-3">
              <BeeLogo className="h-10 w-10 shrink-0 transition-transform duration-300 hover:scale-105 md:h-11 md:w-11" />

FILE: src\components\ImageUpload.tsx

import { useState, useRef, useCallback } from 'react'
import { Camera, Upload, X, Image as ImageIcon, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react'
import { dataMode } from '../services/firebase/config'
import { uploadMenuImage, uploadMemberImage, type UploadResult } from '../services/firebase/storageService'

interface ImageUploadProps {
  currentImageUrl?: string
  currentImageAlt?: string
  onImageSelected: (file: File, previewUrl: string, uploadResult?: UploadResult) => void
  onImageRemoved: () => void
  disabled?: boolean
  /** Context for Firebase Storage upload path */
  uploadContext?: {
    type: 'menu' | 'member'
    restaurantId?: string
    menuItemId?: string
    userId?: string
  }
}

// Accept any common image format — validation is by extension OR MIME type,
// so files whose MIME type the browser doesn't recognise are still accepted.
const IMAGE_EXTENSIONS = ['jpg', 'jpeg', 'png', 'webp', 'gif', 'bmp', 'svg', 'avif', 'heic', 'heif', 'tif', 'tiff', 'ico', 'jfif', 'pjpeg', 'pjp']
const hasImageExtension = (name: string): boolean => {
  const ext = name.split('.').pop()?.toLowerCase() ?? ''
  return IMAGE_EXTENSIONS.includes(ext)
}
const ACCEPT_ATTR = ['image/*', ...IMAGE_EXTENSIONS.map((e) => `.${e}`)].join(',')
const MAX_FILE_SIZE = 5 * 1024 * 1024 // 5MB

export default function ImageUpload({
  currentImageUrl,
  currentImageAlt,
  onImageSelected,
  onImageRemoved,
  disabled = false,
  uploadContext,
}: ImageUploadProps) {
  const [preview, setPreview] = useState<string | null>(currentImageUrl || null)
  const [altText, setAltText] = useState(currentImageAlt || '')
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [dragOver, setDragOver] = useState(false)
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false)
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null)

  const processFile = useCallback(
    (file: File) => {
      setError(null)
      setUploading(true)

      if ((file.type && !file.type.startsWith('image/')) || (!file.type && !hasImageExtension(file.name))) {
        setError('Please choose an image file (JPG, PNG, WEBP, GIF, BMP, SVG, AVIF, HEIC, TIFF, etc.).')
        setUploading(false)
        return
      }

      if (file.size > MAX_FILE_SIZE) {
        setError('Image must be smaller than 5MB.')
        setUploading(false)
        return
      }

      const reader = new FileReader()
      reader.onload = async (event) => {
        const result = event.target?.result as string
        setPreview(result)

        // In Firebase mode the photo belongs in Firebase Storage: the component
        // uploads it and hands the parent the durable download URL. The value
        // passed upward is never a `data:`/`blob:` browser-local preview when an
        // upload target is known.
        if (dataMode === 'firebase' && uploadContext && import.meta.env.VITE_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID) {
          try {
            let uploadResult: UploadResult | undefined
            if (uploadContext.type === 'menu' && uploadContext.restaurantId && uploadContext.menuItemId) {
              uploadResult = await uploadMenuImage(file, uploadContext.restaurantId, uploadContext.menuItemId)
            } else if (uploadContext.type === 'member' && uploadContext.userId) {
              uploadResult = await uploadMemberImage(file, uploadContext.userId)
            }

            if (!uploadResult) {
              // No usable upload target (a missing item/user id). Report it —
              // never silently fall back to a preview that cannot be saved.
              setPreview(currentImageUrl || null)
              setError('The photo was not uploaded. Save the item first, then add the photo.')
              return
            }

            setPreview(uploadResult.imageUrl)
            onImageSelected(file, uploadResult.imageUrl, uploadResult)
          } catch (err) {
            // The upload genuinely failed: show the reason and keep the image
            // that IS stored, so the operator never believes a photo was saved.
            setPreview(currentImageUrl || null)
            setError(
              err instanceof Error && err.message
                ? `Photo upload to Firebase Storage failed: ${err.message}`
                : 'Photo upload to Firebase Storage failed. Please try again.',
            )
          } finally {
            setUploading(false)
          }
          return
        }

        // No upload target configured (local/mock development): hand the caller
        // the local preview so the form can show the chosen file.
        onImageSelected(file, result)
        setUploading(false)
      }
      reader.onerror = () => {
        setError('Failed to read the image file.')
        setUploading(false)
      }
      reader.readAsDataURL(file)
    },
    [currentImageUrl, onImageSelected, uploadContext]
  )

  const handleFileChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0]
    if (file) {
      processFile(file)
    }
    if (fileInputRef.current) {
      fileInputRef.current.value = ''
    }
  }

  const handleDrop = (e: React.DragEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    setDragOver(false)
    const file = e.dataTransfer.files?.[0]
    if (file) {
      processFile(file)
    }
  }

  const handleDragOver = (e: React.DragEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    setDragOver(true)
  }

  const handleDragLeave = () => {
    setDragOver(false)
  }

  const handleRemove = () => {
    setPreview(null)
    setAltText('')
    setError(null)
    onImageRemoved()
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700">Dish Image</label>

      {preview ? (
        <div className="relative">
          <img
            src={preview}
            alt={altText || 'Dish preview'}
            className="h-48 w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 object-cover"
          />
          {uploading && (
            <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-black/40">
              <Loader2 size={32} className="animate-spin text-white" />
            </div>
          )}
          {!disabled && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleRemove}
              className="absolute right-2 top-2 flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-red-500 text-white shadow-lg hover:bg-red-600"
              title="Remove image"
            >
              <X size={16} />
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div
          onDrop={handleDrop}
          onDragOver={handleDragOver}
          onDragLeave={handleDragLeave}
          className={`flex h-48 flex-col items-center justify-center rounded-xl border-2 border-dashed transition ${
            dragOver
              ? 'border-orange-400 bg-orange-50'
              : 'border-slate-300 bg-slate-50 hover:border-orange-300 hover:bg-orange-50/50'
          } ${disabled ? 'cursor-not-allowed opacity-50' : 'cursor-pointer'}`}
          onClick={() => !disabled && fileInputRef.current?.click()}
        >
          <ImageIcon size={40} className="mb-2 text-slate-400" />
          <p className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-600">
            Drag & drop or click to upload
          </p>
          <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-400">
            Any image format — JPG, PNG, WEBP, GIF, BMP, SVG, AVIF, HEIC, TIFF… • Max 5MB
          </p>
        </div>
      )}

      <input
        ref={fileInputRef}
        type="file"
        accept={ACCEPT_ATTR}
        onChange={handleFileChange}
        className="hidden"
        disabled={disabled}
      />

      {preview && !disabled && (
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
            className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-200"
          >
            <Camera size={14} />
            Replace Image
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {preview && (
        <div>
          <label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-medium text-slate-600">Alt Text</label>
          <input
            type="text"
            value={altText}
            onChange={(e) => setAltText(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Describe the image"
            className="w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-200 px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-orange-400"
            disabled={disabled}
          />
        </div>
      )}

      {error && (
        <div className="rounded-lg bg-red-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-red-700">
          {error}
        </div>
      )}

      <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
        <Upload size={10} className="mr-1 inline" />
        Images are stored in cloud storage. Only the URL is saved to the menu item.
      </p>
    </div>
  )
}

FILE: src\components\InventoryEditModal.tsx

import { useState } from 'react'
import { CheckCircle2, X } from 'lucide-react'
import { useRestaurant } from '../context/RestaurantContext'
import type { InventoryItem } from '../context/RestaurantContext'

interface Props {
  item: InventoryItem
  onClose: () => void
  /** Additional actions rendered in the footer (e.g., deactivate/delete for admins). */
  showDangerActions?: boolean
}

/**
 * Shared inventory edit form used by both Admin and Supervisor inventory screens.
 * Stock changes made here are recorded as STOCK_ADJUSTMENT entries (audit trail);
 * minimum-threshold changes are recorded as "Minimum Stock Changed" activity.
 */
export default function InventoryEditModal({
  item,
  onClose,
  showDangerActions = false,
}: Props) {
  const { updateInventoryItem } = useRestaurant()

  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    name: item.name,
    category: item.category,
    unit: item.unit,
    quantity: String(item.quantity),
    minimumThreshold: String(item.minimumThreshold),
    notes: item.notes ?? '',
    active: item.active !== false,
  })

  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState(false)

  const submit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
  e.preventDefault()

  setError(null)
  setSaved(false)

  const quantity = parseFloat(form.quantity)
  const minimumThreshold = parseFloat(form.minimumThreshold)

  if (!form.name.trim()) {
    return setError('Item name is required')
  }

  if (!form.category.trim()) {
    return setError('Category is required')
  }

  if (!form.unit.trim()) {
    return setError('Unit is required')
  }

  if (!Number.isFinite(quantity) || quantity < 0) {
    return setError(
      'Current quantity must be a non-negative number'
    )
  }

  if (
    !Number.isFinite(minimumThreshold) ||
    minimumThreshold < 0
  ) {
    return setError(
      'Minimum quantity must be a non-negative number'
    )
  }

  try {
    updateInventoryItem(item.id, {
      name: form.name.trim(),
      category: form.category.trim(),
      unit: form.unit.trim(),
      quantity,
      minimumThreshold,
      notes: form.notes.trim() || undefined,
      active: form.active,
    })

    setSaved(true)
  } catch (err) {
    setError(
      err instanceof Error
        ? err.message
        : 'Could not save changes'
    )
  }
}

  const field = 'w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-orange-400'
  const label = 'mb-1 block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700'

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-start justify-center overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain bg-slate-900/40 p-4 py-6 sm:items-center bh-modal-overlay">
      <div className="w-full max-w-md rounded-[20px] bg-white p-5 shadow-xl">
        <div className="mb-4 flex items-center justify-between">
          <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900">Edit Inventory Item</h3>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-700"><X size={20} /></button>
        </div>
        {error && <div className="mb-3 rounded-xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-red-700">{error}</div>}
       
        <form onSubmit={submit} className="space-y-3">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div>
              <label className={label}>Item Name</label>
              <input type="text" value={form.name} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, name: e.target.value })} required className={field} />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className={label}>Category</label>
              <input type="text" value={form.category} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, category: e.target.value })} required className={field} />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className={label}>Unit</label>
              <input type="text" value={form.unit} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, unit: e.target.value })} required className={field} />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className={label}>Current Quantity</label>
              <input type="number" min={0} step="any" value={form.quantity} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, quantity: e.target.value })} required className={field} />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className={label}>Minimum / Reorder Quantity</label>
              <input type="number" min={0} step="any" value={form.minimumThreshold} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, minimumThreshold: e.target.value })} required className={field} />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className={label}>Availability</label>
              <select value={form.active ? 'active' : 'inactive'} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, active: e.target.value === 'active' })} className={field}>
                <option value="active">Active</option>
                <option value="inactive">Deactivated</option>
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className={label}>Notes</label>
            <textarea value={form.notes} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, notes: e.target.value })} rows={2} className={field} />
          </div>
          <ModalFooter onClose={onClose} showDangerActions={showDangerActions} item={item} onError={setError} saved={saved}/>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

function ModalFooter({
  onClose,
  showDangerActions,
  item,
  onError,
  saved,
}: {
  onClose: () => void
  showDangerActions: boolean
  item: InventoryItem
  onError: (msg: string) => void
  saved: boolean
}) {
  const { updateInventoryItem, deleteInventoryItem } = useRestaurant()
  // A master inventory record is PERMANENT stock: deleting it is the only
  // irreversible action on this screen, so it is a deliberate two-step
  // confirmation instead of a single mis-tap that removes the record everywhere.
  const [confirmDelete, setConfirmDelete] = useState(false)
  const deactivate = () => {
    try { updateInventoryItem(item.id, { active: false }); onClose() } catch (err) { onError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Could not deactivate item') }
  }
  const remove = () => {
    try { deleteInventoryItem(item.id); onClose() } catch (err) { onError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Could not delete item') }
  }
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 pt-1">
      <button
  type="submit"
  disabled={saved}
  className={`flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-4 py-2 font-bold text-white transition ${
    saved
      ? 'bg-emerald-500'
      : 'bg-orange-500 hover:bg-orange-600'
  } disabled:cursor-not-allowed`}
>
  {saved ? (
    <>
      <CheckCircle2 size={16} />
      Saved
    </>
  ) : (
    'Save Changes'
  )}
</button>
      <button type="button" onClick={onClose} className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-600 transition hover:bg-slate-50">
        Cancel
      </button>
      {showDangerActions && item.active !== false && (
        <button type="button" onClick={deactivate} className="rounded-xl border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-amber-700 transition hover:bg-amber-100">
          Deactivate
        </button>
      )}
      {showDangerActions && (confirmDelete ? (
        <span className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-3 py-2">
          <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-red-700">Delete “{item.name}” permanently?</span>
          <button type="button" onClick={remove} className="rounded-lg bg-red-600 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-red-700">
            Yes, delete
          </button>
          <button type="button" onClick={() => setConfirmDelete(false)} className="rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 transition hover:bg-slate-50">
            Keep
          </button>
        </span>
      ) : (
        <button type="button" onClick={() => setConfirmDelete(true)} className="rounded-xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-red-600 transition hover:bg-red-100">
          Delete
        </button>
      ))}
    </div>
  )
}

import { useRestaurant } from '../context/RestaurantContext'

/**
 * Phase 11/32 — pricing audit: who changed what, Supervisor vs Admin, with old → new.
 * Shared by the Admin (highest pricing authority) and Supervisor (price operator)
 * menu tabs per the role matrix. Read-only — no role can edit history here.
 */
export default function MenuPriceHistoryView() {
  const { activityLog, menu } = useRestaurant()

  const priceChanges = activityLog
    .filter((log) => (log.action ?? '').startsWith('price changed'))
    .slice(0, 50)

  return (
    <div className="rounded-[20px] border border-orange-100 bg-white p-5">
      <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900">Price History</h2>
      <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">
        Every price change is audited with who made it. Admin holds the highest pricing authority and can override Supervisor
        prices — historical orders always keep their original price snapshot.
      </p>
      {priceChanges.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="mt-4 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 p-4 text-sm text-slate-500">
          No price changes recorded yet. Changes made by Supervisor or Admin will appear here.
        </p>
      ) : (
        <div className="mt-4 max-h-80 space-y-2 overflow-y-auto">
          {priceChanges.map((log) => {
            const match = (log.action ?? '').match(/₹\s*([\d.]+)\s*→\s*₹\s*([\d.]+)/)
            const dish = menu.find((item) => item.id === log.entityId)
            const dishName = dish?.name ?? (log.action ?? '').match(/"([^"]+)"/)?.[1] ?? 'Unknown dish'
            return (
              <div key={log.id} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 px-3 py-2">
                <div className="min-w-0">
                  <p className="truncate text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900">{dishName}</p>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                    {log.userName} • {new Date(log.timestamp ?? log.createdAt).toLocaleString()}
                  </p>
                </div>
                <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2">
                  {match ? (
                    <span className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-700">
                      ₹{match[1]} → ₹{match[2]}
                    </span>
                  ) : (
                    <span className="max-w-40 truncate text-sm text-slate-600">{log.action ?? log.subtitle}</span>
                  )}
                  <span
                    className={`rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase ${
                      log.role === 'admin' ? 'bg-violet-100 text-violet-700' : 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {log.role}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            )
          })}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

FILE: src\components\NotificationToasts.tsx

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext'
import { useRestaurant } from '../context/RestaurantContext'
import type { NotificationItem } from '../context/RestaurantContext'
import { BellRing, CheckCheck, X } from 'lucide-react'

const TOAST_DURATION_MS = 7000

export default function NotificationToasts() {
  const { user } = useAuth()
  const { notifications, markNotificationRead } = useRestaurant()
  const [toasts, setToasts] = useState<NotificationItem[]>([])
  const seenIds = useRef<Set<string>>(new Set())
  const initialized = useRef(false)

  // On login, existing notifications are treated as "already seen" so only
  // NEW notifications trigger a real-time toast.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user) return
    const roleNotifications = notifications.filter((n) => n.role === user.role)

    if (!initialized.current) {
      roleNotifications.forEach((n) => seenIds.current.add(n.id))
      initialized.current = true
      return
    }

    const fresh = roleNotifications.filter((n) => !seenIds.current.has(n.id))
    if (fresh.length === 0) return
    fresh.forEach((n) => seenIds.current.add(n.id))
    setToasts((prev) => [...fresh.slice(0, 3), ...prev].slice(0, 4))
  }, [notifications, user])

  // Auto-dismiss each toast after the duration.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (toasts.length === 0) return
    const timers = toasts.map((toast) =>
      window.setTimeout(() => {
        setToasts((prev) => prev.filter((t) => t.id !== toast.id))
      }, TOAST_DURATION_MS)
    )
    return () => timers.forEach((timer) => window.clearTimeout(timer))
  }, [toasts])

  const dismiss = (id: string) => {
    seenIds.current.add(id)
    setToasts((prev) => prev.filter((t) => t.id !== id))
  }

  if (toasts.length === 0) return null

  return (
    <div className="pointer-events-none fixed right-4 top-4 z-70 flex w-[min(92vw,22rem)] flex-col gap-2">
      {toasts.map((toast) => (
        <div
          key={toast.id}
          className="animate-toast-slide pointer-events-auto flex items-start gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-orange-200 bg-white p-4 shadow-[0_16px_40px_rgba(120,53,15,0.18)]"
        >
          <div className="flex h-9 w-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-orange-100 text-orange-600">
            <BellRing size={17} />
          </div>
          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <p className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900">{toast.title}</p>
            <p className="mt-0.5 line-clamp-2 text-xs text-slate-600">{toast.message}</p>
          </div>
          <div className="flex shrink-0 gap-1">
            <button
              onClick={() => markNotificationRead(toast.id)}
              title="Mark as read"
              className="rounded-lg p-1.5 text-emerald-600 transition hover:bg-emerald-50"
            >
              <CheckCheck size={15} />
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => dismiss(toast.id)}
              title="Dismiss"
              className="rounded-lg p-1.5 text-slate-400 transition hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-slate-600"
            >
              <X size={15} />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  )
}
