import { CheckCheck, BellRing } from 'lucide-react'
import type { NotificationItem } from '../context/RestaurantContext'

interface NotificationsPanelProps {
  notifications: NotificationItem[]
  onMarkRead: (notificationId: string) => void
  onMarkAllRead: () => void
}

function formatRelativeTime(timestamp: number): string {
  const diff = Date.now() - timestamp
  const seconds = Math.floor(diff / 1000)
  if (seconds < 60) return 'Just now'
  const minutes = Math.floor(seconds / 60)
  if (minutes < 60) return `${minutes}m ago`
  const hours = Math.floor(minutes / 60)
  if (hours < 24) return `${hours}h ago`
  const days = Math.floor(hours / 24)
  if (days < 7) return `${days}d ago`
  return new Date(timestamp).toLocaleDateString()
}

export default function NotificationsPanel({ notifications, onMarkRead, onMarkAllRead }: NotificationsPanelProps) {
  const unreadCount = notifications.filter((n) => !n.read).length

  return (
    <div className="absolute right-0 top-12 w-80 sm:w-96">
      <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-[20px] border border-orange-100 bg-white shadow-[0_20px_50px_rgba(120,53,15,0.15)]">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-orange-100 bg-orange-50/60 px-4 py-3">
          <div>
            <p className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900">Notifications</p>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
              {unreadCount > 0 ? `${unreadCount} unread` : 'All caught up'}
            </p>
          </div>
          {unreadCount > 0 && (
            <button
              onClick={onMarkAllRead}
              className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg bg-orange-500 px-3 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-orange-600"
            >
              <CheckCheck size={13} />
              Mark all read
            </button>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* List */}
        <div className="max-h-80 overflow-y-auto">
          {notifications.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="px-4 py-10 text-center">
              <BellRing className="mx-auto mb-2 text-orange-200" size={36} />
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-600">No notifications yet</p>
              <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-400">New alerts will show up here in real time.</p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            notifications.map((notification) => (
              <button
                key={notification.id}
                onClick={() => onMarkRead(notification.id)}
                className={`flex w-full items-start gap-3 border-b border-slate-100 px-4 py-3 text-left transition hover:bg-orange-50/60 ${
                  notification.read ? 'bg-white' : 'bg-amber-50/40'
                }`}
              >
                <div
                  className={`mt-0.5 flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full ${
                    notification.read ? 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-400' : 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-600'
                  }`}
                >
                  <BellRing size={15} />
                </div>
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <p className={`text-sm ${notification.read ? 'font-medium text-slate-600' : 'font-bold text-slate-900'}`}>
                    {notification.title}
                  </p>
                  <p className="mt-0.5 line-clamp-2 text-xs text-slate-500">{notification.message}</p>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-400">
                    {formatRelativeTime(notification.createdAt)}
                  </p>
                </div>
                {!notification.read && <span className="mt-1.5 h-2 w-2 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-orange-500" />}
              </button>
            ))
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Footer */}
        <div className="border-t border-slate-100 bg-slate-50/60 px-4 py-2">
          <p className="text-center text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-slate-400">
            Live updates • click to mark as read
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

FILE: src\components\PrintPreview.tsx
============================================================

/**
 * Bee's Hive — physical receipt preview.
 *
 * Opening this modal NEVER prints.
 * The physical PT-210 is triggered only by the PRINT button, which sends the
 * receipt through printService -> Windows relay -> the configured COM port.
 * `window.print()` is deliberately not used here.
 */
import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import {
  printPreviewJob,
  reprintJob,
  usePrintQueue,
  type PrintJob,
} from '../services/print/printService'
import type { BillPrintPayload, TokenPrintPayload, SessionReceiptPayload } from '../services/print/printFormatters'
import {
  formatBill58mm as formatBill,
  formatSessionReceipt58mm as formatSession,
  formatToken58mm as formatToken,
} from '../services/print/printFormatters'
import { receiptTokenLabel } from '../lib/tokenLabel'
import { Printer, X, AlertTriangle, CheckCircle, RotateCcw } from 'lucide-react'

export interface PrintPreviewProps {
  /** Existing queued/printed job, used for an intentional reprint. */
  jobId?: string
  /** Display-only job. It is not sent to the printer until PRINT is clicked. */
  previewJob?: PrintJob
  onCancel?: () => void
}

export default function PrintPreview({ jobId, previewJob, onCancel }: PrintPreviewProps) {
  const jobs = usePrintQueue()
  const queuedJob = jobId ? jobs.find((job) => job.id === jobId) : undefined
  const baseJob = previewJob ?? queuedJob
  const [printedJobId, setPrintedJobId] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [printing, setPrinting] = useState(false)
  const [localError, setLocalError] = useState('')
  const printTriggeredRef = useRef(false)

  const activePrintedJob = printedJobId
    ? jobs.find((job) => job.id === printedJobId)
    : undefined

  const job = activePrintedJob ?? baseJob

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!printedJobId) return
    const current = jobs.find((candidate) => candidate.id === printedJobId)
    if (!current) return
    if (current.status === 'PRINTED' || current.status === 'FAILED') {
      setPrinting(false)
      printTriggeredRef.current = false
    }
  }, [jobs, printedJobId])

  const lines = useMemo(() => {
    if (!job) return []
    return getPreviewLines(job)
  }, [job])

  if (!job) {
    return (
      <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/40 p-4 bh-modal-overlay">
        <div className="rounded-2xl bg-white p-6 shadow-2xl">
          <p className="text-slate-500">Receipt preview is no longer available.</p>
          {onCancel && (
            <button onClick={onCancel} className="mt-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 px-4 py-2 text-sm">Close</button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    )
  }

  const isToken = job.kind === 'token'
  const isParcel = isToken && (job.payload as TokenPrintPayload).kind === 'parcel'
  const tokenPayload = isToken ? (job.payload as TokenPrintPayload) : undefined
  const tokenNo = tokenPayload ? receiptTokenLabel(tokenPayload.tokenNumber, tokenPayload.kind) : ''
  const isDisplayOnly = Boolean(previewJob) && !printedJobId
  const terminalStatus = activePrintedJob?.status ?? (isDisplayOnly ? 'READY' : job.status)

  const handlePrint = () => {
    if (printing || printTriggeredRef.current) return
    printTriggeredRef.current = true
    setLocalError('')
    setPrinting(true)
    try {
      const physicalJob = isDisplayOnly ? printPreviewJob(job) : reprintJob(job)
      setPrintedJobId(physicalJob.id)
    } catch (error) {
      setPrinting(false)
      printTriggeredRef.current = false
      setLocalError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Could not send receipt to printer')
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-start justify-center overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain bg-black/50 p-4 py-6 sm:items-center bh-modal-overlay">
      <div className="w-full max-w-md rounded-2xl bg-white p-4 shadow-2xl">
        <div className="mb-3 flex items-center justify-between">
          <h2 className="flex items-center gap-2 text-lg font-black text-slate-900">
            <Printer size={18} className="text-orange-500" />
            {job.kind === 'token' ? 'Token Preview' : job.kind === 'session_receipt' ? 'Session Receipt Preview' : 'Bill Preview'}
          </h2>
          {onCancel && (
            <button onClick={onCancel} className="rounded-lg p-1.5 text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-100" aria-label="Close">
              <X size={16} />
            </button>
          )}
        </div>

        {terminalStatus === 'FAILED' && (
          <div className="mb-3 flex items-start gap-2 rounded-xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-red-700">
            <AlertTriangle size={16} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
            <span>Print failed — {activePrintedJob?.error ?? job.error ?? 'printer unavailable'}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {terminalStatus === 'PRINTED' && (
          <div className="mb-3 flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-emerald-700">
            <CheckCircle size={16} /> Printed through the configured PT-210.
          </div>
        )}

        {terminalStatus === 'READY' && (
          <div className="mb-3 flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-sky-200 bg-sky-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-sky-700">
            <Printer size={16} /> Preview only — nothing has been printed.
          </div>
        )}

        {isToken && (
          <div className="mb-3 rounded-xl border-2 border-orange-200 bg-linear-to-br from-orange-50 to-amber-50 py-3 text-center">
            <p className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-[0.35em] text-orange-500">{isParcel ? 'Parcel' : 'Token'}</p>
            <p className="mt-0.5 text-4xl font-black tracking-wider text-slate-900">
              {isParcel ? `PARCEL ${tokenNo}` : `TOKEN ${tokenNo}`}
            </p>
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-[#fffdf9] p-3">
          <pre className="max-h-[52vh] overflow-auto whitespace-pre-wrap font-mono text-[11px] leading-tight text-slate-800">
            {lines.join('\n')}
          </pre>
        </div>

        {localError && (
          <div className="mt-3 rounded-xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-red-700">{localError}</div>
        )}

        <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handlePrint}
            disabled={printing}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl bg-orange-500 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-white hover:bg-orange-600 disabled:cursor-wait disabled:opacity-60"
          >
            {printing ? <RotateCcw size={14} className="animate-spin" /> : <Printer size={14} />}
            {printing ? 'Printing…' : terminalStatus === 'PRINTED' ? 'Print Again' : 'PRINT'}
          </button>

          {onCancel && (
            <button type="button" onClick={onCancel} className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-4 py-2.5 text-sm text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50">
              Close
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

/** Keep formatter output identical to the physical PT-210 payload. */
function getPreviewLines(job: PrintJob): string[] {
  if (job.kind === 'token') return formatToken(job.payload as TokenPrintPayload)
  if (job.kind === 'bill') return formatBill(job.payload as BillPrintPayload)
  return formatSession(job.payload as SessionReceiptPayload)
}

FILE: src\components\ProtectedRoute.tsx

import type { ReactNode } from 'react'
import { Navigate } from 'react-router-dom'
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext'
import type { UserRole } from '../context/AuthContext'

interface ProtectedRouteProps {
  children: ReactNode
  requiredRole?: UserRole
}

const roleRoutes: Record<UserRole, string> = {
  admin: '/admin',
  waiter: '/waiter',
  supervisor: '/supervisor',
}

export default function ProtectedRoute({ children, requiredRole }: ProtectedRouteProps) {
  const { isAuthenticated, user, isLoading } = useAuth()

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center">
        <div className="text-lg">Loading...</div>
      </div>
    )
  }

  if (!isAuthenticated || !user) {
    return <Navigate to="/login" replace />
  }

  if (requiredRole && user.role !== requiredRole) {
    // Role mismatch — send them to their own dashboard, NOT back to login
    return <Navigate to={roleRoutes[user.role]} replace />
  }

  return <>{children}</>
}

FILE: src\components\Sidebar.tsx

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, X } from 'lucide-react'
import { useSidebar } from '../context/SidebarContext'

export type NavItem = {
  id: string
  label: string
  icon: React.ReactNode
  badge?: number
}

type SidebarProps = {
  navItems: NavItem[]
  activeTab: string
  panelName: string
  onSelect: (id: string) => void
}

/**
 * Responsive, collapsible sidebar.
 *
 * - On large screens (lg+): a desktop sidebar that collapses to an icon-only
 *   rail via the arrow button (ChevronLeft/ChevronRight toggle).
 * - On small/medium screens (< lg): hides the desktop rail and shows a floating
 *   hamburger button that opens an off-canvas drawer with a backdrop.
 */
export default function Sidebar({ navItems, activeTab, panelName, onSelect }: SidebarProps) {
  const [collapsed, setCollapsed] = useState(false)
  const { mobileOpen, closeMobile } = useSidebar()

  // Close the shared mobile drawer whenever a role dashboard (re)mounts.
  useEffect(() => {
    closeMobile()
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [])

  // Lock page scroll while the mobile drawer is open.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!mobileOpen) return
    const previous = document.body.style.overflow
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden'
    return () => {
      document.body.style.overflow = previous
    }
  }, [mobileOpen])

  const handleSelect = (id: string) => {
    onSelect(id)
    closeMobile()
  }

  const badge = (item: NavItem) =>
    item.badge != null && item.badge > 0 ? (
      <span className="ml-auto rounded-full bg-red-500 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-white">{item.badge}</span>
    ) : null

  return (
    <>
      {/* Mobile drawer */}
      <div className={`fixed inset-0 z-40 lg:hidden ${mobileOpen ? 'pointer-events-auto' : 'pointer-events-none'}`}>
        <div
          className={`absolute inset-0 bg-slate-900/40 transition-opacity duration-300 ${
            mobileOpen ? 'opacity-100' : 'opacity-0'
          }`}
          onClick={() => closeMobile()}
        />
        <div
          className={`absolute left-0 top-0 z-10 flex h-full w-64 max-w-[80%] flex-col overflow-x-hidden overflow-y-auto border-r border-orange-100 bg-white p-3 shadow-[0_16px_40px_rgba(120,53,15,0.18)] transition-transform duration-300 ${
            mobileOpen ? 'translate-x-0' : '-translate-x-full'
          }`}
        >
          <div className="mb-3 flex items-center justify-between pr-2">
            <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-slate-400">{panelName}</p>
            <button
              onClick={() => closeMobile()}
              className="rounded-lg p-1.5 text-slate-500 transition hover:bg-slate-50"
              aria-label="Close menu"
              title="Close menu"
            >
              <X size={18} />
            </button>
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-1">
            {navItems.map((item) => (
              <button
                key={item.id}
                onClick={() => handleSelect(item.id)}
                className={`flex min-w-0 w-full items-center justify-start gap-2 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-left text-sm font-medium transition ${
                  activeTab === item.id
                    ? 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-700'
                    : 'text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50 hover:text-slate-900'
                }`}
              >
                <span className="shrink-0">{item.icon}</span>
                <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate">{item.label}</span>
                {badge(item)}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Desktop sidebar (lg+) */}
      <aside
        className={`hidden shrink-0 transition-all duration-300 lg:block ${collapsed ? 'lg:w-16' : 'lg:w-56'}`}
      >
        <nav className="rounded-[20px] border border-orange-100 bg-white p-2 shadow-sm">
          <div className={`mb-3 flex items-center justify-between px-2 pt-2 ${collapsed ? 'justify-center' : ''}`}>
            {!collapsed && (
              <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-slate-400">{panelName}</p>
            )}
            <button
              onClick={() => setCollapsed((value) => !value)}
              className="shrink-0 rounded-lg p-1.5 text-slate-400 transition hover:bg-slate-50 hover:text-slate-600"
              aria-label={collapsed ? 'Expand sidebar' : 'Collapse sidebar'}
              title={collapsed ? 'Expand sidebar' : 'Collapse sidebar'}
            >
              {collapsed ? <ChevronRight size={18} /> : <ChevronLeft size={18} />}
            </button>
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-1">
            {navItems.map((item) => (
              <button
                key={item.id}
                onClick={() => handleSelect(item.id)}
                title={collapsed ? item.label : undefined}
                className={`flex w-full items-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium transition ${
                  collapsed ? 'justify-center' : ''
                } ${
                  activeTab === item.id
                    ? 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-700'
                    : 'text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50 hover:text-slate-900'
                }`}
              >
                <span className="relative shrink-0">
                  {item.icon}
                  {collapsed && item.badge != null && item.badge > 0 && (
                    <span className="absolute -right-2 -top-1.5 flex h-4 w-4 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-red-500 text-[9px] font-bold text-white">
                      {item.badge > 9 ? '9+' : item.badge}
                    </span>
                  )}
                </span>
                {!collapsed && item.label}
                {!collapsed && badge(item)}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </nav>
      </aside>
    </>
  )
}

FILE: src\components\SupervisorMenuManagement.tsx

import { useState } from 'react'
import { useRestaurant } from '../context/RestaurantContext'
import type { MenuItem } from '../context/RestaurantContext'
import ImageUpload from './ImageUpload'
import { FOOD_TYPE_OPTIONS, type FoodType } from '../lib/menuFilters'
import { dataMode } from '../services/firebase/config'
import { uploadMenuImage, deleteMenuImage, getMenuImagePath, isDurableImageUrl } from '../services/firebase/storageService'
import { saveDoc, deleteEntity, FIRESTORE_COLLECTIONS } from '../services/firebase/dataService'
import { Loader2, Plus, X, Clock, Star, Image as ImageIcon, Edit2 } from 'lucide-react'

export default function SupervisorMenuManagement() {
  const {
    menu,
    categories,
    addCategory,
    addMenuItem,
    updateMenuItemDetails,
    updateMenuItemPrice,
    toggleMenuItemAvailability,
    setMenuItemActive,
    setSpecialDate,
    renameCategory,
    deactivateCategory,
    deleteMenuItem,
  } = useRestaurant()

  const [menuError, setMenuError] = useState('')

  const [showCategoryForm, setShowCategoryForm] = useState(false)
  const [showItemForm, setShowItemForm] = useState(false)
  const [editingItemId, setEditingItemId] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [categoryName, setCategoryName] = useState('')
  const [itemForm, setItemForm] = useState({
    name: '',
    price: 0,
    halfPlatePrice: '',
    description: '',
    preparationTime: 15,
    categoryId: '',
    imageUrl: '',
    imageAlt: '',
    foodType: 'veg' as FoodType,
  })
  const [selectedImageFile, setSelectedImageFile] = useState<File | null>(null)
  const [showSpecialDatePicker, setShowSpecialDatePicker] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [specialDateValue, setSpecialDateValue] = useState('')
  const [savingItem, setSavingItem] = useState(false)

  const today = new Date()
  const todayStr = `${today.getFullYear()}-${String(today.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(today.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}`

  const handleAddCategory = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    if (!categoryName.trim()) return
    try {
      addCategory(categoryName.trim())
      setCategoryName('')
      setShowCategoryForm(false)
      setMenuError('')
    } catch (err) {
      setMenuError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Could not add category')
    }
  }

  /**
   * Create or update a dish.
   *
   * The dish is only reported as saved once BOTH the Firestore menu document and
   * its Firebase Storage image are durable:
   *   • CREATE — the Firestore item is created first (that mint the permanent
   *     document id), then the photo is uploaded to Storage under that id, and
   *     the SAME document is updated with imageUrl + imagePath. If any step
   *     fails the partial item and the uploaded object are removed and the form
   *     stays open with the real error.
   *   • EDIT — ImageUpload uploads the replacement photo under the existing
   *     item id, so the URL handed back here is already a Storage download URL.
   * A browser-local preview (`data:` / `blob:`) is never persisted: it would
   * break on the next reload and on every other device.
   */
  const handleAddItem = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    if (savingItem) return
    if (!itemForm.name.trim() || !itemForm.categoryId) {
      setMenuError('Enter a dish name and choose a category.')
      return
    }
    // Optional half plate price: empty → null (full plate only). Never allow
    // NaN/string into the persisted dish record.
    const halfRaw = itemForm.halfPlatePrice.trim()
    let halfPlatePrice: number | null = null
    if (halfRaw !== '') {
      const parsedHalf = parseFloat(halfRaw)
      if (!Number.isFinite(parsedHalf) || parsedHalf < 0) {
        setMenuError('Half plate price must be a non-negative number (or leave it empty).')
        return
      }
      halfPlatePrice = parsedHalf
    }
    const category = categories.find((c) => c.id === itemForm.categoryId)
    setMenuError('')
    setSavingItem(true)
    let created: MenuItem | null = null
    try {
      if (editingItemId) {
        const current = menu.find((m) => m.id === editingItemId)
        // Cleared by the operator → remove it; still a local preview → keep the
        // stored URL; a Storage URL → save it.
        const imageUrl = itemForm.imageUrl === ''
          ? undefined
          : isDurableImageUrl(itemForm.imageUrl) ? itemForm.imageUrl : current?.imageUrl
        const details = {
          name: itemForm.name.trim(),
          description: itemForm.description.trim(),
          preparationTime: itemForm.preparationTime,
          category: category?.name || '',
          categoryId: itemForm.categoryId,
          imageUrl,
          imageAlt: itemForm.imageAlt || itemForm.name.trim(),
          foodType: itemForm.foodType,
          halfPlatePrice,
        }
        // Operational fields (name, description, timing, image) go to details…
        updateMenuItemDetails(editingItemId, details)
        // …price goes through the audited price path. ADMIN + SUPERVISOR both allowed.
        updateMenuItemPrice(editingItemId, itemForm.price)
        if (dataMode === 'firebase') {
          // Write through and wait: the debounced sync push is not the source of
          // truth for an image that must be visible immediately on every device.
          await saveDoc(
            FIRESTORE_COLLECTIONS.menu,
            editingItemId,
            { ...details, updatedAt: Date.now() },
            { merge: true },
          )
        }
      } else {
        created = addMenuItem({
          name: itemForm.name.trim(),
          price: itemForm.price,
          halfPlatePrice,
          description: itemForm.description.trim(),
          preparationTime: itemForm.preparationTime,
          category: category?.name || '',
          categoryId: itemForm.categoryId,
          available: true,
          active: true,
          // Persisted only after the Storage upload below has finished.
          imageUrl: selectedImageFile
            ? undefined
            : isDurableImageUrl(itemForm.imageUrl) ? itemForm.imageUrl : undefined,
          imageAlt: itemForm.imageAlt || itemForm.name.trim(),
          foodType: itemForm.foodType,
        })
        if (dataMode === 'firebase' && selectedImageFile) {
          const uploaded = await uploadMenuImage(
            selectedImageFile,
            import.meta.env.VITE_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID,
            created.id,
          )
          await saveDoc(
            FIRESTORE_COLLECTIONS.menu,
            created.id,
            {
              ...created,
              imageUrl: uploaded.imageUrl,
              imagePath: uploaded.imagePath,
              updatedAt: Date.now(),
            },
            { merge: true },
          )
          updateMenuItemDetails(created.id, { imageUrl: uploaded.imageUrl, imagePath: uploaded.imagePath })
        }
      }
      // Every step succeeded — only now close and clear the form.
      resetForm()
    } catch (err) {
      if (created) {
        if (dataMode === 'firebase') {
          await deleteEntity(FIRESTORE_COLLECTIONS.menu, created.id).catch(() => {})
          await deleteMenuImage(getMenuImagePath(import.meta.env.VITE_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID, created.id)).catch(() => {})
        }
        deleteMenuItem(created.id)
      }
      setMenuError(err instanceof Error && err.message
        ? `Dish could not be saved: ${err.message}`
        : 'Dish could not be saved. Please try again.')
    } finally {
      setSavingItem(false)
    }
  }

  const resetForm = () => {
    setItemForm({ name: '', price: 0, halfPlatePrice: '', description: '', preparationTime: 15, categoryId: '', imageUrl: '', imageAlt: '', foodType: 'veg' as FoodType })
    setSelectedImageFile(null)
    setShowItemForm(false)
    setEditingItemId(null)
  }

  const handleEditItem = (itemId: string) => {
    const item = menu.find((m) => m.id === itemId)
    if (!item) return
    setItemForm({
      name: item.name,
      price: item.price,
      halfPlatePrice: item.halfPlatePrice != null && Number.isFinite(item.halfPlatePrice) ? String(item.halfPlatePrice) : '',
      description: item.description,
      preparationTime: item.preparationTime,
      categoryId: item.categoryId,
      imageUrl: item.imageUrl || '',
      imageAlt: item.imageAlt || '',
      foodType: item.foodType || 'veg',
    })
    setEditingItemId(itemId)
    setShowItemForm(true)
  }

  const handleImageSelected = (file: File, previewUrl: string) => {
    setSelectedImageFile(file)
    setItemForm({ ...itemForm, imageUrl: previewUrl })
  }

  const handleImageRemoved = () => {
    setSelectedImageFile(null)
    setItemForm({ ...itemForm, imageUrl: '', imageAlt: '' })
  }

  const handleSetSpecialDate = (itemId: string) => {
    if (specialDateValue) {
      try {
        setSpecialDate(itemId, specialDateValue)
        setMenuError('')
      } catch (err) {
        setMenuError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Could not set special date')
      }
    }
    setShowSpecialDatePicker(null)
    setSpecialDateValue('')
  }

  const handleClearSpecialDate = (itemId: string) => {
    try {
      setSpecialDate(itemId, undefined)
      setMenuError('')
    } catch (err) {
      setMenuError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Could not clear special date')
    }
  }

  const isSpecialToday = (item: { specialDate?: string }) => {
    return item.specialDate === todayStr
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {menuError && (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-red-700">{menuError}</div>
      )}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-900">Menu Management</h2>
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <button
            onClick={() => setShowCategoryForm(true)}
            className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 transition hover:bg-slate-200"
          >
            <Plus size={16} />
            Add Category
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => { resetForm(); setShowItemForm(true) }}
            className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-orange-500 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-orange-600"
          >
            <Plus size={16} />
            Add Dish
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Category Form */}
      {showCategoryForm && (
        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-orange-200 bg-orange-50 p-5">
          <div className="mb-4 flex items-center justify-between">
            <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900">New Category</h3>
            <button onClick={() => setShowCategoryForm(false)} className="text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-700">
              <X size={20} />
            </button>
          </div>
          <form onSubmit={handleAddCategory} className="flex gap-2">
            <input
              type="text"
              value={categoryName}
              onChange={(e) => setCategoryName(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Category name (e.g., Starters)"
              required
              className="flex-1 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-orange-400"
            />
            <button type="submit" className="rounded-xl bg-orange-500 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-bold text-white hover:bg-orange-600">
              Add
            </button>
          </form>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Item Form (Add/Edit) */}
      {showItemForm && (
        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-orange-200 bg-orange-50 p-5">
          <div className="mb-4 flex items-center justify-between">
            <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900">
              {editingItemId ? 'Edit Dish' : 'New Dish'}
            </h3>
            <button onClick={resetForm} className="text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-700">
              <X size={20} />
            </button>
          </div>
          <form onSubmit={handleAddItem} className="space-y-4">
            {/* Image Upload — while editing, the photo uploads straight to
                Firebase Storage under the item's permanent id and the download
                URL comes back here. When creating a new dish the file is kept
                and uploaded right after the item (and its id) is created. */}
            <ImageUpload
              currentImageUrl={itemForm.imageUrl}
              currentImageAlt={itemForm.imageAlt}
              uploadContext={editingItemId && import.meta.env.VITE_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID
                ? { type: 'menu', restaurantId: import.meta.env.VITE_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID, menuItemId: editingItemId }
                : undefined}
              onImageSelected={handleImageSelected}
              onImageRemoved={handleImageRemoved}
              disabled={savingItem}
            />

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
              <div>
                <label className="mb-1 block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700">Dish Name *</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={itemForm.name}
                  onChange={(e) => setItemForm({ ...itemForm, name: e.target.value })}
                  placeholder="e.g., Paneer Tikka"
                  required
                  className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-orange-400"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="mb-1 block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700">Category *</label>
                <select
                  value={itemForm.categoryId}
                  onChange={(e) => setItemForm({ ...itemForm, categoryId: e.target.value })}
                  required
                  className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-orange-400"
                >
                  <option value="">Select category</option>
                  {categories.filter((c) => c.active).map((cat) => (
                    <option key={cat.id} value={cat.id}>{cat.name}</option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="mb-1 block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700">Price (₹) *</label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  value={itemForm.price}
                  onChange={(e) => setItemForm({ ...itemForm, price: parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0 })}
                  min="0"
                  required
                  className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-orange-400"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="mb-1 block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700" title="Optional — leave empty when the dish has no half plate">Half Plate Price (₹) — Optional</label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  value={itemForm.halfPlatePrice}
                  onChange={(e) => setItemForm({ ...itemForm, halfPlatePrice: e.target.value })}
                  min="0"
                  step="0.01"
                  placeholder="Empty = full plate only"
                  className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-orange-400"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="mb-1 block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700">Prep Time (min)</label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  value={itemForm.preparationTime}
                  onChange={(e) => setItemForm({ ...itemForm, preparationTime: parseInt(e.target.value) || 5 })}
                  min="1"
                  className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-orange-400"
                />
              </div>
              <div className="md:col-span-2">
                <label className="mb-1 block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700">Description</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={itemForm.description}
                  onChange={(e) => setItemForm({ ...itemForm, description: e.target.value })}
                  placeholder="Brief description"
                  className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-orange-400"
                />
              </div>
              <div className="md:col-span-2">
                <label className="mb-1 block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700">Food Type *</label>
                <div className="flex gap-3">
                  {FOOD_TYPE_OPTIONS.map((opt) => (
                    <button
                      key={opt.value}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setItemForm({ ...itemForm, foodType: opt.value })}
                      className={`flex-1 rounded-xl border-2 px-4 py-3 text-center text-sm font-bold transition ${itemForm.foodType === opt.value ? (opt.value === 'veg' ? 'border-emerald-500 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700' : 'border-rose-500 bg-rose-50 text-rose-700') : 'border-slate-200 bg-white text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50'}`}
                    >
                      {opt.value === 'veg' ? '🥬 Veg' : '🍗 Non-Veg'}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={savingItem}
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl bg-orange-500 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-bold text-white hover:bg-orange-600 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
              >
                {savingItem && <Loader2 size={14} className="animate-spin" />}
                {savingItem ? 'Saving…' : editingItemId ? 'Update Dish' : 'Add Dish'}
              </button>
              <button type="button" disabled={savingItem} onClick={resetForm} className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50 disabled:opacity-50">
                Cancel
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Categories and Items */}
      {categories.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="rounded-[20px] border border-dashed border-slate-300 bg-white p-8 text-center">
          <p className="text-slate-500">No menu categories yet.</p>
          <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-400">Create a category and add dishes.</p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          {categories.map((category) => (
            <div key={category.id} className="rounded-[20px] border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4">
              <div className="mb-3 flex items-center justify-between">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-orange-600">{category.name}</h3>
                  <span className="rounded-full bg-slate-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-600">
                    {menu.filter((item) => item.categoryId === category.id).length} items
                  </span>
                  <span className={`rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold ${
                    category.active ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700' : 'bg-slate-200 text-slate-600'
                  }`}>
                    {category.active ? 'Active' : 'Inactive'}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex gap-1">
                  <button
                    onClick={() => {
                      const newName = window.prompt('Rename category', category.name)
                      if (newName && newName.trim()) {
                        try {
                          renameCategory(category.id, newName.trim())
                          setMenuError('')
                        } catch (err) {
                          setMenuError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Could not rename category')
                        }
                      }
                    }}
                    className="rounded-lg bg-slate-100 px-2 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-200"
                  >
                    Rename
                  </button>
                  {category.active && (
                    <button
                      onClick={() => {
                        try {
                          deactivateCategory(category.id)
                          setMenuError('')
                        } catch (err) {
                          setMenuError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Could not deactivate category')
                        }
                      }}
                      className="rounded-lg bg-red-100 px-2 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-red-700 hover:bg-red-200"
                    >
                      Deactivate
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                {menu.filter((item) => item.categoryId === category.id).map((item) => {
                  const special = isSpecialToday(item)
                  return (
                    <div key={item.id} className={`flex items-center justify-between rounded-xl p-3 ${special ? 'bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200' : 'bg-slate-50'}`}>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 flex-1">
                        {/* Dish Image Thumbnail */}
                        {item.imageUrl ? (
                          <img
                            src={item.imageUrl}
                            alt={item.imageAlt || item.name}
                            className="h-12 w-12 rounded-lg object-cover"
                          />
                        ) : (
                          <div className="flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-slate-200">
                            <ImageIcon size={20} className="text-slate-400" />
                          </div>
                        )}
                        <div className="flex-1">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <p className="font-semibold text-slate-900">{item.name}</p>
                            {special && (
                              <span className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full bg-amber-200 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-amber-800">
                                <Star size={8} />
                                Today's Special
                              </span>
                            )}
                          </div>
                          {item.description && (
                            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 line-clamp-1">{item.description}</p>
                          )}
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-xs text-slate-500">
                            <span className="font-bold text-orange-600">₹{item.price}</span>
                            <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                              <Clock size={10} />
                              {item.preparationTime} min
                            </span>
                            {!item.active && (
                              <span className="rounded bg-slate-200 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-bold text-slate-600">DISABLED</span>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                        {/* Today's Special Date Picker */}
                        {showSpecialDatePicker === item.id ? (
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                            <input
                              type="date"
                              value={specialDateValue || item.specialDate || todayStr}
                              onChange={(e) => setSpecialDateValue(e.target.value)}
                              className="rounded border border-slate-200 px-1 py-0.5 text-xs"
                              min={todayStr}
                            />
                            <button
                              onClick={() => handleSetSpecialDate(item.id)}
                              className="rounded bg-amber-500 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-bold text-white hover:bg-amber-600"
                            >
                              Set
                            </button>
                            <button
                              onClick={() => setShowSpecialDatePicker(null)}
                              className="rounded bg-slate-200 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-bold text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-300"
                            >
                              <X size={10} />
                            </button>
                          </div>
                        ) : (
                          <button
                            onClick={() => {
                              setShowSpecialDatePicker(item.id)
                              setSpecialDateValue(item.specialDate || todayStr)
                            }}
                            className={`rounded-lg px-2 py-1 text-xs font-semibold transition ${
                              special
                                ? 'bg-amber-200 text-amber-800 hover:bg-amber-300'
                                : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 hover:bg-amber-100 hover:text-amber-700'
                            }`}
                            title={item.specialDate ? `Special: ${item.specialDate}` : "Set as Today's Special"}
                          >
                            <Star size={12} className={special ? 'text-amber-600' : ''} />
                          </button>
                        )}
                        {item.specialDate && (
                          <button
                            onClick={() => handleClearSpecialDate(item.id)}
                            className="rounded-lg bg-red-100 px-2 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-red-700 hover:bg-red-200"
                            title="Remove special date"
                          >
                            <X size={10} />
                          </button>
                        )}
                        {/* Edit */}
                        <button
                          onClick={() => { setMenuError(''); handleEditItem(item.id) }}
                          className="rounded-lg bg-blue-100 px-2 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-blue-700 hover:bg-blue-200"
                        >
                          <Edit2 size={12} />
                        </button>
                        {/* Availability */}
                        <button
                          onClick={() => {
                            try {
                              toggleMenuItemAvailability(item.id, !item.available)
                              setMenuError('')
                            } catch (err) {
                              setMenuError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Could not update availability')
                            }
                          }}
                          className={`rounded-lg px-2 py-1 text-xs font-semibold transition ${
                            item.available
                              ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 hover:bg-emerald-200'
                              : 'bg-red-100 text-red-700 hover:bg-red-200'
                          }`}
                        >
                          {item.available ? 'On' : 'Off'}
                        </button>
                        {/* Active/Deactivate */}
                        <button
                          onClick={() => {
                            try {
                              setMenuItemActive(item.id, !item.active)
                              setMenuError('')
                            } catch (err) {
                              setMenuError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Could not toggle dish status')
                            }
                          }}
                          className={`rounded-lg px-2 py-1 text-xs font-semibold transition ${
                            item.active
                              ? 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-200'
                              : 'bg-slate-300 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-400'
                          }`}
                        >
                          {item.active ? 'Active' : 'Inactive'}
                        </button>
                        {/* Delete */}
                        <button
                          onClick={() => {
                            if (window.confirm(`Delete "${item.name}" from the menu? This cannot be undone.`)) {
                              try {
                                deleteMenuItem(item.id)
                                setMenuError('')
                              } catch (err) {
                                setMenuError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Could not delete dish')
                              }
                            }
                          }}
                          className="rounded-lg bg-red-100 px-2 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-red-700 hover:bg-red-200"
                          title="Delete dish"
                        >
                          <X size={12} />
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )
                })}
                {menu.filter((item) => item.categoryId === category.id).length === 0 && (
                  <p className="text-sm text-slate-400">No items in this category.</p>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

import { useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import { useRestaurant } from '../context/RestaurantContext'
import { useKdsNow, computeKdsPriority, formatCountdown, sortKdsByPriority } from '../lib/orderPriority'
import { usePrintQueue, retryPrint } from '../services/print/printService'
import { formatOrderToken } from '../lib/tokenSequence'
import { servingSuffix } from '../lib/servingType'
import { Flame, CheckCircle2, Printer, RotateCcw } from 'lucide-react'

type Filter = 'ALL' | 'INCOMING' | 'PREPARING' | 'READY' | 'OVERDUE' | 'VIP'
const FILTERS: Filter[] = ['ALL', 'INCOMING', 'PREPARING', 'READY', 'OVERDUE', 'VIP']

const maxPrep = (order: { items: { menuItemId: string }[] }, prep: Map<string, number>): number =>
  order.items.reduce((acc, i) => Math.max(acc, prep.get(i.menuItemId) ?? 0), 1)

export default function SupervisorOrderBoard() {
  const { orders, tables, sessions, menu, updateOrderStatus, setOrderReady } = useRestaurant()
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<Filter>('ALL')
  const now = useKdsNow(15_000)
  const printJobs = usePrintQueue()
  const prepById = useMemo(() => new Map(menu.map((m) => [m.id, Number(m.preparationTime) || 0])), [menu])

  const activeOrders = orders.filter((o) => o.status === 'confirmed' || o.status === 'preparing' || o.status === 'ready')
  const enriched = activeOrders.map((order) => {
    const isVip = order.isVip ?? tables.find((t) => t.id === order.tableId)?.isVip ?? false
    const info = computeKdsPriority(
      { status: order.status, createdAt: order.createdAt, preparingAt: order.preparingAt ?? order.preparationStartedAt ?? null,
        estimatedReadyAt: order.estimatedReadyAt ?? null, prepMinutes: maxPrep(order, prepById), isVip, manualPriority: order.priority },
      now
    )
    return { id: order.id, order, info, isVip }
  })

  const match = (e: (typeof enriched)[number]): boolean => {
    if (filter === 'INCOMING') return e.order.status === 'confirmed'
    if (filter === 'PREPARING') return e.order.status === 'preparing'
    if (filter === 'READY') return e.order.status === 'ready'
    if (filter === 'OVERDUE') return e.info.isOverdue
    if (filter === 'VIP') return e.isVip
    return true
  }
  const sorted = sortKdsByPriority(enriched.filter(match), (e) => e.info, (e) => e.order.createdAt)

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
        {FILTERS.map((f) => (
          <button key={f} onClick={() => setFilter(f)}
            className={`rounded-full px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold ${filter === f ? 'bg-orange-500 text-white' : 'bg-orange-50 text-orange-700 hover:bg-orange-100'}`}>
            {f}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
      {sorted.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="rounded-[20px] border border-dashed border-slate-300 bg-white p-8 text-center"><p className="text-slate-500">No matching orders.</p></div>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3">
          {sorted.map(({ order, info, isVip }) => {
            const table = tables.find((t) => t.id === order.tableId)
            const session = sessions.find((s) => s.id === order.sessionId)
            return (
              <div key={order.id} className={`rounded-[20px] border p-4 shadow-sm ${info.isOverdue ? 'border-red-400 bg-red-50 animate-pulse' : 'border-orange-100 bg-white'}`}>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <p className="text-lg font-black text-slate-900">{order.tokenNumber ? `${order.orderType === 'parcel' ? 'PARCEL' : 'TOKEN'} ${formatOrderToken(order)}` : 'DRAFT'}</p>
                  <span className={`rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold ${order.status === 'confirmed' ? 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-700' : order.status === 'preparing' ? 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700' : 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700'}`}>
                    {order.status.toUpperCase()}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">Table {table?.name ?? 'Unknown'} · {session?.guestCount ?? 0} guests</p>
                {order.items.map((item) => (
                  <div key={item.id} className="rounded-lg bg-slate-50 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-sm">
                    <span className="font-semibold text-slate-800">{item.nameSnapshot}{servingSuffix(item.servingType)}</span>
                    <span className="text-slate-500"> × {item.quantity}</span>
                    {item.specialRequests && <div className="text-[11px] font-bold text-orange-700">!! {item.specialRequests} !!</div>}
                  </div>
                ))}
                <div className="mt-1 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
                  {info.isOverdue ? (
                    <span className="rounded-full bg-red-600 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-white">{isVip ? '⭐ VIP · ' : '🔴 '}OVERDUE BY {info.overdueMinutes} MIN</span>
                  ) : (
                    <span className={`rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold ${isVip ? 'bg-violet-100 text-violet-700' : info.isDueSoon ? 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700' : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600'}`}>
                      {isVip ? '⭐ VIP' : info.isDueSoon ? `DUE SOON · ${formatCountdown(info)}` : 'NORMAL'}
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>
                {order.status === 'confirmed' && (
                  <button onClick={() => updateOrderStatus(order.id, 'preparing')} className="mt-3 w-full rounded-xl bg-orange-500 px-3 py-2 text-sm font-bold text-white hover:bg-orange-600"><Flame size={15} className="mr-1.5" /> Start Preparing</button>
                )}
                {order.status === 'preparing' && (
                  <button onClick={() => setOrderReady(order.id)} className="mt-3 w-full rounded-xl bg-emerald-500 px-3 py-2 text-sm font-bold text-white hover:bg-emerald-600"><CheckCircle2 size={15} className="mr-1.5" /> Mark Ready</button>
                )}
              </div>
            )
          })}
        </div>
      )}
      {/* Print queue */}
      <div className="rounded-[20px] border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4">
        <h3 className="mb-2 flex items-center gap-2 font-bold text-slate-800"><Printer size={16} className="text-orange-500" /> Print Queue</h3>
        {printJobs.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">No print jobs.</p>
        ) : (
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            {printJobs.map((job) => (
              <div key={job.id} className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-lg bg-slate-50 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs">
                <span>{job.kind === 'token' ? `Token · ${job.referenceId.slice(-6)}` : 'Bill'}</span>
                <span className={`font-bold ${job.status === 'FAILED' ? 'text-red-600' : job.status === 'PRINTED' ? 'text-emerald-600' : 'text-amber-600'}`}>{job.status}</span>
                {job.status === 'FAILED' && (
                  <button onClick={() => retryPrint(job.id)} className="flex items-center gap-1 text-orange-600"><RotateCcw size={12} /> Retry</button>
                )}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

/**
 * Bee's Hive — Supervisor Recipe Management
 * Configure Dish → ingredient → quantity → unit. Saved recipes drive
 * real ingredient consumption when orders enter preparation.
 */
import { useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import { useRestaurant } from '../context/RestaurantContext'
import type { RecipeIngredient } from '../context/RestaurantContext'
import { Plus, Trash2, Save } from 'lucide-react'

export default function SupervisorRecipeManagement() {
  const { menu, inventory, recipes, saveRecipe } = useRestaurant()
  const [selectedItemId, setSelectedItemId] = useState<string>('')
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<{ kind: 'ok' | 'error'; text: string } | null>(null)
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<RecipeIngredient[]>([])
  const [draftFor, setDraftFor] = useState<string>('')

  const activeMenu = useMemo(() => menu.filter((m) => m.active), [menu])
  const selectedItem = activeMenu.find((m) => m.id === selectedItemId)
  const existingRecipe = useMemo(
    () => recipes.find((r) => r.menuItemId === selectedItemId),
    [recipes, selectedItemId],
  )

  // Load the current recipe into the editor whenever a different dish is selected.
  if (selectedItemId && draftFor !== selectedItemId) {
    setDraftFor(selectedItemId)
    setDraft(
      existingRecipe
        ? existingRecipe.ingredients.map((ing) => ({ ...ing }))
        : [{ inventoryItemId: inventory[0]?.id ?? '', name: inventory[0]?.name ?? '', quantity: 0, unit: inventory[0]?.unit ?? '' }],
    )
  }

  const updateRow = (index: number, patch: Partial<RecipeIngredient>) => {
    setDraft((prev) => prev.map((row, i) => {
      if (i !== index) return row
      if (patch.inventoryItemId) {
        const inv = inventory.find((item) => item.id === patch.inventoryItemId)
        return { ...row, ...patch, name: inv?.name ?? row.name, unit: inv?.unit ?? row.unit }
      }
      return { ...row, ...patch }
    }))
  }

  const handleSave = () => {
    if (!selectedItemId) return
    try {
      saveRecipe(selectedItemId, draft)
      setStatus({ kind: 'ok', text: `Recipe saved for ${selectedItem?.name}. Ingredient consumption is now live.` })
    } catch (e) {
      setStatus({ kind: 'error', text: e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Failed to save recipe' })
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div>
        <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-900">Recipe Configuration</h2>
        <p className="text-sm text-slate-500">
          Map each dish to its ingredients. When an order starts preparation, exactly these quantities
          (× order quantity) are deducted from inventory. Dishes without a recipe show
          &ldquo;No recipe configured&rdquo; and do not deduct ingredients.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div className="rounded-[20px] border border-orange-100 bg-white p-5">
        <label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.15em] text-slate-500">Dish</label>
        <select
          value={selectedItemId}
          onChange={(e) => { setSelectedItemId(e.target.value); setStatus(null) }}
          className="w-full max-w-md rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-3 py-2 text-sm"
        >
          <option value="">Select a dish…</option>
          {activeMenu.map((m) => (
            <option key={m.id} value={m.id}>{m.name} · ₹{m.price}</option>
          ))}
        </select>

        {selectedItemId && (
          <div className="mt-4 space-y-3">
            {existingRecipe ? (
              <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-700">
                Recipe configured · {existingRecipe.ingredients.length} ingredient(s) · updated {new Date(existingRecipe.updatedAt).toLocaleString()}
              </p>
            ) : (
              <p className="rounded-xl bg-amber-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-amber-700">No recipe configured</p>
            )}

            {draft.map((row, index) => (
              <div key={index} className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                <select
                  value={row.inventoryItemId}
                  onChange={(e) => updateRow(index, { inventoryItemId: e.target.value })}
                  className="min-w-50 flex-1 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-3 py-2 text-sm"
                >
                  <option value="">Select ingredient…</option>
                  {inventory.map((item) => (
                    <option key={item.id} value={item.id}>{item.name} ({item.unit})</option>
                  ))}
                </select>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  min="0"
                  step="0.01"
                  value={row.quantity || ''}
                  placeholder="Qty per serving"
                  onChange={(e) => updateRow(index, { quantity: Number(e.target.value) })}
                  className="w-36 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-3 py-2 text-sm"
                />
                <span className="w-12 text-sm text-slate-500">{row.unit || '—'}</span>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setDraft((prev) => prev.filter((_, i) => i !== index))}
                  className="rounded-lg p-2 text-slate-400 transition hover:bg-red-50 hover:text-red-600"
                  aria-label="Remove ingredient"
                >
                  <Trash2 size={16} />
                </button>
              </div>
            ))}

            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setDraft((prev) => [...prev, { inventoryItemId: '', name: '', quantity: 0, unit: '' }])}
                className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-3 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 transition hover:bg-slate-50"
              >
                <Plus size={14} /> Add ingredient
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleSave}
                className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-xl bg-orange-600 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-orange-700"
              >
                <Save size={14} /> Save recipe
              </button>
            </div>

            {status && (
              <p className={`text-sm font-semibold ${status.kind === 'ok' ? 'text-emerald-700' : 'text-red-600'}`}>{status.text}</p>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="rounded-[20px] border border-orange-100 bg-white p-5">
        <h3 className="mb-3 text-sm font-bold text-slate-900">Configured recipes ({recipes.length})</h3>
        {recipes.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-500">No recipes configured yet.</p>
        ) : (
          <div className="space-y-2">
            {recipes.map((recipe) => {
              const dish = menu.find((m) => m.id === recipe.menuItemId)
              return (
                <div key={recipe.id} className="rounded-xl bg-slate-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm">
                  <p className="font-semibold text-slate-900">{dish?.name ?? recipe.menuItemId}</p>
                  <p className="text-slate-600">
                    {recipe.ingredients.map((ing) => `${ing.name} ${ing.quantity}${ing.unit}`).join(' · ')}
                  </p>
                </div>
              )
            })}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

import { useState } from 'react'
import { ListFilter, Search, X, MapPin, RotateCcw, ArrowUpDown, Crown } from 'lucide-react'
import {
  activeTableFacetCount,
  isTableFilterActive,
  TABLE_STATUS_FILTER_OPTIONS,
  TABLE_CAPACITY_FILTER_OPTIONS,
  TABLE_SORT_OPTIONS,
  type TableFilter,
  type TableStatusFilter,
  type TableSort,
} from '../lib/tableFilters'

interface TableFilterBarProps {
  filter: TableFilter
  updateFilter: (patch: Partial<TableFilter>) => void
  resetFilter: () => void
  search: string
  setSearch: (next: string) => void
  /** Area labels present on the current floor, already ordered. */
  areaOptions: string[]
  /** Optional table count per area label (rendered next to the chip). */
  areaCounts?: Record<string, number>
  /** Tables remaining after filtering — shown as "Showing X of Y". */
  matched: number
  total: number
  placeholder?: string
}

/**
 * Shared "fetch the required tables" control for every table surface:
 * admin Table Management, waiter Tables (Floor Status) and waiter Sessions
 * (Table Floor). Replaces the per-screen area-chip + search row with one
 * identical control that also sorts and can narrow by status, seats and VIP.
 */
export default function TableFilterBar({
  filter,
  updateFilter,
  resetFilter,
  search,
  setSearch,
  areaOptions,
  areaCounts,
  matched,
  total,
  placeholder = 'Search tables…',
}: TableFilterBarProps) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
  const facetCount = activeTableFacetCount(filter)
  const filtered = isTableFilterActive(filter)

  const selectClass =
    'w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200/90 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-800 shadow-2xs outline-none transition focus:border-orange-500 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-orange-500/20'

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
      {/* Top Control Bar */}
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-2.5 lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between">
        
        {/* Area chips — Horizontal scrollable on mobile screens */}
        <div className="no-scrollbar -mx-2 flex items-center gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto px-2 py-0.5 sm:mx-0 sm:px-0 sm:flex-wrap">
          <button
            onClick={() => updateFilter({ area: null })}
            className={`shrink-0 touch-manipulation rounded-full px-3 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider transition-all duration-150 active:scale-95 ${
              filter.area === null
                ? 'bg-linear-to-r from-orange-500 to-amber-500 text-white shadow-sm shadow-orange-500/20'
                : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 hover:bg-orange-100/70 hover:text-orange-800'
            }`}
          >
            ALL
          </button>
          
          {areaOptions.map((area) => {
            const isSelected = filter.area === area
            const count = areaCounts?.[area]

            return (
              <button
                key={area}
                onClick={() => updateFilter({ area: isSelected ? null : area })}
                className={`shrink-0 touch-manipulation flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full px-3 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-bold transition-all duration-150 active:scale-95 ${
                  isSelected
                    ? 'bg-linear-to-r from-orange-500 to-amber-500 text-white shadow-sm shadow-orange-500/20'
                    : 'bg-slate-100/90 text-slate-600 hover:bg-orange-100/70 hover:text-orange-800'
                }`}
              >
                <MapPin size={11} className={isSelected ? 'text-white' : 'text-slate-400'} />
                <span>{area}</span>
                {count !== undefined && (
                  <span
                    className={`rounded-full px-1.5 py-0.2 text-[10px] font-extrabold ${
                      isSelected ? 'bg-white/20 text-white' : 'bg-slate-200/80 text-slate-600'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {count}
                  </span>
                )}
              </button>
            )
          })}
        </div>

        {/* Search Input and Action Buttons */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          {/* Search Box */}
          <div className="relative flex-1 sm:w-60 lg:w-64">
            <Search size={14} className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400" />
            <input
              type="text"
              value={search}
              onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
              placeholder={placeholder}
              className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200/90 bg-white py-2 pl-8 pr-8 text-xs font-medium text-slate-800 placeholder-slate-400 shadow-2xs outline-none transition focus:border-orange-500 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-orange-500/20"
            />
            {search && (
              <button
                onClick={() => setSearch('')}
                className="absolute right-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 rounded-full p-0.5 text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-slate-600 active:scale-90 transition"
                aria-label="Clear search"
              >
                <X size={13} />
              </button>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Filters Panel Toggle Button */}
          <button
            onClick={() => setOpen((v) => !v)}
            aria-expanded={open}
            className={`touch-manipulation flex items-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs font-bold transition-all duration-150 active:scale-95 ${
              open || facetCount > 0
                ? 'border-orange-300 bg-orange-50 text-orange-700 shadow-2xs'
                : 'border-slate-200 bg-white text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50'
            }`}
          >
            <ListFilter size={14} />
            <span className="hidden sm:inline">Filters</span>
            {facetCount > 0 && (
              <span className="rounded-full bg-orange-500 px-1.5 py-0.2 text-[10px] font-black text-white shadow-2xs">
                {facetCount}
              </span>
            )}
          </button>

          {/* Quick Clear All Button */}
          {(filtered || search) && (
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                resetFilter()
                setSearch('')
              }}
              className="touch-manipulation flex items-center gap-1 whitespace-nowrap rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-2.5 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-slate-600 transition hover:bg-slate-100 active:scale-95"
              title="Clear all table filters"
            >
              <X size={13} />
              <span className="hidden sm:inline">Clear</span>
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Expandable Filter Facets Drawer */}
      {open && (
        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-orange-200/80 bg-linear-to-b from-orange-50/70 to-amber-50/30 p-3.5 shadow-sm backdrop-blur-sm transition-all">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 lg:grid-cols-4">
            <label className="block">
              <span className="mb-1 block text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">
                Status
              </span>
              <select
                value={filter.status}
                onChange={(e) => updateFilter({ status: e.target.value as TableStatusFilter })}
                className={selectClass}
              >
                {TABLE_STATUS_FILTER_OPTIONS.map((o) => (
                  <option key={o.value} value={o.value}>
                    {o.label}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </label>

            <label className="block">
              <span className="mb-1 block text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">
                Seats Capacity
              </span>
              <select
                value={filter.minCapacity === null ? '' : String(filter.minCapacity)}
                onChange={(e) => updateFilter({ minCapacity: e.target.value === '' ? null : Number(e.target.value) })}
                className={selectClass}
              >
                {TABLE_CAPACITY_FILTER_OPTIONS.map((o) => (
                  <option key={o.label} value={o.value === null ? '' : String(o.value)}>
                    {o.label}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </label>

            <label className="block">
              <span className="mb-1 block text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">
                Area Section
              </span>
              <select
                value={filter.area ?? ''}
                onChange={(e) => updateFilter({ area: e.target.value === '' ? null : e.target.value })}
                className={selectClass}
              >
                <option value="">All areas</option>
                {areaOptions.map((area) => (
                  <option key={area} value={area}>
                    {area}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </label>

            <label className="block">
              <span className="mb-1 flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">
                <ArrowUpDown size={11} /> Sort by
              </span>
              <select
                value={filter.sort}
                onChange={(e) => updateFilter({ sort: e.target.value as TableSort })}
                className={selectClass}
              >
                {TABLE_SORT_OPTIONS.map((o) => (
                  <option key={o.value} value={o.value}>
                    {o.label}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </label>
          </div>

          {/* Bottom Row: Checkbox & Count Summary */}
          <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 border-t border-orange-200/60 pt-3">
            <label className="inline-flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 touch-manipulation text-xs font-bold text-slate-800">
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={filter.vipOnly}
                onChange={(e) => updateFilter({ vipOnly: e.target.checked })}
                className="h-4 w-4 rounded-md border-slate-300 text-orange-500 accent-orange-500 focus:ring-orange-400"
              />
              <Crown size={14} className="text-amber-500 fill-amber-400/20" />
              <span>VIP tables only</span>
            </label>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
              <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500">
                Showing <strong className="font-extrabold text-slate-900">{matched}</strong> of {total}
              </span>
              {filtered && (
                <button
                  onClick={resetFilter}
                  className="touch-manipulation flex items-center gap-1 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-bold text-slate-600 transition hover:bg-slate-100 active:scale-95 shadow-2xs"
                >
                  <RotateCcw size={11} /> Reset
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}
