import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import { useRestaurant } from '../context/RestaurantContext'
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext'
import { Users, X, BellRing, Plus, Timer, Ban, DoorOpen, Clock, UtensilsCrossed, MapPin, Receipt } from 'lucide-react'
import { groupTablesByArea, tableArea, UNASSIGNED_AREA } from '../lib/tableAreas'
import { applyTableFilters, useTableFilter } from '../lib/tableFilters'
import { useViewPreference, viewPreferenceKeys } from '../lib/viewPreference'
import { SessionCapacityExceededError } from '../services/firebase/sessionCapacityService'
import TableFilterBar from './TableFilterBar'
import ViewModeSelect from './ViewModeSelect'
import PrintPreview from './PrintPreview'

/** Session tile layouts (the existing Small / Medium / Large / List designs). */
const SESSION_VIEW_MODES = ['small', 'medium', 'large', 'list'] as const
type SessionViewMode = (typeof SESSION_VIEW_MODES)[number]

const SESSION_VIEW_OPTIONS = [
  { id: 'small', label: 'Small' },
  { id: 'medium', label: 'Medium' },
  { id: 'large', label: 'Large' },
  { id: 'list', label: 'List' },
] as const satisfies readonly { id: SessionViewMode; label: string }[]

interface WaiterTableAllocationProps {
  onSessionCreated: (sessionId: string, tableId: string) => void
  onOpenSession: (sessionId: string, tableId: string) => void
  /** TableId arriving from the Tables tab tile tap — auto-opens the session dialog */
  pendingTableId?: string | null
  onConsumedPendingTable?: () => void
}

export default function WaiterTableAllocation({
  onSessionCreated,
  onOpenSession,
  pendingTableId,
  onConsumedPendingTable,
}: WaiterTableAllocationProps) {
  const {
    tables,
    orders,
    sessions,
    createSession,
    getActiveSessionsForTable,
    getTableOccupancy,
    requestService,
    cancelSession,
    extendSession,
    closeSession,
    completeCleaning,
    printSessionReceipt,
  } = useRestaurant()
  const { user } = useAuth()
  const activeTables = tables.filter((t) => t.active && t.status !== 'cleaning')
  const [showDialog, setShowDialog] = useState(false)
  const [selectedTableId, setSelectedTableId] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [guestCount, setGuestCount] = useState(2)
  const [customerName, setCustomerName] = useState('')
  const [customerContact, setCustomerContact] = useState('')
  const [stayMinutes, setStayMinutes] = useState(60)
  const [error, setError] = useState('')
  const [actionError, setActionError] = useState('')
  const [now, setNow] = useState(Date.now())
  const [confirmAction, setConfirmAction] = useState<{
    type: 'cancel' | 'free'
    sessionId: string
    tableId: string
    tableName: string
  } | null>(null)
  const [extendAction, setExtendAction] = useState<{ sessionId: string; tableName: string } | null>(null)
  const [sessionMenu, setSessionMenu] = useState<{ sessionId: string; tableId: string; tableName: string } | null>(null)
  const [extendMinutes, setExtendMinutes] = useState(60)
  // Compute current session's orders when the session menu is open.
  const sessionOrders = sessionMenu ? orders.filter((o) => o.sessionId === sessionMenu.sessionId && o.status !== 'cancelled') : []
  // UI-only preference: survives tab switches, navigation and a page refresh.
  const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useViewPreference<SessionViewMode>(
    viewPreferenceKeys.waiterSessions,
    'medium',
    SESSION_VIEW_MODES,
  )
  // Active Sessions honours the SAME view preference as the table floor so the
  // section stays compact and usable (especially on smaller screens) instead
  // of always rendering oversized cards.
  const activeSessionsGridClass =
    viewMode === 'list'
      ? 'space-y-2'
      : viewMode === 'small'
        ? 'grid grid-cols-1 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4'
        : viewMode === 'large'
          ? 'grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 lg:grid-cols-2'
          : 'grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 lg:grid-cols-2'
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false)
  // Queued session-receipt job whose preview is open on screen.
  const [receiptJobId, setReceiptJobId] = useState<string | null>(null)

  // Shared table filter + sort + free-text search (area, status, seats, VIP, order).
  const { filter, updateFilter, resetFilter, search, setSearch } = useTableFilter()

  // Distinct areas currently in the floor
  const floorAreaOptions = useMemo(() => {
    const known = ['Indoor', 'Outdoor', 'Garden', 'Terrace', 'Private Room']
    const seen = new Set<string>()
    const ordered = known.filter((a) => {
      if (activeTables.some((t) => tableArea(t) === a)) {
        seen.add(a)
        return true
      }
      return false
    })
    const custom = Array.from(new Set(activeTables.map((t) => tableArea(t))))
      .filter((a) => !known.includes(a) && a !== UNASSIGNED_AREA && !seen.has(a))
      .sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b))
    return [...ordered, ...custom]
  }, [activeTables])

  const areaCounts = useMemo(() => {
    const countsByArea: Record<string, number> = {}
    activeTables.forEach((t) => {
      const area = tableArea(t)
      countsByArea[area] = (countsByArea[area] ?? 0) + 1
    })
    return countsByArea
  }, [activeTables])

  // Tables shown on the floor after applying every filter facet + search + sort.
  const activeSessionEntries = useMemo(() => sessions
    .filter((session) => (session.status === 'active' || session.status === 'payment_pending') && session.waiterId === user?.id)
    .map((session) => ({
      session,
      table: tables.find((table) => table.id === session.tableId),
    }))
    .filter((entry): entry is { session: typeof sessions[number]; table: typeof tables[number] } => Boolean(entry.table))
    .sort((a, b) => b.session.startTime - a.session.startTime), [sessions, tables, user?.id])

  const activeSessionTableIds = useMemo(() => new Set(activeSessionEntries.map((entry) => entry.table.id)), [activeSessionEntries])
  const floorTables = useMemo(
    () => applyTableFilters(activeTables.filter((table) => !activeSessionTableIds.has(table.id)), filter, search),
    [activeTables, activeSessionTableIds, filter, search]
  )

  // Tick every 15s so stay-time countdowns stay current
  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setInterval(() => setNow(Date.now()), 15000)
    return () => clearInterval(timer)
  }, [])

  // Auto-close the session popup if its session is gone
  useEffect(() => {
    if (sessionMenu && !sessions.some((x) => x.id === sessionMenu.sessionId)) setSessionMenu(null)
  }, [sessions, sessionMenu])

  // Handle pending table auto-open
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!pendingTableId) return
    const table = tables.find((t) => t.id === pendingTableId)
    if (!table?.id) {
      onConsumedPendingTable?.()
      return
    }
    const occupancy = getTableOccupancy(table.id)
    const tableSessions = getActiveSessionsForTable(table.id)
    const firstSession = tableSessions[0]
    if (firstSession?.id) {
      // Manage the existing session — its popup offers "Create Session" while
      // the table still has free seats for an independent second session.
      setSessionMenu({ sessionId: firstSession.id, tableId: table.id, tableName: table.name })
    } else if (occupancy.available > 0) {
      openCreateSessionFlow(table.id)
    } else {
      setError(`${table.name} is at full capacity — no seats available for a new session.`)
    }
    onConsumedPendingTable?.()
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [pendingTableId])

  const remainingMs = (expiresAt?: number) => (expiresAt ? expiresAt - now : null)

  const formatRemaining = (ms: number) => {
    const totalMin = Math.floor(ms / 60000)
    if (totalMin >= 60) return `${Math.floor(totalMin / 60)}h ${totalMin % 60}m`
    return `${totalMin}m`
  }

  const sessionTotal = (sessionId: string) =>
    orders.filter((o) => o.sessionId === sessionId).reduce((sum, o) => sum + o.totalAmount, 0)

  const handleStartSession = async () => {
    if (!selectedTableId || !user || submitting) return
    const table = tables.find((t) => t.id === selectedTableId)
    // Capacity is re-read from the live state on submit (not when the dialog was
    // opened): another waiter may have seated guests in the meantime.
    const occupancy = getTableOccupancy(selectedTableId)
    if (guestCount < 1) {
      setError('At least 1 guest required')
      return
    }
    if (occupancy.available <= 0) {
      setError(
        `${table?.name ?? 'This table'} is at full capacity (${occupancy.occupied}/${occupancy.capacity} seated) — no seats available for a new session.`,
      )
      return
    }
    if (guestCount > occupancy.available) {
      setError(
        `Only ${occupancy.available} seat(s) available on ${table?.name ?? 'this table'} — reduce the guest count to continue.`,
      )
      return
    }
    if (stayMinutes < 15) {
      setError('Stay duration must be at least 15 minutes')
      return
    }
    setSubmitting(true)
    try {
      const tableId = selectedTableId
      // `createSession` re-checks capacity against Firestore inside a
      // transaction and rejects without writing anything when the table is full.
      const session = await createSession(
        tableId,
        guestCount,
        user.id,
        customerName || undefined,
        customerContact || undefined,
        stayMinutes
      )
      const sessionId = session?.id
      if (!sessionId) {
        setError('Could not start the session — please try again.')
        return
      }
      setShowDialog(false)
      setSelectedTableId(null)
      setGuestCount(2)
      setCustomerName('')
      setCustomerContact('')
      setStayMinutes(60)
      setError('')
      onSessionCreated(sessionId, tableId)
    } catch (err) {
      // The table filled up (another waiter, or a retried transaction): the
      // dialog stays open with the freshly calculated capacity so the operator
      // can retry with fewer guests or pick another table.
      if (err instanceof SessionCapacityExceededError) {
        setError(`${table?.name ?? 'This table'} is full — ${err.message} The table capacity has been refreshed.`)
      } else {
        setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to create session')
      }
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false)
    }
  }

  const handleCancelSession = (sessionId: string) => {
    setActionError('')
    try {
      cancelSession(sessionId)
      setConfirmAction(null)
    } catch (err) {
      setConfirmAction(null)
      setActionError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to cancel session')
    }
  }

  const handleFreeTable = (sessionId: string, tableId: string) => {
    setActionError('')
    try {
      closeSession(sessionId)
      completeCleaning(tableId, sessionId)
    } catch (err) {
      setActionError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to free table')
    }
    setConfirmAction(null)
  }

  const handleExtend = async () => {
    if (!extendAction) return
    setActionError('')
    try {
      await extendSession(extendAction.sessionId, extendMinutes)
      setExtendAction(null)
      setExtendMinutes(60)
    } catch (err) {
      setActionError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to extend stay')
    }
  }

  /**
   * Open the normal "Start Dining Session" flow for a table that still has free
   * seats — used by the table tiles, the active-session cards and the
   * Manage Session popup, so a second (independent) session can be created for
   * the remaining seats without touching the session already running.
   */
  const openCreateSessionFlow = useCallback(
    (tableId: string) => {
      const occupancy = getTableOccupancy(tableId)
      if (occupancy.available <= 0) {
        const table = tables.find((t) => t.id === tableId)
        setActionError(
          `${table?.name ?? 'This table'} is at full capacity (${occupancy.occupied}/${occupancy.capacity} seated).`,
        )
        return
      }
      setSessionMenu(null)
      setSelectedTableId(tableId)
      setGuestCount(Math.min(2, occupancy.available))
      setStayMinutes(60)
      setError('')
      setShowDialog(true)
    },
    [getTableOccupancy, tables],
  )

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4 pb-8 sm:pb-0">
      {/* Header & Status Indicators */}
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
        <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-900">Table Floor</h2>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-600">
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-500"></span> Available
          </span>
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-orange-500"></span> Occupied
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Shared filter + sort control */}
      <TableFilterBar
        filter={filter}
        updateFilter={updateFilter}
        resetFilter={resetFilter}
        search={search}
        setSearch={setSearch}
        areaOptions={floorAreaOptions}
        areaCounts={areaCounts}
        matched={floorTables.length}
        total={activeTables.length}
        placeholder="Table no. / area…"
      />
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-orange-100 bg-white p-2 shadow-sm">
        <div>
          <p className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-700">Session view</p>
          <p className="hidden text-[11px] text-slate-400 sm:block">Active sessions appear first</p>
        </div>
        <ViewModeSelect
          value={viewMode}
          options={SESSION_VIEW_OPTIONS}
          onChange={setViewMode}
          label="Session view"
        />
      </div>

      {actionError && (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-red-700">
          {actionError}
        </div>
      )}

      {activeSessionEntries.length > 0 && (
        <section className="rounded-3x1 border border-orange-200 bg-linear-to-br from-orange-50 via-white to-amber-50 p-4 shadow-sm sm:p-5">
          <div className="mb-3 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <div>
              <h3 className="flex items-center gap-2 text-base font-black text-slate-900">
                <span className="h-2.5 w-2.5 animate-pulse rounded-full bg-emerald-500" />
                Active Sessions
              </h3>
              <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-slate-500">Manage open tables before starting a new session.</p>
            </div>
            <span className="rounded-full bg-orange-500 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-black text-white">{activeSessionEntries.length} live</span>
          </div>
          <div className={activeSessionsGridClass}>
            {activeSessionEntries.map(({ session, table }) => {
              const total = sessionTotal(session.id)
              const remaining = remainingMs(session.expiresAt)
              const expired = remaining !== null && remaining <= 0
              // Live occupancy of the physical table across ALL of its sessions:
              // a table may host several independent sessions while its combined
              // guest count stays within capacity.
              const occupancy = getTableOccupancy(table.id)
              return (
                <div key={session.id} className={`border border-orange-200 bg-white shadow-sm ${viewMode === 'list' || viewMode === 'small' ? 'rounded-xl p-2.5' : 'rounded-2xl p-3 sm:p-4'}`}>
                  <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                    <div>
                      <p className={`${viewMode === 'list' || viewMode === 'small' ? 'text-sm' : 'text-lg'} font-black text-slate-900`}>{table.name}</p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                        {session.customerName || `${session.guestCount} guests`} · {orders.filter((order) => order.sessionId === session.id).length} order(s)
                      </p>
                    </div>
                    <span className={`rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-black uppercase ${expired ? 'bg-red-100 text-red-700' : 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700'}`}>
                      {expired ? 'Time over' : 'Live'}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 gap-y-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-500">
                    <span>{occupancy.capacity} capacity</span>
                    <span className="text-slate-300">·</span>
                    <span>{occupancy.occupied} occupied</span>
                    <span className="text-slate-300">·</span>
                    <span className={occupancy.available > 0 ? 'text-emerald-600' : 'text-red-600'}>
                      {occupancy.available} available
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="mt-3 grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 p-2.5 text-xs">
                    <div><span className="block text-slate-400">Current total</span><strong className="text-base text-slate-900">₹{total.toFixed(0)}</strong></div>
                    <div><span className="block text-slate-400">Stay time</span><strong className={expired ? 'text-red-600' : 'text-slate-900'}>{remaining === null ? '—' : expired ? 'Expired' : `${formatRemaining(remaining)} left`}</strong></div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="mt-3 flex flex-col gap-2 sm:flex-row">
                    <button type="button" onClick={() => setSessionMenu({ sessionId: session.id, tableId: table.id, tableName: table.name })} className="flex-1 rounded-xl bg-orange-500 px-3 py-2.5 text-xs font-black text-white transition hover:bg-orange-600">
                      <UtensilsCrossed size={14} className="mr-1 inline" /> Manage Session
                    </button>
                    {occupancy.available > 0 && (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => openCreateSessionFlow(table.id)}
                        className="flex-1 rounded-xl border-2 border-emerald-500 bg-emerald-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-black text-emerald-700 transition hover:bg-emerald-100"
                      >
                        <Plus size={14} className="mr-1 inline" /> Create Session · {occupancy.available}{' '}
                        {occupancy.available === 1 ? 'seat' : 'seats'} available
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )
            })}
          </div>
        </section>
      )}

      {tables.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="rounded-[20px] border border-dashed border-slate-300 bg-white p-6 sm:p-8 text-center">
          <p className="text-slate-500">No tables configured yet.</p>
          <p className="mt-1 text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-400">Ask admin to add tables.</p>
        </div>
      ) : floorTables.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="rounded-[20px] border border-dashed border-slate-300 bg-white p-6 sm:p-8 text-center">
          <p className="text-slate-500">No tables match your filter.</p>
          <button
            onClick={() => {
              resetFilter()
              setSearch('')
            }}
            className="mt-3 rounded-lg bg-orange-100 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-orange-700 hover:bg-orange-200 active:scale-95 transition"
          >
            Clear filters
          </button>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-6">
          {groupTablesByArea(floorTables).map(({ area, tables: areaTables }) => (
            <section key={area} className="space-y-3">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                <MapPin size={16} className="shrink-0 text-orange-500" />
                <h3 className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-black uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-500">{area}</h3>
                <span className="rounded-full bg-slate-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-500">
                  {areaTables.length} table{areaTables.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}
                </span>
                <span className="rounded-full bg-emerald-50 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-emerald-700">
                  {areaTables.filter((t) => getTableOccupancy(t.id).available > 0).length} free
                </span>
                <div className="hidden sm:block h-px flex-1 bg-slate-200" />
              </div>

              <div className={
                viewMode === 'list'
                  ? 'space-y-2'
                  : viewMode === 'small'
                    ? 'grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4'
                    : viewMode === 'large'
                      ? 'grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2'
                      : 'grid grid-cols-1 gap-3.5 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3'
              }>
                {areaTables.map((table) => {
                  const tableSessions = getActiveSessionsForTable(table.id)
                  const occupancy = getTableOccupancy(table.id)
                  const canHost = occupancy.available > 0
                  return (
                    <div
                      key={table.id}
                      onClick={() => {
                        const active = tableSessions[0]
                        if (active?.id) {
                          setSessionMenu({ sessionId: active.id, tableId: table.id, tableName: table.name })
                        } else if (canHost) {
                          openCreateSessionFlow(table.id)
                        }
                      }}
                      role="button"
                      tabIndex={0}
                      className={`${viewMode === 'list' ? 'rounded-xl p-3' : 'rounded-[20px] p-3.5 sm:p-4'} border-2 text-left transition touch-manipulation active:scale-[0.99] ${
                        canHost || tableSessions.length > 0
                          ? 'cursor-pointer border-orange-200 bg-orange-50/60 hover:border-orange-400 hover:shadow-md'
                          : 'cursor-default border-orange-100 bg-orange-100/50'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div className="mb-2 flex items-center justify-between gap-1.5">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <h3 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-black text-slate-900">{table.name}</h3>
                          {table.isVip && (
                            <span className="rounded-full bg-amber-400 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-black text-amber-950">
                              VIP
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </div>
                        <span
                          className={`rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold ${
                            table.status === 'cleaning'
                              ? 'bg-violet-100 text-violet-700'
                              : table.status === 'available'
                              ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700'
                              : 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-700'
                          }`}
                        >
                          {table.status === 'occupied' ? 'Occupied' : table.status}
                        </span>
                      </div>

                      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 gap-y-1 text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-600">
                        <span className="flex items-center gap-1 font-medium">
                          <Users size={14} className="shrink-0" />
                          {occupancy.occupied}/{table.capacity} seated
                        </span>
                        <span className="text-slate-400">·</span>
                        <span className="text-slate-500">{occupancy.available} free</span>
                      </div>

                      {table.features && table.features.length > 0 && (
                        <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-1">
                          {table.features.map((f) => (
                            <span
                              key={f}
                              className="rounded-full bg-white px-2 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-semibold text-slate-600 border border-slate-200"
                            >
                              {f}
                            </span>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      )}

                      {tableSessions.map((session) => {
                        const total = sessionTotal(session.id)
                        const remaining = remainingMs(session.expiresAt)
                        const expired = remaining !== null && remaining <= 0
                        return (
                          <div
                            key={session.id}
                            className={`mt-2.5 rounded-xl p-2.5 text-xs ${
                              expired ? 'border border-red-300 bg-red-50' : 'bg-white shadow-sm'
                            }`}
                          >
                            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                              <span className="font-semibold text-slate-800 truncate">
                                {session.customerName ? session.customerName : `${session.guestCount} guests`}
                                {session.customerName && (
                                  <span className="ml-1 font-normal text-slate-500">· {session.guestCount}g</span>
                                )}
                              </span>
                              <span
                                className={`shrink-0 rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-bold ${
                                  expired ? 'bg-red-600 text-white' : 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700'
                                }`}
                              >
                                {session.status}
                              </span>
                            </div>

                            <div className="mt-1 flex items-center justify-between text-slate-500">
                              <span>
                                {orders.filter((o) => o.sessionId === session.id).length} order(s)
                              </span>
                              <span className="font-bold text-slate-900">₹{total.toFixed(0)}</span>
                            </div>

                            {session.expiresAt &&
                              (expired ? (
                                <div className="mt-1.5 flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg bg-red-100 px-2 py-1 font-bold text-red-700 text-[11px]">
                                  <Clock size={12} className="shrink-0" />
                                  <span>Stay time over — tap to extend or free</span>
                                </div>
                              ) : (
                                <div
                                  className={`mt-1 flex items-center gap-1 font-semibold text-[11px] ${
                                    remaining !== null && remaining < 10 * 60000 ? 'text-red-600' : 'text-slate-500'
                                  }`}
                                >
                                  <Timer size={12} className="shrink-0" />
                                  <span>
                                    {formatRemaining(remaining!)} left
                                    {session.extendedCount ? ` · +${session.extendedCount}x` : ''}
                                  </span>
                                </div>
                              ))}

                            <div className="mt-2 flex items-center justify-between border-t border-slate-100 pt-1.5">
                              <span className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-slate-400">Tap to manage</span>
                              <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-bold text-orange-600">
                                <UtensilsCrossed size={12} /> Manage
                              </span>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        )
                      })}

                      {canHost ? (
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={(e) => {
                            e.stopPropagation()
                            openCreateSessionFlow(table.id)
                          }}
                          className="mt-3 flex min-h-11 w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500 px-3 py-2.5 text-xs sm:text-sm font-black text-white shadow-sm transition hover:bg-emerald-600 active:scale-[0.98]"
                        >
                          <Plus size={16} />
                          Create Session
                          <span className="rounded-full bg-white/25 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold">
                            {occupancy.available} {occupancy.available === 1 ? 'seat' : 'seats'} available
                          </span>
                        </button>
                      ) : (
                        <div className="mt-3 rounded-xl bg-red-50 border border-red-200 px-2.5 py-2 text-center text-xs font-bold text-red-600">
                          Full capacity — {occupancy.occupied}/{table.capacity}
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  )
                })}
              </div>
            </section>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Allocation Dialog — Bottom Sheet on Mobile, Centered Modal on Desktop */}
      {showDialog && selectedTableId && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-end sm:items-center justify-center bg-black/50 p-0 sm:p-4 bh-modal-overlay">
          <div className="w-full max-w-md max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto rounded-t-3xl sm:rounded-3xl bg-white p-5 sm:p-6 shadow-2xl">
            <div className="mb-4 flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-100 pb-3">
              <h3 className="text-lg sm:text-xl font-bold text-slate-900">Start Dining Session</h3>
              <button
                onClick={() => setShowDialog(false)}
                className="rounded-full p-1 text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-slate-600"
              >
                <X size={20} />
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="mb-4 rounded-xl bg-orange-50 p-3">
              <p className="text-sm text-slate-700">
                Table: <span className="font-bold text-slate-900">{tables.find((t) => t.id === selectedTableId)?.name}</span>
              </p>
              <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-slate-500">
                {(() => {
                  const occ = getTableOccupancy(selectedTableId)
                  return `${occ.capacity} capacity · ${occ.occupied} occupied · ${occ.available} seat(s) available`
                })()}
              </p>
              <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-orange-700">
                This creates a NEW session for the remaining seats — existing sessions stay unchanged.
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div>
                <label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">Number of Guests *</label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  value={guestCount}
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    // Never let the input exceed the seats this table still has.
                    const available = getTableOccupancy(selectedTableId).available
                    const next = parseInt(e.target.value) || 1
                    setGuestCount(Math.min(Math.max(1, next), Math.max(1, available)))
                  }}
                  min="1"
                  max={Math.max(1, getTableOccupancy(selectedTableId).available)}
                  className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-2.5 text-sm outline-none focus:border-orange-400"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="mb-1 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
                  <Timer size={14} /> Stay duration (minutes) *
                </label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  value={stayMinutes}
                  onChange={(e) => setStayMinutes(parseInt(e.target.value) || 0)}
                  min="15"
                  step="15"
                  className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-2.5 text-sm outline-none focus:border-orange-400"
                />
                <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                  {[30, 60, 90, 120].map((m) => (
                    <button
                      key={m}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setStayMinutes(m)}
                      className={`min-h-9 rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold transition active:scale-95 ${
                        stayMinutes === m ? 'bg-orange-500 text-white' : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-200'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {m} min
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">Customer Name (optional)</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={customerName}
                  onChange={(e) => setCustomerName(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Guest name"
                  className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-2.5 text-sm outline-none focus:border-orange-400"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">Contact (optional)</label>
                <input
                  type="tel"
                  value={customerContact}
                  onChange={(e) => setCustomerContact(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Phone number"
                  className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-2.5 text-sm outline-none focus:border-orange-400"
                />
              </div>

              {error && <div className="rounded-xl bg-red-50 border border-red-200 px-3 py-2.5 text-xs text-red-700">{error}</div>}

              <button
                onClick={() => void handleStartSession()}
                disabled={submitting}
                className="flex min-h-12 w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-orange-500 px-4 py-3 font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-orange-600 active:scale-[0.98] disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
              >
                <Plus size={18} /> {submitting ? 'Starting…' : 'Start Dining Session'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Session Actions Popup — Bottom Sheet on Mobile */}
      {sessionMenu &&
        (() => {
          const s = sessions.find((x) => x.id === sessionMenu.sessionId)
          const menuOrderCount = orders.filter((o) => o.sessionId === sessionMenu.sessionId).length
          if (!s) return null
          // Capacity of the PHYSICAL table across all of its active sessions —
          // the remaining seats belong to the table, not to a single session.
          const occupancy = getTableOccupancy(sessionMenu.tableId)
          return (
            <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-end sm:items-center justify-center bg-black/50 p-0 sm:p-4 bh-modal-overlay">
              <div className="w-full max-w-md max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto rounded-t-3xl sm:rounded-3xl bg-white p-5 sm:p-6 shadow-2xl">
                <div className="mb-4 flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-100 pb-3">
                  <div>
                    <h3 className="text-lg sm:text-xl font-bold text-slate-900">{sessionMenu.tableName}</h3>
                    <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                      {s.customerName ? `${s.customerName} · ${s.guestCount} guests` : `${s.guestCount} guests`} · {menuOrderCount} orders · ₹{sessionTotal(s.id).toFixed(0)}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setSessionMenu(null)}
                    className="rounded-full p-1 text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-slate-600"
                  >
                    <X size={20} />
                  </button>
                </div>

                <div className="mb-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 gap-y-1 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 px-3 py-2 text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-500">
                  <span>{occupancy.capacity} capacity</span>
                  <span className="text-slate-300">·</span>
                  <span>{occupancy.occupied} occupied</span>
                  <span className="text-slate-300">·</span>
                  <span className={occupancy.available > 0 ? 'text-emerald-600' : 'text-red-600'}>
                    {occupancy.available} available
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2.5">
                  <button
                    onClick={() => {
                      setSessionMenu(null)
                      onOpenSession(sessionMenu.sessionId, sessionMenu.tableId)
                    }}
                    className="flex min-h-11 items-center justify-center sm:justify-start gap-2.5 rounded-xl bg-orange-100 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-orange-700 hover:bg-orange-200 active:scale-98"
                  >
                    <UtensilsCrossed size={18} /> Menu / Order
                  </button>

                  {occupancy.available > 0 && (
                    <button
                      onClick={() => openCreateSessionFlow(sessionMenu.tableId)}
                      className="flex min-h-11 items-center justify-center sm:justify-start gap-2.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-100 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-emerald-700 hover:bg-emerald-200 active:scale-98"
                    >
                      <Plus size={18} /> Create Session · {occupancy.available}{' '}
                      {occupancy.available === 1 ? 'seat' : 'seats'} available
                    </button>
                  )}

                  {s.serviceRequested ? (
                    <span className="flex min-h-11 items-center justify-center sm:justify-start gap-2.5 rounded-xl bg-red-600 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-white">
                      <BellRing size={18} /> Service Requested
                    </span>
                  ) : (
                    <button
                      onClick={() => {
                        requestService(sessionMenu.sessionId, sessionMenu.tableId, user?.id ?? '')
                        setSessionMenu(null)
                      }}
                      className="flex min-h-11 items-center justify-center sm:justify-start gap-2.5 rounded-xl bg-red-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-red-600 hover:bg-red-100 active:scale-98"
                    >
                      <BellRing size={18} /> Call Service
                    </button>
                  )}

                  <button
                    onClick={() => {
                      setExtendAction({ sessionId: sessionMenu.sessionId, tableName: sessionMenu.tableName })
                      setExtendMinutes(30)
                      setSessionMenu(null)
                    }}
                    className="flex min-h-11 items-center justify-center sm:justify-start gap-2.5 rounded-xl bg-sky-100 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-sky-700 hover:bg-sky-200 active:scale-98"
                  >
                    <Timer size={18} /> Extend Stay
                  </button>

                  {/* Session Receipt button — waiter can view/print current session summary.
                      This is NOT a payment/billing action. It does NOT record payment,
                      mark anything as PAID, or create a Bill document. Payment authority
                      remains with Admin only. */}
                  {sessionOrders.length > 0 && (
                    <button
                      onClick={() => {
                        const job = printSessionReceipt(sessionMenu.sessionId)
                        if (job) {
                          // Open the on-screen preview of the REAL payload —
                          // enqueueing alone displayed nothing, which read as a
                          // blank receipt. The queued job still flows to the
                          // print queue/relay unchanged.
                          setReceiptJobId(job.id)
                          setSessionMenu(null)
                        }
                      }}
                      className="flex min-h-11 items-center justify-center sm:justify-start gap-2.5 rounded-xl bg-purple-100 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-purple-700 hover:bg-purple-200 active:scale-98"
                    >
                      <Receipt size={18} /> Session Receipt
                    </button>
                  )}

                  {menuOrderCount === 0 && (
                    <button
                      onClick={() => {
                        setConfirmAction({
                          type: 'cancel',
                          sessionId: sessionMenu.sessionId,
                          tableId: sessionMenu.tableId,
                          tableName: sessionMenu.tableName,
                        })
                        setSessionMenu(null)
                      }}
                      className="flex min-h-11 items-center justify-center sm:justify-start gap-2.5 rounded-xl bg-rose-100 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-rose-700 hover:bg-rose-200 active:scale-98"
                    >
                      <Ban size={18} /> Cancel Session
                    </button>
                  )}

                  <button
                    onClick={() => {
                      setConfirmAction({
                        type: 'free',
                        sessionId: sessionMenu.sessionId,
                        tableId: sessionMenu.tableId,
                        tableName: sessionMenu.tableName,
                      })
                      setSessionMenu(null)
                    }}
                    className="flex min-h-11 items-center justify-center sm:justify-start gap-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-200 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-300 active:scale-98"
                  >
                    <DoorOpen size={18} /> Table Free
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )
        })()}

      {/* Confirmation Modal */}
      {confirmAction && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-end sm:items-center justify-center bg-black/50 p-0 sm:p-4 bh-modal-overlay">
          <div className="w-full max-w-sm rounded-t-3xl sm:rounded-3xl bg-white p-5 sm:p-6 shadow-2xl">
            <div className="mb-3 flex items-center gap-3">
              {confirmAction.type === 'cancel' ? (
                <span className="flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-rose-100 text-rose-600">
                  <Ban size={20} />
                </span>
              ) : (
                <span className="flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-slate-100 text-slate-600">
                  <DoorOpen size={20} />
                </span>
              )}
              <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900">
                {confirmAction.type === 'cancel' ? 'Cancel Session?' : 'Free the Table?'}
              </h3>
            </div>

            {confirmAction.type === 'cancel' ? (
              <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-600">
                This will cancel the session on <span className="font-bold">{confirmAction.tableName}</span> and make the seats available again.
              </p>
            ) : (
              <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-600">
                This will end the guest's stay on <span className="font-bold">{confirmAction.tableName}</span> and mark the table free.
                {sessionTotal(confirmAction.sessionId) > 0 && (
                  <span className="mt-1.5 block font-semibold text-red-600">
                    Warning: Unbilled orders worth ₹{sessionTotal(confirmAction.sessionId).toFixed(0)} exist.
                  </span>
                )}
              </p>
            )}

            {actionError && <div className="mt-3 rounded-xl bg-red-50 border border-red-200 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-red-700">{actionError}</div>}

            <div className="mt-5 flex gap-2">
              <button
                onClick={() => setConfirmAction(null)}
                className="flex-1 min-h-11 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 px-4 py-2.5 text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-200 active:scale-95 transition"
              >
                Back
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={() =>
                  confirmAction.type === 'cancel'
                    ? handleCancelSession(confirmAction.sessionId)
                    : handleFreeTable(confirmAction.sessionId, confirmAction.tableId)
                }
                className={`flex-1 min-h-11 rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold text-white transition active:scale-95 ${
                  confirmAction.type === 'cancel' ? 'bg-rose-500 hover:bg-rose-600' : 'bg-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-800'
                }`}
              >
                {confirmAction.type === 'cancel' ? 'Yes, Cancel' : 'Yes, Free Table'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Extend Stay Modal */}
      {extendAction && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-end sm:items-center justify-center bg-black/50 p-0 sm:p-4 bh-modal-overlay">
          <div className="w-full max-w-sm rounded-t-3xl sm:rounded-3xl bg-white p-5 sm:p-6 shadow-2xl">
            <div className="mb-3 flex items-center gap-3">
              <span className="flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-sky-100 text-sky-600">
                <Timer size={20} />
              </span>
              <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900">Extend Stay Duration</h3>
            </div>
            <p className="mb-3 text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-600">
              Set additional time for <span className="font-bold">{extendAction.tableName}</span>. Time is added from now.
            </p>

            <input
              type="number"
              value={extendMinutes}
              onChange={(e) => setExtendMinutes(parseInt(e.target.value) || 0)}
              min="15"
              step="15"
              className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-2.5 text-sm outline-none focus:border-sky-400"
            />

            <div className="mt-2.5 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
              {[30, 60, 90, 120].map((m) => (
                <button
                  key={m}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setExtendMinutes(m)}
                  className={`min-h-9 rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold transition active:scale-95 ${
                    extendMinutes === m ? 'bg-sky-500 text-white' : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-200'
                  }`}
                >
                  +{m} min
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>

            {actionError && <div className="mt-3 rounded-xl bg-red-50 border border-red-200 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-red-700">{actionError}</div>}

            <div className="mt-5 flex gap-2">
              <button
                onClick={() => {
                  setExtendAction(null)
                  setActionError('')
                }}
                className="flex-1 min-h-11 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 px-4 py-2.5 text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-200 active:scale-95 transition"
              >
                Back
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={handleExtend}
                className="flex-1 min-h-11 rounded-xl bg-sky-500 px-4 py-2.5 text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-sky-600 active:scale-95"
              >
                Confirm
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Session-receipt preview — shows the actual queued payload (restaurant
          header, table/guests/waiter, items with serving type, totals). */}
      {receiptJobId && <PrintPreview jobId={receiptJobId} onCancel={() => setReceiptJobId(null)} />}
    </div>
  )
}

const AuthContext = createContext<AuthContextType | null>(null)
const firebaseMode = dataMode === 'firebase'

/**
 * Map an authenticated profile (Firebase Auth identity + the `users/{uid}`
 * Firestore document) onto the account shape the UI renders. No password is
 * ever carried: Firebase Authentication owns credentials.
 */
const fromAuthUser = (entry: AuthUser): UserAccount => ({
  id: entry.uid,
  name: entry.displayName,
  username: extractUsernameFromEmail(entry.email),
  email: entry.email,
  phone: entry.phone ?? '',
  role: entry.role,
  isMainAdmin: entry.isMainAdmin,
  active: entry.active,
  avatarUrl: entry.avatarUrl,
  createdAt: entry.createdAt ?? Date.now(),
})

/**
 * Extract username from internal email (username@beeshive.local -> username)
 */
const extractUsernameFromEmail = (email: string): string => {
  if (!email) return ''
  const parts = email.split('@')
  return parts[0]?.toLowerCase() || ''
}

/** A raw SDK message must never reach the login screen. */
const looksLikeRawSdkError = (message: string): boolean =>
  /firebase|firestore|identitytoolkit|api[-_ ]?key|AIza|Bearer|https?:\/\//i.test(message)

/**
 * Turn any sign-in failure into a clean, user-facing message.
 * Firebase Auth codes are mapped by authService; Firestore/transport failures
 * are described without echoing a raw Firebase response, token or credential.
 */
const describeSignInFailure = (err: unknown): string => {
  const code = String((err as { code?: string })?.code ?? '')
  if (code.startsWith('auth/')) return mapAuthError(err)
  if (code === 'permission-denied')
    return 'Your account profile could not be read. Ask an administrator to check your access.'
  if (code === 'unavailable' || code === 'deadline-exceeded')
    return 'Network error. Please check your connection and try again.'
  const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : ''
  return message && !looksLikeRawSdkError(message)
    ? message
    : 'Sign-in could not be completed. Please try again.'
}

const toDirectory = (account: UserAccount): DirectoryUser => ({
  id: account.id,
  name: account.name,
  username: account.username,
  email: account.email,
  phone: account.phone,
  role: account.role,
  isMainAdmin: account.isMainAdmin,
  active: account.active,
  avatarUrl: account.avatarUrl,
  createdAt: account.createdAt,
})

export function fromDirectory(entry: DirectoryUser): UserAccount {
  const email = entry.email || ''
  return {
    id: entry.id,
    name: entry.name ?? '',
    // New documents carry `username` explicitly; legacy documents minted the
    // directory email from the username (username@beeshive.local).
    username: entry.username ?? extractUsernameFromEmail(email),
    email,
    phone: entry.phone ?? '',
    role: entry.role,
    isMainAdmin: entry.isMainAdmin === true,
    active: entry.active !== false,
    avatarUrl: entry.avatarUrl,
    createdAt: entry.createdAt ?? Date.now(),
  }
}

export function mergeDirectory(local: UserAccount[], remote: DirectoryUser[]): UserAccount[] {
  const byId = new Map(local.map((account) => [account.id, account]))
  remote.forEach((entry) => {
    byId.set(entry.id, fromDirectory(entry))
  })
  return Array.from(byId.values())
}

export const AuthProvider = ({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) => {
  const [users, setUsers] = useState<UserAccount[]>([])
  const [user, setUser] = useState<UserAccount | null>(null)
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true)

  // ── Mock mode (DEVELOPMENT/TESTING ONLY) ──────────────────────────────────
  // Hydrates the local directory so the login screen works and restores the
  // session-scoped signed-in user. Production (firebase mode) never reads a
  // credential from the browser — see the Firebase effects below.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (firebaseMode) return
    let stored: UserAccount[] = []
    try {
      stored = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('beeshive_users') || '[]') as UserAccount[]
    } catch {
      stored = []
    }
    const accounts = Array.isArray(stored) ? stored.filter((entry) => entry && entry.id) : []
    setUsers(accounts)
    try {
      const session = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('beeshive_session') || 'null') as { id?: string } | null
      const sessionUser = session?.id ? accounts.find((entry) => entry.id === session.id) : null
      if (sessionUser) setUser(sessionUser)
    } catch {
      /* no session — stay signed out */
    }
    setIsLoading(false)
  }, [])

  // ── Firebase Auth identity (firebase mode) ────────────────────────────────
  // Firebase Authentication is the single source of identity; the application
  // role/profile is read from `users/{uid}` in Firestore by authService. No
  // account is ever invented locally and no local session is trusted.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!firebaseMode) return
    const unsubscribe = onAuthStateChange((profile) => {
      setUser(profile ? fromAuthUser(profile) : null)
      setIsLoading(false)
    })
    return unsubscribe
  }, [])

  // ── Staff directory (firebase mode, authenticated operators only) ─────────
  // The directory mirrors `users/*` for the staff-management screens. It is
  // loaded only AFTER sign-in because firestore.rules deny that collection to
  // anonymous clients: a pre-login read would fail (and show a denied request
  // in the browser) instead of simply showing the login screen.
  const signedInUid = user?.id ?? null
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!firebaseMode) return
    if (!signedInUid) {
      setUsers([])
      return
    }
    let cancelled = false
    const apply = (remote: DirectoryUser[]) => {
      if (cancelled) return
      const accounts = remote.map(fromDirectory)
      setUsers((prev) => mergeDirectory(prev, remote))
      // Keep the signed-in account in step with a role/activation change made by
      // an admin on another device (the Auth identity itself is unchanged).
      setUser((current) => {
        if (!current) return current
        const fresh = accounts.find((account) => account.id === current.id)
        return fresh ? fresh : current
      })
    }
    void loadUsersDirectory().then(apply).catch(() => {
      // An unavailable/denied read is covered by the live listener below.
    })
    const unsubscribe = watchUsersDirectory(apply)
    return () => { cancelled = true; unsubscribe() }
  }, [signedInUid])

  /**
   * Production sign-in with username, email or 10-digit phone.
   *
   * The typed identifier is resolved through the login-identifier mappings
   * (`usernames/` | `emails/` | `phones/`) to the account's Firebase Auth
   * identity, then authenticated by Firebase Authentication — the sole
   * credential authority. There is no local password database, no password in
   * localStorage, and no sign-in path that pretends an account exists.
   */
  const loginWithFirebase = useCallback(async (identifier: string, password: string) => {
    try {
      const normalized = identifier.trim().toLowerCase()

      let profile: AuthUser
      if (looksLikeEmail(normalized)) {
        // Resolve through the email mapping (handles updated addresses),
        // falling back to a direct Auth sign-in with the typed address.
        profile = await signInWithIdentifier(normalized, password)
      } else if (/^\d{10}$/.test(normalized)) {
        // 10-digit phone number login
        profile = await signInWithIdentifier(normalized, password)
      } else {
        // Username-based authentication via the username mapping
        profile = await signInWithUsername(normalized, password)
      }

      const account = fromAuthUser(profile)
      setUser(account)
      return account
    } catch (err) {
      // Surface the mapped, user-safe reason (never a raw Firebase error).
      throw new Error(describeSignInFailure(err))
    }
  }, [])

  /**
   * Mock-mode credentials check (DEVELOPMENT/TESTING ONLY). Production always
   * goes through loginWithFirebase; this path never touches Firebase and only
   * matches the local seeded directory.
   * 
   * NOTE: In mock mode, passwords are stored in the local users array for
   * development purposes only. In production (firebase mode), authentication
   * is handled by Firebase Auth.
   */
  const login = useCallback((_identifier: string, _password: string) => {
    if (firebaseMode) return null
    // Mock mode: for development purposes only
    // In mock mode, we just check if user exists and is active
    const normalized = _identifier.trim().toLowerCase()
    const match = users.find(
      (entry) => (entry.email ?? '').trim().toLowerCase() === normalized,
    )
    if (!match || match.active === false) return null
    setUser(match)
    try {
      sessionStorage.setItem('beeshive_session', JSON.stringify({ id: match.id }))
    } catch {
      /* session-scoped convenience only */
    }
    return match
  }, [users])
  const logout = useCallback(() => {
    setUser(null)
    if (firebaseMode) {
      // End the Firebase Auth session; a failed remote sign-out (offline) must
      // not surface as an unhandled rejection — the UI is already signed out.
      void firebaseSignOut().catch(() => {})
    } else {
      try {
        sessionStorage.removeItem('beeshive_session')
      } catch {
        /* ignore */
      }
    }
  }, [])

  // const updateAccount = useCallback(async (id: string, data: Partial<UserAccount>) => {
  //   const target = users.find((entry) => entry.id === id)
  //   if (!target) throw new Error('Account was not found.')
  //   const next = { ...target, ...data }
  //   if (firebaseMode) {
  //     // Identifier changes (username / 10-digit phone / email) are reserved
  //     // transactionally BEFORE the profile document is written, so a failed
  //     // save never leaves a stale login identifier active.
  //     const persisted = await updateDirectoryAccount(id, {

  //       avatarUrl: next.avatarUrl,
  //       active: next.active,
  //     })
  //     const persistedAccount = fromDirectory(persisted)
  //     // Role changes (updateStaff) still flow through the directory save.
  //     if (data.role !== undefined && data.role !== target.role) {
  //       await saveUsersDirectory([toDirectory({ ...persistedAccount, role: next.role })])
  //     }
  //     setUsers((prev) => prev.map((entry) => entry.id === id ? { ...entry, ...persistedAccount, role: next.role } : entry))
  //     setUser((current) => current?.id === id ? { ...current, ...persistedAccount, role: next.role } : current)
  //     return
  //   }
  //   setUsers((prev) => prev.map((entry) => entry.id === id ? next : entry))
  //   setUser((current) => current?.id === id ? next : current)
  // }, [users])

    const updateAccount = useCallback(async (
    id: string,
    data: Partial<UserAccount> & { password?: string },
  ) => {
    const target = users.find((entry) => entry.id === id)
    if (!target) throw new Error('Account was not found.')

    // Never persist password into local/Firestore state — Auth owns credentials.
    const { password, ...profileData } = data
    const next = { ...target, ...profileData }

    if (firebaseMode) {
      // 1) Auth password first (fails loudly if Cloud Function is missing).
      if (password) {
        const check = validatePassword(password)
        if (!check.isValid) {
          throw new Error(`Password is not strong enough: ${check.errors.join('; ')}.`)
        }
        const { updateAuthUserPassword } = await import('../services/firebase/userService')
        await updateAuthUserPassword(id, password)
      }

      // 2) Firestore profile + identifier mappings.
      const persisted = await updateDirectoryAccount(id, {
        name: next.name,
        username: next.username,
        email: next.email,
        phone: next.phone,
        avatarUrl: next.avatarUrl,
        active: next.active,
      })
      const persistedAccount = fromDirectory(persisted)
      if (data.role !== undefined && data.role !== target.role) {
        await saveUsersDirectory([toDirectory({ ...persistedAccount, role: next.role })])
      }
      setUsers((prev) =>
        prev.map((entry) =>
          entry.id === id ? { ...entry, ...persistedAccount, role: next.role } : entry,
        ),
      )
      setUser((current) =>
        current?.id === id ? { ...current, ...persistedAccount, role: next.role } : current,
      )
      return
    }

    // Mock mode: profile only (mock login does not verify passwords).
    setUsers((prev) => prev.map((entry) => (entry.id === id ? next : entry)))
    setUser((current) => (current?.id === id ? next : current))
  }, [users])

  const createAdmin = useCallback(async (data: Omit<UserAccount, "id" | "createdAt" | "role"> & { avatarFile?: File; password: string }) => {
    if (!user?.isMainAdmin) throw new Error("Only the Main Admin can create admins.")
    if (users.filter((entry) => entry.role === "admin").length >= MAX_ADMINS) throw new Error("Maximum admin limit reached.")
    const { avatarFile, password, ...account } = data

    // Frontend pre-checks (the transactional reservations in
    // createDirectoryAccount remain the authoritative enforcement).
    const usernameError = validateUsername(account.username ?? '')
    if (usernameError) throw new Error(usernameError)
    if (!isValidContactEmailFormat(account.email ?? '')) throw new Error('Enter a valid email address.')
    if (!isValidPhone(normalizePhone(account.phone ?? ''))) throw new Error('Phone number must be exactly 10 digits.')
    const normalizedUsername = account.username!.trim().toLowerCase()
    if (users.some((entry) => (entry.username ?? '').toLowerCase() === normalizedUsername)) {
      throw new Error('That username is already taken.')
    }
    if (users.some((entry) => (entry.email ?? '').toLowerCase() === account.email!.trim().toLowerCase())) {
      throw new Error('That email address is already in use.')
    }
    if (users.some((entry) => entry.phone === normalizePhone(account.phone ?? ''))) {
      throw new Error('That phone number is already in use.')
    }

    const result = await createDirectoryAccount({
      name: account.name,
      username: normalizedUsername,
      email: account.email,
      phone: normalizePhone(account.phone ?? ''),
      password,
      role: "admin",
      isMainAdmin: false
    })
    // Preserve the user's real contact email — do NOT use the internal auth email.
    let created: UserAccount = {
      ...account,
      username: normalizedUsername,
      email: account.email!, // User's real contact email, not the internal @beeshive.local
      phone: result.entry.phone,
      id: result.entry.id,
      role: "admin" as const,
      createdAt: result.entry.createdAt,
      isMainAdmin: false,
      active: true,
      pending: false,
    }
    if (avatarFile) {
      // Upload to Storage and persist ONLY the download URL — the form closes
      // only after this has fully succeeded.
      const uploaded = await uploadMemberImage(avatarFile, created.id)
      created = { ...created, avatarUrl: uploaded.imageUrl }
      await updateDirectoryAccount(created.id, { avatarUrl: uploaded.imageUrl })
    }
    setUsers((prev) => [...prev.filter((entry) => entry.id !== created.id), created])
    return created
  }, [user, users])

  /**
   * Save the signed-in account's own credentials.
   *
   * Atomic from the operator's point of view — everything below must succeed
   * before the caller is told the save worked:
   *   1. validate every field (username / email / 10-digit phone / password);
   *   2. Firebase Authentication: re-authenticate, then update the password
   *      and/or the sign-in email where applicable. Credentials NEVER reach
   *      Firestore (no password, no hash, no salt);
   *   3. Firestore: reserve the new login identifiers, release the previous
   *      ones and write the `users/{uid}` profile (see updateDirectoryAccount);
   *   4. the Auth listener + the directory listener refresh the profile, so the
   *      UI shows what is actually persisted.
   * A failure at any step throws with the real reason and nothing is reported as
   * saved.
   */
  const updateMyCredentials = useCallback(async (data: {
    name?: string
    username?: string
    email?: string
    phone?: string
    password?: string
    currentPassword?: string
    avatarUrl?: string
  }) => {
    if (!user) throw new Error('No signed-in user.')
    const auth = getAuthNow()
    const fbUser = auth?.currentUser
    if (!auth || !fbUser || fbUser.uid !== user.id) {
      throw new Error('Your session could not be verified. Please sign in again and retry.')
    }

    // ── 1. Validate exactly what will be persisted ─────────────────────────
    const nextName = data.name === undefined ? undefined : data.name.trim()
    if (nextName !== undefined && !nextName) throw new Error('Name is required.')

    const nextUsername = data.username === undefined ? undefined : normalizeUsername(data.username)
    if (nextUsername !== undefined) {
      const usernameError = validateUsername(nextUsername)
      if (usernameError) throw new Error(usernameError)
    }

    const nextEmail = data.email === undefined ? undefined : data.email.trim().toLowerCase()
    if (nextEmail !== undefined && !isValidContactEmailFormat(nextEmail)) {
      throw new Error('Enter a valid email address.')
    }

    // Exactly 10 digits, digits only: spaces, +91 and other characters are
    // rejected rather than silently stripped.
    const nextPhone = data.phone === undefined ? undefined : normalizePhone(data.phone)
    if (nextPhone !== undefined && !isValidPhone(nextPhone)) {
      throw new Error('Phone number must be exactly 10 digits (digits only).')
    }

    if (data.password) {
      const check = validatePassword(data.password)
      if (!check.isValid) {
        throw new Error(`New password is not strong enough: ${check.errors.join('; ')}.`)
      }
      if (!data.currentPassword) throw new Error('Enter your current password to change it.')
    }

    /**
     * The Firebase Auth identity of an app-created account is the internal,
     * non-routable `<username>@beeshive.local` address. Such an identity must
     * NOT be re-pointed at the operator's real mailbox (the login screen
     * resolves a real address through the `emails/{email}` mapping, and the
     * internal identity must stay stable across username renames). Only accounts
     * whose Auth identity IS a real mailbox (the nominated owner, legacy
     * accounts) have their sign-in email updated in Firebase Authentication.
     */
    const internalIdentity = (fbUser.email ?? '').toLowerCase().endsWith(`@${INTERNAL_ACCOUNT_DOMAIN}`)
    const authEmailChange =
      nextEmail !== undefined &&
      !internalIdentity &&
      nextEmail !== (fbUser.email ?? '').toLowerCase()

    // ── 2. Firebase Authentication (password / sign-in email) ──────────────
    const reauthenticate = async () => {
      if (!data.currentPassword) return
      try {
        const credential = EmailAuthProvider.credential(fbUser.email ?? '', data.currentPassword)
        await reauthenticateWithCredential(fbUser, credential)
      } catch (err) {
        const code = (err as { code?: string })?.code
        if (code === 'auth/wrong-password' || code === 'auth/invalid-credential') {
          throw new Error('Your current password is incorrect.')
        }
        throw new Error(mapAuthError(err))
      }
    }

    if (data.password || authEmailChange) {
      if (authEmailChange && !data.currentPassword) {
        throw new Error('Enter your current password to change your sign-in email address.')
      }
      await reauthenticate()
    }

    if (data.password) {
      try {
        await updatePassword(fbUser, data.password)
      } catch (err) {
        const code = (err as { code?: string })?.code
        if (code === 'auth/requires-recent-login') {
          throw new Error('Please enter your current password again to change it.')
        }
        throw new Error(mapAuthError(err))
      }
    }

    if (authEmailChange) {
      try {
        // After this the previous sign-in email can no longer authenticate.
        await updateEmail(fbUser, nextEmail!)
      } catch (err) {
        const code = (err as { code?: string })?.code
        if (code === 'auth/email-already-in-use') {
          throw new Error('That email address is already in use by another account.')
        }
        if (code === 'auth/requires-recent-login') {
          throw new Error('Please enter your current password again to change your sign-in email address.')
        }
        throw new Error(mapAuthError(err))
      }
    }

    // ── 3. Firestore profile + login-identifier mappings ──────────────────
    const profileChanges: Partial<UserAccount> = {}
    if (nextName !== undefined) profileChanges.name = nextName
    if (nextUsername !== undefined) profileChanges.username = nextUsername
    if (nextEmail !== undefined) profileChanges.email = nextEmail
    if (nextPhone !== undefined) profileChanges.phone = nextPhone
    if (data.avatarUrl !== undefined) profileChanges.avatarUrl = data.avatarUrl

    await updateAccount(user.id, profileChanges)

    // Issue 4 — identity-mapping consistency after a real Auth email change.
    // Firebase Authentication accepted the new email, so EVERY authEmail-bearing
    // artifact must be re-pointed at it: `users/{uid}.authEmail` and the
    // username / phone / email identifier mappings this account owns. The UID
    // stays the canonical identity — repairAuthIdentity only rewrites mappings
    // that belong to THIS uid, never creates a second account, and the
    // post-sign-in self-heal in authService.resolveProfile re-runs it on the
    // next login as a second convergence guarantee.
    if (authEmailChange) {
      await repairAuthIdentity(user.id, nextEmail!).catch(() => {
        /* best-effort: the sign-in self-heal re-aligns the mappings on next login */
      })
    }
  }, [user, updateAccount])

  const deleteAccount = useCallback(async (id: string) => {
    if (!user?.isMainAdmin) throw new Error('Only the Main Admin can delete accounts.')
    const target = users.find((entry) => entry.id === id)
    if (!target || target.isMainAdmin) throw new Error('The Main Admin account cannot be deleted.')

    // Deletes the profile document AND releases every login-identifier mapping
    // (username / phone / email) so no stale identifier keeps resolving.
    await deleteUserDirectoryEntry(id)

    setUsers((prev) => prev.filter((entry) => entry.id !== id))
  }, [user, users])

  const value = useMemo<AuthContextType>(() => ({
    user, users, isAuthenticated: !!user, isLoading, firebaseMode,
    isMainAdmin: user?.isMainAdmin === true, login, loginWithFirebase, logout,
    listAdmins: () => users.filter((entry) => entry.role === 'admin'),
    createAdmin, updateAdmin: updateAccount, deleteAdmin: deleteAccount,
    transferMainAdmin: async (id) => {
      if (!user?.isMainAdmin) throw new Error('Only the Main Admin can transfer this title.')
      await saveUsersDirectory(users.filter((entry) => entry.role === 'admin').map((entry) => toDirectory({ ...entry, isMainAdmin: entry.id === id })))
    },
    updateMyCredentials, createStaff: async (data: Omit<UserAccount, "id" | "createdAt" | "isMainAdmin"> & { password: string; avatarFile?: File | null }) => {
      // Staff creation MUST use a real Firebase Auth UID — never local_ IDs.
      // Username / phone / email are validated + reserved transactionally by
      // createDirectoryAccount; any failure throws and the create form stays
      // open with the real error.
      const { password, avatarFile, ...profile } = data
      const normalizedUsername = (profile.username ?? '').trim().toLowerCase()
      const usernameError = validateUsername(normalizedUsername)
      if (usernameError) throw new Error(usernameError)
      if (!isValidContactEmailFormat(profile.email ?? '')) throw new Error('Enter a valid email address.')
      const phone = normalizePhone(profile.phone ?? '')
      if (!isValidPhone(phone)) throw new Error('Phone number must be exactly 10 digits.')

      const result = await createDirectoryAccount({
        name: profile.name,
        username: normalizedUsername,
        email: profile.email,
        phone,
        password,
        role: data.role,
        isMainAdmin: false,
      })
      // Preserve the user's real contact email — do NOT use the internal auth email.
      let created: UserAccount = {
        ...profile,
        avatarUrl: undefined, // a local preview URL is never persisted — Storage is authoritative
        username: normalizedUsername,
        email: profile.email!, // User's real contact email, not the internal @beeshive.local
        phone,
        id: result.entry.id,
        createdAt: result.entry.createdAt,
        isMainAdmin: false,
        active: true,
      }
      if (avatarFile) {
        // Same contract as admin creation: upload to Firebase Storage, persist
        // ONLY the download URL, and complete before the caller closes the form.
        const uploaded = await uploadMemberImage(avatarFile, created.id)
        created = { ...created, avatarUrl: uploaded.imageUrl }
        await updateDirectoryAccount(created.id, { avatarUrl: uploaded.imageUrl })
      }
      return created
    },
    updateStaff: updateAccount, deleteStaff: deleteAccount,
    listStaff: () => users.filter((entry) => entry.role === 'waiter' || entry.role === 'supervisor'),
    sendOtp: async () => false, verifyOtp: async () => false, resetPassword: async () => false,
    /**
     * Production password recovery goes through Firebase Authentication
     * (`sendPasswordResetEmail`). Never throws: the caller only needs to know
     * whether the request was accepted, and no address existence is disclosed.
     *
     * The typed identifier (username OR contact email OR Firebase Auth email)
     * is resolved to the account's Firebase Auth identity through the
     * login-identifier mappings BEFORE the reset is requested, because Firebase
     * emails the reset link to the AUTH address of the account. Accounts whose
     * Auth identity is a real mailbox (the Main Admin, migrated and newly
     * created accounts) therefore receive the link in their actual inbox; an
     * account still on its legacy internal identity keeps the previous
     * behavior. No account existence is ever disclosed either way.
     */
    sendPasswordReset: async (identifier: string) => {
      if (!firebaseMode) return false
      const typed = (identifier ?? '').trim()
      if (!typed) return false
      try {
        let recoveryAddress: string
        const resolved = await resolveAuthEmailForIdentifier(typed)
        const resolvedIsRealMailbox =
          !!resolved && !resolved.toLowerCase().endsWith(`@${INTERNAL_ACCOUNT_DOMAIN}`)
        if (looksLikeEmail(typed)) {
          // Real contact email → emails/ mapping → Firebase Auth identity.
          recoveryAddress = resolvedIsRealMailbox ? resolved! : typed.toLowerCase()
        } else {
          // Username → usernames/ mapping → Firebase Auth identity (legacy
          // fallback unchanged: the internal identity derived from the name).
          const normalized = normalizeUsername(typed)
          recoveryAddress = resolvedIsRealMailbox
            ? resolved!
            : `${normalized}@${INTERNAL_ACCOUNT_DOMAIN}`
        }
        await firebaseSendPasswordReset(recoveryAddress)
        return true
      } catch {
        return false
      }
    },
  }), [user, users, isLoading, login, loginWithFirebase, logout, createAdmin, updateAccount, deleteAccount, updateMyCredentials])

  return <AuthContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</AuthContext.Provider>
}

export const useAuth = () => {
  const context = useContext(AuthContext)
  if (!context) throw new Error('useAuth must be used within AuthProvider')
  return context
}

// Business-day filtering is FIXED to IST (the restaurant's calendar). The
// previous local-time implementation made "Today" depend on whatever timezone
// the device happened to run in; the shared module keeps every device,
// refresh and analytics view on the exact same day boundary.
export const isSameBusinessDay = (timestamp: number, dateStr: string) =>
  businessDayIsSame(timestamp, dateStr)
const toDateStr = (d: Date) => businessDayStr(d.getTime())
const getBusinessDay = (timestamp: number) => businessDayStr(timestamp)

const computeStockStatus = (quantity: number, minimumThreshold: number): StockStatus => {
  if (quantity <= 0) return 'OUT_OF_STOCK'
  if (quantity <= minimumThreshold) return 'LOW'
  return 'GOOD'
}
