/**
 * Bee's Hive — guest customisation helpers.
 *
 * A guest's spice preference and anything else they ask for ("no onion", "less
 * oil", "pack separately" …) travel with the order item as
 * `OrderItem.specialRequests`, so the same text:
 *   • prints on the kitchen / parcel token receipt (`SPECIAL REQUEST`)
 *   • shows on the supervisor KDS board, admin live orders and token history
 *
 * Shared by the waiter order screen and the admin parcel screen so both flows
 * offer the identical choices.
 */

/** Spice levels a guest can ask for. */
export const SPICE_LEVELS = ['Less Spice', 'Low', 'Medium', 'Hot']

/** Helper text shown under each spice level on the order screens. */
export const SPICE_DESCRIPTIONS: Record<string, string> = {
  'Less Spice': 'Very low heat — kid friendly',
  Low: 'Gentle, mild chilli warmth',
  Medium: 'Balanced house spice',
  Hot: 'Full fiery chilli punch',
}

/** Quick-pick requests customers ask for most often. */
export const CUSTOMER_NOTE_OPTIONS = [
  'No Onion',
  'No Garlic',
  'Less Oil',
  'Less Salt',
  'Extra Gravy',
  'Extra Spicy Chilli',
  'Extra Crispy',
  'Serve Hot',
  'Pack Separately',
  'Jain (No Onion & Garlic)',
]

/**
 * Compose one `specialRequests` string from the spice choice, quick-pick notes
 * and any free text the guest said. Returns `undefined` when nothing was chosen,
 * so items without a request stay clean.
 */
export const buildSpecialRequests = (spice?: string, notes: string[] = [], freeText?: string): string | undefined => {
  const parts: string[] = []
  if (spice) parts.push(`Spice: ${spice}`)
  notes.forEach((note) => {
    const trimmed = note.trim()
    if (trimmed) parts.push(trimmed)
  })
  const extra = freeText?.trim()
  if (extra) parts.push(extra)
  return parts.length > 0 ? parts.join(' · ') : undefined
}

FILE: src\lib\orderMetrics.ts

import type { Bill, Order, Session } from '../context/RestaurantContext'

const pendingStatuses = new Set<Order['status']>(['placed', 'confirmed', 'preparing'])

const billStatusBySession = (bills: Bill[]) =>
  new Map(
    bills
      .map((bill) => [bill.sessionId, bill.status] as const),
  )

export const getPendingOrders = (
  orders: Order[],
  sessions: Session[],
  bills: Bill[],
  options: { waiterId?: string; includeParcel?: boolean } = {},
): Order[] => {
  const activeSessionIds = new Set(
    sessions
      .filter((session) => session.status === 'active' || session.status === 'payment_pending')
      .map((session) => session.id),
  )
  const billStatuses = billStatusBySession(bills)
  const includeParcel = options.includeParcel ?? false

  return orders.filter((order) => {
    if (!pendingStatuses.has(order.status)) return false
    if (options.waiterId && order.waiterId !== options.waiterId) return false
    const billStatus = billStatuses.get(order.sessionId)
    if (order.orderType === 'parcel') {
      return includeParcel && billStatus !== 'PAID'
    }
    if (billStatus === 'GENERATED' || billStatus === 'PAID') return false
    return activeSessionIds.has(order.sessionId)
  })
}

FILE: src\lib\orderPriority.ts
============================================================

/**
 * Supervisor order prioritization engine — pure, timestamp-driven.
 *
 * Design rules:
 *  - Priority is CALCULATED from stable timestamps; it is never stored and
 *    never replaces the operational order status (PLACED..SERVED).
 *  - Firebase-ready: DB stores timestamps; the client derives urgency, so no
 *    per-second writes are ever needed.
 *  - One shared ticker hook for the whole KDS (no per-card intervals).
 */
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'

export type KdsPriority = 'VIP_OVERDUE' | 'URGENT' | 'VIP' | 'HIGH' | 'NORMAL'

export interface KdsOrderTiming {
  status: string
  createdAt: number
  acceptedAt?: number | null
  preparingAt?: number | null
  estimatedReadyAt?: number | null
  prepMinutes: number // max(item prep times) — parallel cooking model
  isVip: boolean
  manualPriority?: string | null // 'normal' | 'fast' chosen at order placement
}

export interface KdsPriorityInfo {
  priority: KdsPriority
  isVip: boolean
  isOverdue: boolean
  isDueSoon: boolean
  expectedReadyAt: number | null
  remainingMinutes: number
  overdueMinutes: number
  severity: 'OVERDUE' | 'HIGHLY OVERDUE' | 'CRITICAL DELAY'
  rank: number
}

const MIN = 60_000

/** Longest item prep time wins (dishes cook in parallel, never summed). */
export const maxPrepMinutes = (values: Array<number | null | undefined>): number =>
  values.reduce<number>((acc, v) => (typeof v === 'number' && v > acc ? v : acc), 0)

export const computeKdsPriority = (o: KdsOrderTiming, now: number): KdsPriorityInfo => {
  const active = o.status === 'placed' || o.status === 'confirmed' || o.status === 'accepted' || o.status === 'preparing'
  const prep = Math.max(1, Math.round(o.prepMinutes || 1))

  // Deadline: preparingAt + prep wins. A supervisor ETA overrides ONLY when the
  // supervisor explicitly asked for more time than the prep-based expectation.
  // Fallback chain: preparingAt -> acceptedAt -> createdAt.
  const base = o.preparingAt ?? o.acceptedAt ?? o.createdAt
  const prepBased = base + prep * MIN
  const etaBased = o.estimatedReadyAt ?? 0
  const expectedReadyAt = active ? (etaBased > prepBased + MIN ? etaBased : prepBased) : null
  const remainingMs = expectedReadyAt ? expectedReadyAt - now : 0
  const remainingMinutes = Math.ceil(remainingMs / MIN)
  const overdueMinutes = expectedReadyAt ? Math.max(0, Math.ceil(-remainingMs / MIN)) : 0

  const isOverdue = active && expectedReadyAt !== null && remainingMs < 0

  // Due soon when <= 25% of the prep window remains (relative, not fixed 5 min).
  const dueSoonWindowMs = prep * MIN * 0.25
  const isDueSoon =
    active && !isOverdue && expectedReadyAt !== null && remainingMs <= dueSoonWindowMs

  const vip = o.isVip || o.manualPriority === 'vip'

  let priority: KdsPriority
  if (vip && isOverdue) priority = 'VIP_OVERDUE'
  else if (isOverdue) priority = 'URGENT'
  else if (vip) priority = 'VIP'
  else if (isDueSoon) priority = 'HIGH'
  else priority = 'NORMAL'

  // Manual "fast" can lift a NORMAL order; it can never suppress VIP/overdue.
  if (priority === 'NORMAL' && o.manualPriority === 'fast') priority = 'HIGH'

  const severity: KdsPriorityInfo['severity'] =
    overdueMinutes >= 15 ? 'CRITICAL DELAY' : overdueMinutes >= 5 ? 'HIGHLY OVERDUE' : 'OVERDUE'

  const rankTable: Record<KdsPriority, number> = {
    VIP_OVERDUE: 0,
    URGENT: 1,
    VIP: 2,
    HIGH: 3,
    NORMAL: 4,
  }

  return {
    priority,
    isVip: vip,
    isOverdue,
    isDueSoon,
    expectedReadyAt,
    remainingMinutes: Math.max(0, remainingMinutes),
    overdueMinutes,
    severity,
    rank: rankTable[priority],
  }
}

/** Dynamic KDS sort: priority rank asc, then oldest activity first. */
export const sortKdsByPriority = <T extends { id: string }>(
  list: T[],
  info: (item: T) => KdsPriorityInfo,
  activityTime: (item: T) => number
): T[] =>
  [...list].sort((a, b) => {
    const ra = info(a).rank
    const rb = info(b).rank
    if (ra !== rb) return ra - rb
    const ta = activityTime(a)
    const tb = activityTime(b)
    if (ta !== tb) return ta - tb
    return a.id.localeCompare(b.id)
  })

/** Single shared clock for the whole board — one interval, cleaned up. */
export const useKdsNow = (intervalMs = 20_000): number => {
  const [now, setNow] = useState(() => Date.now())
  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = window.setInterval(() => setNow(Date.now()), intervalMs)
    return () => window.clearInterval(timer)
  }, [intervalMs])
  return now
}

export const formatCountdown = (p: KdsPriorityInfo): string =>
  p.isOverdue ? 'OVERDUE BY ' + p.overdueMinutes + ' MIN' : 'READY IN ' + p.remainingMinutes + ' MIN'

/**
 * Bee's Hive — password policy.
 *
 * Firebase Authentication is the ONLY credential store: no password, hash or
 * salt is ever computed or persisted by this application (not in Firestore, not
 * in the browser). This module therefore contains the shared password-strength
 * policy used by every account form (create admin, create/edit staff, change my
 * password, reset password) so the same rules are enforced everywhere.
 */

// src/lib/password.ts
export interface PasswordValidationResult {
  isValid: boolean;
  errors: string[];
}

export function validatePassword(password: string): PasswordValidationResult {
  const errors: string[] = []

  if (password.length < 8) errors.push('At least 8 characters')
  if (!/[A-Z]/.test(password)) errors.push('One uppercase letter (A-Z)')
  if (!/[a-z]/.test(password)) errors.push('One lowercase letter (a-z)')
  if (!/[0-9]/.test(password)) errors.push('One number (0-9)')
  if (!/[!@#$%^&*(),.?":{}|<>]/.test(password)) errors.push('One special character (!@#$...)')

  return { isValid: errors.length === 0, errors }
}

/**

 *
 * ONE consistent, readable format across every screen and 58mm receipt:
 * half plates carry ` (HALF)` and full plates carry ` (FULL)`. Orders stored
 * before `servingType` existed have no serving type at all — those are FULL

export type ServingType = 'full' | 'half'

/**

  halfPlatePrice: number | null | undefined,

FILE: src\lib\tableAreas.ts

/**
 * Table area (section) helpers shared by every screen that lists tables.
 *
 * Tables are categorised by their `area` field so that the admin Table
 * Management screen and the waiter table views all show Indoor / Garden /
 * Terrace / ... as separate groups instead of one flat list.
 */
export const TABLE_AREAS = ['Indoor', 'Outdoor', 'Garden', 'Terrace', 'Private Room']

/** Friendly label used when a table has no area assigned. */
export const UNASSIGNED_AREA = 'No Area Assigned'

/** Shared sessionStorage key for the last-selected table area filter. */
export const TABLE_AREA_STORAGE_KEY = 'beeshive_tableAreaFilter'
let storedAreaFilter: string | null = null

/**
 * Read the last-selected table area filter from sessionStorage.
 * Returns null when nothing was stored or storage is unavailable.
 * Scoped to the current browser session (tab) so it resets on browser restart.
 */
export function getStoredAreaFilter(): string | null {
  return storedAreaFilter
}

/** Persist (or clear) the last-selected table area filter to sessionStorage. */
export function setStoredAreaFilter(area: string | null): void {
  storedAreaFilter = area
}

/** Area of a table, falling back to a readable label when it is missing/blank. */
export const tableArea = (table: { area?: string }): string => table.area?.trim() || UNASSIGNED_AREA

export interface TableAreaGroup<T> {
  area: string
  tables: T[]
}

/**
 * Group tables area-wise.
 *
 * Groups follow the configured `TABLE_AREAS` order (Indoor first, then Garden,
 * ...), custom areas added later come next in alphabetical order and tables
 * without an area are always listed last.
 */
export function groupTablesByArea<T extends { area?: string }>(tables: T[]): TableAreaGroup<T>[] {
  const buckets = new Map<string, T[]>()
  tables.forEach((table) => {
    const area = tableArea(table)
    const bucket = buckets.get(area)
    if (bucket) bucket.push(table)
    else buckets.set(area, [table])
  })

  const known = TABLE_AREAS.filter((area) => buckets.has(area))
  const custom = Array.from(buckets.keys())
    .filter((area) => !TABLE_AREAS.includes(area) && area !== UNASSIGNED_AREA)
    .sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b))
  const ordered = [...known, ...custom]
  if (buckets.has(UNASSIGNED_AREA)) ordered.push(UNASSIGNED_AREA)

  return ordered.map((area) => ({ area, tables: buckets.get(area) as T[] }))
}

FILE: src\lib\tableFilters.ts

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { tableArea } from './tableAreas'

/**
 * Table filtering + sorting helpers shared by the admin Table Management
 * screen and the waiter table views (Floor Status / Sessions).
 *
 * The area chips that used to live in each screen are now one control here,
 * extended with status, minimum capacity, VIP and a sort order so staff can
 * "fetch the required tables" instead of scanning the whole floor.
 */
export const tableStatusFilters = ['all', 'available', 'occupied', 'reserved', 'cleaning'] as const
export type TableStatusFilter = (typeof tableStatusFilters)[number]

export const tableSorts = ['name_asc', 'name_desc', 'capacity_desc', 'capacity_asc', 'status'] as const
export type TableSort = (typeof tableSorts)[number]

export interface TableFilter {
  /** null = every area. */
  area: string | null
  status: TableStatusFilter
  /** null = any capacity; otherwise tables seating at least this many guests. */
  minCapacity: number | null
  vipOnly: boolean
  sort: TableSort
}

export const DEFAULT_TABLE_FILTER: TableFilter = {
  area: null,
  status: 'all',
  minCapacity: null,
  vipOnly: false,
  sort: 'name_asc',
}

export const TABLE_STATUS_FILTER_OPTIONS: { value: TableStatusFilter; label: string }[] = [
  { value: 'all', label: 'All' },
  { value: 'available', label: 'Available' },
  { value: 'occupied', label: 'Occupied' },
  { value: 'reserved', label: 'Reserved' },
  { value: 'cleaning', label: 'Cleaning' },
]

export const TABLE_CAPACITY_FILTER_OPTIONS: { value: number | null; label: string }[] = [
  { value: null, label: 'Any size' },
  { value: 2, label: '2+ seats' },
  { value: 4, label: '4+ seats' },
  { value: 6, label: '6+ seats' },
  { value: 8, label: '8+ seats' },
]

export const TABLE_SORT_OPTIONS: { value: TableSort; label: string }[] = [
  { value: 'name_asc', label: 'Table no. (A→Z)' },
  { value: 'name_desc', label: 'Table no. (Z→A)' },
  { value: 'capacity_desc', label: 'Seats (high → low)' },
  { value: 'capacity_asc', label: 'Seats (low → high)' },
  { value: 'status', label: 'Status (free first)' },
]

/** Shared sessionStorage key for the last-selected table filter. */
export const TABLE_FILTER_STORAGE_KEY = 'beeshive_tableFilter'

interface FilterableTable {
  name: string
  capacity?: number
  status?: string
  area?: string
  isVip?: boolean
  active?: boolean
}

const STATUS_ORDER: Record<string, number> = {
  available: 0,
  reserved: 1,
  occupied: 2,
  cleaning: 3,
}

export const isTableFilterActive = (filter: TableFilter): boolean =>
  filter.area !== null || filter.status !== 'all' || filter.minCapacity !== null || filter.vipOnly

/** How many facets are currently narrowing the list (used on the Filter badge). */
export const activeTableFacetCount = (filter: TableFilter): number =>
  (filter.status !== 'all' ? 1 : 0) +
  (filter.minCapacity !== null ? 1 : 0) +
  (filter.vipOnly ? 1 : 0) +
  (filter.area !== null ? 1 : 0)

/**
 * Apply the filter + free-text search and return the sorted list.
 * Tables without a status default to `available` so they stay filterable.
 */
export function applyTableFilters<T extends FilterableTable>(
  tables: T[],
  filter: TableFilter,
  search = '',
): T[] {
  const needle = search.trim().toLowerCase()
  const filtered = tables.filter((table) => {
    if (filter.area !== null && tableArea(table) !== filter.area) return false
    if (filter.status !== 'all' && (table.status ?? 'available') !== filter.status) return false
    if (filter.minCapacity !== null && (table.capacity ?? 0) < filter.minCapacity) return false
    if (filter.vipOnly && !table.isVip) return false
    if (!needle) return true
    return (
      table.name.toLowerCase().includes(needle) ||
      (table.area ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(needle) ||
      String(table.capacity ?? '').includes(needle)
    )
  })

  const byName = (a: FilterableTable, b: FilterableTable) =>
    a.name.localeCompare(b.name, undefined, { numeric: true })

  switch (filter.sort) {
    case 'name_desc':
      return [...filtered].sort((a, b) => byName(b, a))
    case 'capacity_desc':
      return [...filtered].sort((a, b) => (b.capacity ?? 0) - (a.capacity ?? 0) || byName(a, b))
    case 'capacity_asc':
      return [...filtered].sort((a, b) => (a.capacity ?? 0) - (b.capacity ?? 0) || byName(a, b))
    case 'status':
      return [...filtered].sort(
        (a, b) =>
          (STATUS_ORDER[a.status ?? 'available'] ?? 9) - (STATUS_ORDER[b.status ?? 'available'] ?? 9) ||
          byName(a, b),
      )
    default:
      return [...filtered].sort(byName)
  }
}

/** Read the persisted table filter (session-scoped). */
let storedTableFilter: TableFilter = DEFAULT_TABLE_FILTER

export function getStoredTableFilter(): TableFilter {
  return storedTableFilter
}

/** Persist (or clear) the table filter. */
export function setStoredTableFilter(filter: TableFilter): void {
  storedTableFilter = filter
}

/**
 * Table filter state + free-text search, persisted across tab switches so the
 * chosen "sort by seats" / "only available" view sticks while the waiter moves
 * between the Tables and Sessions tabs.
 */
export function useTableFilter(): {
  filter: TableFilter
  setFilter: (next: TableFilter) => void
  updateFilter: (patch: Partial<TableFilter>) => void
  resetFilter: () => void
  search: string
  setSearch: (next: string) => void
} {
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<TableFilter>(() => getStoredTableFilter())
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('')
  useEffect(() => {
    setStoredTableFilter(filter)
  }, [filter])

  return {
    filter,
    setFilter,
    updateFilter: (patch: Partial<TableFilter>) => setFilter((prev) => ({ ...prev, ...patch })),
    resetFilter: () => setFilter(DEFAULT_TABLE_FILTER),
    search,
    setSearch,
  }
}

/**
 * Bee's Hive — token label helpers (pure, dependency-free).
 *
 * Dine-in orders and parcel (takeaway) orders are numbered in SEPARATE daily
 * series (see `getNextTokenNumber` in RestaurantContext) and are also labelled
 * differently, so the two series can never be confused on screen or on a
 * 58mm kitchen receipt:
 *
 *   • dine-in → TOKEN #001   (receipt banner: `TOKEN 001`)
 *   • parcel  → PARCEL P-001 (receipt banner: `PARCEL P-001`)
 *
 * The plain number stays on `Order.tokenNumber` — only the label differs, so
 * sorting, filters and stored data are untouched.
 */

/** `1` → `001`. */
export const pad3 = (n: number): string => String(n).padStart(3, '0')

/** Dine-in token label, e.g. `#041`. */
export const formatTokenNumber = (n: number): string => `#${pad3(n)}`

/** Parcel token label — its own series, e.g. `P-041`. */
export const formatParcelTokenNumber = (n: number): string => `P-${pad3(n)}`

/** Label honouring the order's series. */
export const formatSeriesToken = (kind: 'dine_in' | 'parcel' | undefined, n: number): string =>
  kind === 'parcel' ? formatParcelTokenNumber(n) : formatTokenNumber(n)

/** Token label for an order (`—` when it has no token yet). */
export const formatOrderToken = (order: { orderType?: 'dine_in' | 'parcel'; tokenNumber?: number }): string =>
  order.tokenNumber == null ? '—' : formatSeriesToken(order.orderType, order.tokenNumber)

/** Thermal-receipt label: `001` for dine-in (no `#`), `P-001` for parcels. */
export const receiptTokenLabel = (n: number, kind?: 'dine_in' | 'parcel'): string =>
  kind === 'parcel' ? formatParcelTokenNumber(n) : pad3(n)

FILE: src\lib\tokenSequence.ts
============================================================

/**
 * Bee's Hive — Daily sequential token numbering.
 *
 * Requirement (Phase 8 / Firestore readiness):
 *   Tokens are sequential for the restaurant day (TOKEN #001 … #041) and must
 *   NEVER be derived from "orders array length + 1" — records can be
 *   deleted/amended. Each confirmed order owns ONE token for life (a failed
 *   print retries the SAME token; it never produces a duplicate).
 *
 * Mock mode:
 *   A per-day counter persisted to localStorage keeps numbering correct across
 *   page reloads and multi-waiter clients on the same browser. It also keeps a
 *   monotonic "last assigned" value for the day so deletions never reuse a
 *   number.
 *
 * Firebase mode:
 *   `nextToken()` delegates to the Firestore atomic counter
 *   (runTransaction on counters/tokens/{date}) so multiple waiters can never
 *   receive the same token. The bridge below keeps the two implementations
 *   behind one interface.
 */
import { dataMode } from '../services/firebase/config'
import { toBusinessDayStr } from './businessDay'
import { nextToken as nextFirebaseToken } from '../services/firebase/tokenService'

const STORAGE_PREFIX = 'beeshive_token_counter_'

/** Dine-in and parcel tokens are numbered on separate series. */
export type TokenSeries = 'dine_in' | 'parcel'

/** LocalStorage-backed counter (mock). Thread-safe within one browser. */
const mockCounter = {
  read(key: string): number {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(key)
      const parsed = raw === null ? null : Number(JSON.parse(raw))
      return typeof parsed === 'number' && Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed > 0 ? parsed : 0
    } catch {
      return 0
    }
  },
  write(key: string, value: number): void {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(value))
    } catch {
      /* storage unavailable — fall back to in-memory only */
    }
  },
}

/** A monotonic in-memory view so two calls in the same second still increment. */
const memoryNext: Record<string, number> = {}

/** YYYY-MM-DD local key used for a "restaurant day". */
export const restaurantDateKey = (at: number = Date.now()): string => toBusinessDayStr(at)

/**
 * Human-friendly token label, e.g. `#041`.
 *
 * Re-exported from the dependency-free `tokenLabel` module so receipts and the
 * print preview can build parcel (`P-041`) / dine-in (`#041`) labels without
 * pulling the numbering (and Firebase) code in.
 */
export { formatTokenNumber, formatParcelTokenNumber, formatOrderToken } from './tokenLabel'

/**
 * Returns the next token number for the restaurant day.
 *
 * - Firebase mode: delegates to the Firestore atomic counter (separate document
 *   per series), so two waiters on two devices can never receive the same token.
 * - Mock/offline: a per-series localStorage counter that is also monotonic in
 *   memory, so numbering survives reloads and rapid same-second confirmations.
 */
export const nextTokenNumber = async (series: TokenSeries = 'dine_in'): Promise<number> => {
  const dateKey = restaurantDateKey()
  if (dataMode === 'firebase' && import.meta.env.VITE_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID) {
    return nextFirebaseToken(dateKey, series)
  }
  const key = `${STORAGE_PREFIX}${series}_${dateKey}`
  const base = Math.max(mockCounter.read(key), memoryNext[key] ?? 0)
  const next = base + 1
  memoryNext[key] = next
  mockCounter.write(key, next)
  return next
}

/** Last token assigned this day (for displays/logs). */
export const currentTokenNumber = (series: TokenSeries = 'dine_in'): number => {
  const key = `${STORAGE_PREFIX}${series}_${restaurantDateKey()}`
  return Math.max(mockCounter.read(key), memoryNext[key] ?? 0)
}

/**
 * Bee's Hive — username credentials.
 *
 * The application authenticates with **username + password**. Firebase
 * Authentication is still the ONLY credential authority: every account owns a
 * real Firebase Auth identity whose email is an internal, non-routable address
 * derived from the username. Nothing about the password is ever stored by the
 * application (no hash, no salt, no plaintext — not in Firestore, not in the
 * browser).
 *
 * The internal address exists only so the Firebase Email/Password provider can
 * be used unchanged:
 *
 *      username  ──►  "<username>@beeshive.local"  ──►  Firebase Auth identity
 *
 * `.local` is an RFC-reserved, non-routable domain: no mail is ever delivered
 * there, and it cannot collide with a real user mailbox. When an account's
 * username changes the Auth identity keeps its original internal address — the
 * `usernames/{username}` reservation document carries the mapping, so a rename
 * never requires re-creating the identity (and never breaks sign-in).
 */

export const USERNAME_MIN_LENGTH = 3
export const USERNAME_MAX_LENGTH = 32

/** Internal, non-routable address domain used for Firebase Auth identities. */
export const INTERNAL_ACCOUNT_DOMAIN = 'beeshive.local'

/** Shown to operators in the account forms. */
export const USERNAME_RULE_TEXT =
  '3–32 characters — letters, numbers, dot, dash or underscore (starts with a letter or number)'

/**
 * Normalization applied EVERYWHERE (create, rename, login): trim + lowercase.
 * Whitespace inside the value is rejected rather than silently removed so two
 * different typings can never map onto the same credential by accident.
 */
export const normalizeUsername = (raw: string): string => (raw ?? '').trim().toLowerCase()

/** Letters/numbers, optional single `.`, `-`, `_` separators between them. */
const USERNAME_PATTERN = /^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9]|[-._](?=[a-z0-9]))*$/

export const isValidUsername = (raw: string): boolean => {
  const username = normalizeUsername(raw)
  if (username.length < USERNAME_MIN_LENGTH || username.length > USERNAME_MAX_LENGTH) return false
  if (/\s/.test(raw ?? '')) return false
  return USERNAME_PATTERN.test(username)
}

/**
 * Internal Auth address for a username (deterministic, opaque to the user).
 * Returns '' for an empty/absent username — a local-part-less address such as
 * "@beeshive.local" is INVALID and must never be minted or stored anywhere.
 */
export const internalEmailForUsername = (raw: string): string => {
  const username = normalizeUsername(raw)
  return username ? `${username}@${INTERNAL_ACCOUNT_DOMAIN}` : ''
}

/**
 * True when a stored identity email is well-formed for authentication: a
 * non-empty local part before the '@'. Guards every read/write of an
 * `authEmail` so a malformed value (e.g. exactly "@beeshive.local") can never
 * be propagated into Firebase Authentication sign-in attempts.
 */
export const isValidAuthEmail = (raw: string | null | undefined): boolean => {
  const value = (raw ?? '').trim()
  if (!value || !value.includes('@')) return false
  return (value.split('@')[0] ?? '').length > 0
}

/** True when the typed credential is an email rather than a username. */
export const looksLikeEmail = (raw: string): boolean =>
  /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]{2,}$/.test((raw ?? '').trim())

/** Optional recovery/contact address validation (never a login credential). */
export const isValidContactEmail = (raw: string): boolean =>
  (raw ?? '').trim() === '' || /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]{2,}$/.test((raw ?? '').trim())

/**
 * Validate username for creation/editing.
 * Returns an error message if invalid, empty string if valid.
 */
export const validateUsername = (raw: string): string => {
  const username = normalizeUsername(raw)
  if (username.length === 0) return 'Username is required.'
  if (username.length < USERNAME_MIN_LENGTH) return `Username must be at least ${USERNAME_MIN_LENGTH} characters.`
  if (username.length > USERNAME_MAX_LENGTH) return `Username must be at most ${USERNAME_MAX_LENGTH} characters.`
  if (!USERNAME_PATTERN.test(username)) return USERNAME_RULE_TEXT
  return ''
}

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react'

/**
 * Persisted VIEW preferences ("Small / Medium / Large / List" controls).
 *
 * A view mode is a UI preference, NOT business data: it only decides how the
 * cards of the current screen are laid out. Nothing that belongs to Firebase —
 * sessions, orders, tables, bills, payments, tokens, menu, inventory — is ever
 * stored here (see the note on `readViewPreference`).
 *
 * Why localStorage: the requirement is that the chosen view survives a page
 * navigation AND a browser refresh, and keeps applying until the operator
 * explicitly changes it. That is exactly the pattern the app already uses for
 * other local, non-business helper values (`beeshive_token_counter_*`,
 * `beeshive_analytics_waiterDaily`), so it reuses the approved mechanism instead
 * of introducing a new one.
 *
 * Every screen owns its own key (`README`: stable per-page preference) so
 * switching the Menu to "Small" can never silently re-layout Inventory, and the
 * stored value is validated against the screen's own option list, so a stale or
 * hand-edited value can never produce an unknown view mode.
 */
export const viewPreferenceKeys = {
  /** Waiter → Sessions / Table Floor (`WaiterTableAllocation`). */
  waiterSessions: 'beeshive_view_waiterSessions',
  /** Waiter → Menu tab (`WaiterMenuBrowse`). */
  waiterMenu: 'beeshive_view_waiterMenu',
  /** Waiter → order screen dish list (`WaiterOrderCreation`). */
  waiterOrderMenu: 'beeshive_view_waiterOrderMenu',
  /** Admin → Menu (`AdminMenuManagement`). */
  adminMenu: 'beeshive_view_adminMenu',
  /** Supervisor → Dashboard inventory (`SupervisorDashboard`). */
  supervisorInventory: 'beeshive_view_supervisorInventory',
} as const

export type ViewPreferenceKey = (typeof viewPreferenceKeys)[keyof typeof viewPreferenceKeys]

/**
 * Read a stored view mode. Returns `fallback` when nothing is stored, when the
 * stored value is not one of this screen's options, or when storage is
 * unavailable (private mode / quota). Never throws.
 */
export function readViewPreference<T extends string>(
  key: string,
  fallback: T,
  allowed: readonly T[],
): T {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(key)
    if (raw === null) return fallback
    return allowed.includes(raw as T) ? (raw as T) : fallback
  } catch {
    return fallback
  }
}

/** Persist a view mode (best effort — a failed write is never fatal). */
export function writeViewPreference(key: string, value: string): void {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(key, value)
  } catch {
    // Storage unavailable (private mode / quota): the view still applies for
    // this page load, it just cannot be remembered.
  }
}

/**
 * View-mode state for one screen, persisted across navigation, tab switches and
 * browser refreshes. The setter applies the change immediately (no reload) and
 * stores it, so the selection sticks until the operator picks another one.
 */
export function useViewPreference<T extends string>(
  key: string,
  fallback: T,
  allowed: readonly T[],
): [T, (next: T) => void] {
  const [value, setValue] = useState<T>(() => readViewPreference(key, fallback, allowed))

  // Re-read when the screen's own key changes (never for unrelated screens).
  useEffect(() => {
    setValue(readViewPreference(key, fallback, allowed))
    // `allowed`/`fallback` are module constants on every screen that uses this.
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [key])

  const update = useCallback(
    (next: T) => {
      setValue(next)
      writeViewPreference(key, next)
    },
    [key],
  )

  return [value, update]
}

type AdminTab = 'dashboard' | 'admins' | 'tables' | 'menu' | 'staff' | 'orders' | 'inventory' | 'inventory-usage' | 'tokens' | 'billing' | 'payments' | 'purchase-requests' | 'analytics' | 'settings'

/**
 * Per-tab crash guard. Without this, any runtime error inside a tab component
 * (e.g. Tables / Menu) unmounts the whole React tree and the user sees a blank
 * white page. The boundary contains the failure to the tab content area and
 * always renders an actionable panel with a reload escape hatch.
 */
class TabErrorBoundary extends Component<{ tab: string; children: ReactNode }, { error: Error | null }> {
  state = { error: null as Error | null }

  static getDerivedStateFromError(error: Error) {
    return { error }
  }

  componentDidCatch(error: Error) {
    if (import.meta.env.DEV) console.error(`[AdminDashboard] Tab "${this.props.tab}" crashed:`, error)
  }

  componentDidUpdate(prev: { tab: string }) {
    // Switching tabs clears the previous failure so the new tab renders.
    if (prev.tab !== this.props.tab && this.state.error) {
      this.setState({ error: null })
    }
  }

  render() {
    if (this.state.error) {
      return (
        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-6">
          <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-red-700">Something went wrong in "{this.props.tab}"</h2>
          <p className="mt-2 break-all font-mono text-xs text-red-600">{this.state.error.message}</p>
          <p className="mt-3 text-sm text-red-600">Other sections keep working. Try again or reload the page.</p>
          <div className="mt-4 flex gap-2">
            <button onClick={() => this.setState({ error: null })} className="rounded-lg bg-red-500 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-bold text-white hover:bg-red-600">
              Try again
            </button>
            <button onClick={() => window.location.reload()} className="rounded-lg border border-red-300 bg-white px-4 py-2 text-sm font-bold text-red-600 hover:bg-red-50">
              Reload page
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )
    }
    return this.props.children
  }
}

// ─── Period helpers — FIXED IST business calendar (see lib/businessDay.ts) ────
// The previous implementation mixed browser-local day keys with Date.UTC
// boundaries, shifting every selected period by 5½ hours on an IST device
// (orders placed 00:00–05:30 IST were dropped from "their own day", and
// 05:30 of the NEXT day was included). All boundaries below are now IST.
import {
  toBusinessDayStr,
  isSameBusinessDay as isSameIstDay,
  todayBusinessDayStr,
  businessDayStart,
  businessDayEnd,
  businessWeekStart,
  businessWeekEnd,
  businessMonthStart,
  businessMonthEnd,
  businessYearStart,
  businessYearEnd,
} from '../lib/businessDay'

const isToday = (ts: number) => isSameIstDay(ts, todayBusinessDayStr())

const toDateStr = (d: Date) => toBusinessDayStr(d.getTime())
const sameDay = (ts: number, dateStr: string) => isSameIstDay(ts, dateStr)

// ─── Period helpers (Mon–Sun week, calendar month, calendar year) ──────────────
export type PeriodType = 'week' | 'month' | 'year' | 'custom'

/** midnight IST of `dateStr` (inclusive start of that business day) */
const startOfDateStr = (dateStr: string): number => businessDayStart(dateStr)

/** end of a business day = IST midnight of the NEXT day minus 1ms (inclusive) */
const endOfDateStr = (dateStr: string): number => businessDayEnd(dateStr)

/** Start of week: Monday 00:00 IST of the week containing `dateStr`. */
const startOfWeek = (dateStr: string): number => businessWeekStart(dateStr)

/** End of week: Sunday 23:59:59.999 IST of the week containing `dateStr`. */
const endOfWeek = (dateStr: string): number => businessWeekEnd(dateStr)

/** Start of calendar month: 00:00 IST of the 1st. */
const startOfMonth = (dateStr: string): number => businessMonthStart(dateStr)
/** End of calendar month: last ms of the month, IST. */
const endOfMonth = (dateStr: string): number => businessMonthEnd(dateStr)

/** Start of calendar year: Jan 1 00:00 IST. */
const startOfYear = (dateStr: string): number => businessYearStart(dateStr)
/** End of calendar year: last ms of Dec 31, IST. */
const endOfYear = (dateStr: string): number => businessYearEnd(dateStr)

/** Label-aware date range. isActive(ts) returns true when `ts` falls within [start, end] (inclusive). */
type DateRange = {
  start: number
  end: number
  label: string
}

const rangeForPeriod = (period: PeriodType, anchorDateStr: string): DateRange => {
  if (period === 'week') {
    const start = startOfWeek(anchorDateStr)
    const end = endOfWeek(anchorDateStr)
    const s = new Date(start)
    const e = new Date(end)
    return {
      start,
      end,
      label: `This Week · ${s.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' })} – ${e.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' })}`,
    }
  }
  if (period === 'month') {
    const start = startOfMonth(anchorDateStr)
    const end = endOfMonth(anchorDateStr)
    const s = new Date(start)
    return {
      start,
      end,
      label: `This Month · ${s.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: 'long', year: 'numeric' })}`,
    }
  }
  if (period === 'year') {
    const start = startOfYear(anchorDateStr)
    const end = endOfYear(anchorDateStr)
    return {
      start,
      end,
      label: `This Year · ${new Date(start).getUTCFullYear()}`,
    }
  }
  // custom: single day selectedDate
  const start = startOfDateStr(anchorDateStr)
  const end = endOfDateStr(anchorDateStr)
  const d = new Date(start)
  return {
    start,
    end,
    label: `Custom · ${d.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { weekday: 'short', month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' })}`,
  }
}

const inRange = (range: DateRange, ts: number) => ts >= range.start && ts <= range.end

/** Format a UTC timestamp for trend labels. */
const fmtDate = (ts: number) => new Date(ts).toLocaleDateString(undefined, { weekday: 'short', month: 'short', day: 'numeric' })
const fmtMonth = (ts: number) => new Date(ts).toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: 'short' })

function StatCard({ label, value, color, onClick }: { label: string; value: string | number; color: string; onClick?: () => void }) {
  const styles: Record<string, { bar: string; dot: string; text: string }> = {
    orange: { bar: 'bg-orange-400', dot: 'bg-orange-400', text: 'text-orange-600' },
    emerald: { bar: 'bg-emerald-400', dot: 'bg-emerald-400', text: 'text-emerald-600' },
    blue: { bar: 'bg-blue-400', dot: 'bg-blue-400', text: 'text-blue-600' },
    amber: { bar: 'bg-amber-400', dot: 'bg-amber-400', text: 'text-amber-600' },
    red: { bar: 'bg-red-400', dot: 'bg-red-400', text: 'text-red-600' },
    violet: { bar: 'bg-violet-400', dot: 'bg-violet-400', text: 'text-violet-600' },
  }
  const s = styles[color] || styles.orange

  const header = <p className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-slate-400">{label}</p>

  if (!onClick) {
    return (
      <div className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-[22px] border border-orange-100/70 bg-white p-4 shadow-[0_12px_28px_-14px_rgba(120,53,15,0.22)]">
        <span className={`pointer-events-none absolute left-0 top-0 h-full w-1.5 ${s.bar}`} />
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          {header}
          <span className={`h-2.5 w-2.5 shrink-0 rounded-full ${s.dot}`} />
        </div>
        <p className={`mt-2 text-[26px] font-black leading-none ${s.text}`}>{value}</p>
      </div>
    )
  }

  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={onClick}
      className="group relative w-full cursor-pointer overflow-hidden rounded-[22px] border border-orange-100/70 bg-white p-4 text-left shadow-[0_12px_28px_-14px_rgba(120,53,15,0.22)] transition hover:-translate-y-1 hover:border-orange-200 hover:shadow-[0_18px_36px_-14px_rgba(120,53,15,0.32)]"
    >
      <span className={`pointer-events-none absolute left-0 top-0 h-full w-1.5 ${s.bar}`} />
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        {header}
        <span className="shrink-0 text-slate-300 transition group-hover:translate-x-0.5 group-hover:text-orange-500">&rarr;</span>
      </div>
      <p className={`mt-2 text-[26px] font-black leading-none ${s.text}`}>{value}</p>
    </button>
  )
}

function AdminOrdersView() {
  return <AdminLiveOrdersBoard />
}

function AdminLiveOrdersBoard() {
  const { orders, tables, sessions, bills, previewOrderToken } = useRestaurant()
  const [showParcel, setShowParcel] = useState(false)
  /** Parcel order currently open in the billing modal (items → bill → payment → receipt). */
  const [billOrderId, setBillOrderId] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [previewJobId, setPreviewJobId] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [previewJob, setPreviewJob] = useState<PrintJob | null>(null)
  const [billingTarget, setBillingTarget] = useState<{ sessionId: string; tableId: string } | null>(null)
  const live = getPendingOrders(orders, sessions, bills, { includeParcel: true })
  const dineIn = live.filter((o) => o.orderType !== 'parcel')
  const parcels = live.filter((o) => o.orderType === 'parcel')

  /** Open the kitchen token receipt (parcel series -> `P-001`) of an existing order. */
  const openTokenReceipt = (orderId: string) => {
    const job = previewOrderToken(orderId)
    if (job) {
      setPreviewJob(job)
      setPreviewJobId(job.id)
    }
  }

  const byTable = Array.from(
    dineIn.reduce<Map<string, Order[]>>((m, o) => {
      const list = m.get(o.tableId) ?? []
      list.push(o)
      m.set(o.tableId, list)
      return m
    }, new Map<string, Order[]>()).entries()
  )

  const chip = (s: string) =>
    ({
      placed: 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-700',
      confirmed: 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700',
      preparing: 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700',
      ready: 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700',
      served: 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-500',
    }[s] ?? 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600')

  const summaries = [
    { label: 'Live', value: live.length, cls: 'bg-orange-50 text-orange-700' },
    { label: 'Preparing', value: live.filter((o) => o.status === 'preparing').length, cls: 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-700' },
    { label: 'Ready', value: live.filter((o) => o.status === 'ready').length, cls: 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700' },
    { label: 'Parcels', value: parcels.length, cls: 'bg-sky-50 text-sky-700' },
  ]

  return (
    <div className="space-y-5">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-900">Live Orders</h2>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={() => setShowParcel(true)}
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-linear-to-br from-orange-500 to-amber-500 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-white shadow-[0_6px_16px_-6px_rgba(249,115,22,0.5)] transition hover:from-orange-600 hover:to-amber-600"
        >
          <ShoppingBag size={16} /> Parcel Order
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-4">
        {summaries.map((s) => (
          <div key={s.label} className={`rounded-[18px] px-4 py-3 ${s.cls}`}>
            <p className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider opacity-70">{s.label}</p>
            <p className="mt-1 text-2xl font-black">{s.value}</p>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {dineIn.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="rounded-[20px] border border-dashed border-slate-300 bg-white p-10 text-center">
          <p className="text-slate-500">No live orders right now. New orders appear here by table.</p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 lg:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3">
          {byTable.map(([tableId, list]) => {
            const table = tables.find((t) => t.id === tableId)
            const latest = list[list.length - 1]
            return (
              <div key={tableId} className="overflow-hidden rounded-[20px] border border-orange-100 bg-white shadow-sm">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-orange-100 bg-linear-to-r from-orange-50 to-amber-50 px-4 py-3">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Table2 size={16} className="text-orange-600" />
                    <span className="font-black text-slate-900">{table?.name ?? 'Unknown Table'}</span>
                  </div>
                  <span className={`rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold ${chip(latest.status)}`}>
                    {latest.status.toUpperCase()}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-2 p-4">
                  {list.map((order) => (
                    <div key={order.id} className="rounded-xl border border-slate-100 bg-slate-50/60 p-3">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                        <span className="font-bold text-slate-900">
                          {order.tokenNumber ? `TOKEN ${String(order.tokenNumber).padStart(3, '0')}` : 'DRAFT'}
                        </span>
                        <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2">
                          {order.tokenNumber != null && (
                            <button
                              onClick={() => openTokenReceipt(order.id)}
                              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg border border-orange-200 bg-orange-50 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-bold text-orange-700 transition hover:bg-orange-100"
                            >
                              <Printer size={12} /> Token Receipt
                            </button>
                          )}
                          <span className={`rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold ${chip(order.status)}`}>
                            {order.status}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <div className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-600">
                        {order.items.map((item) => (
                          <span key={item.id} className="mr-2">
                            {item.nameSnapshot}{servingSuffix(item.servingType)} x{item.quantity}
                          </span>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                      {/* Spice level / anything else the guest asked for */}
                      {order.items.some((item) => item.specialRequests) && (
                        <div className="mt-1 space-y-0.5">
                          {order.items.filter((item) => item.specialRequests).map((item) => (
                            <p key={`note-${item.id}`} className="text-[11px] font-bold text-orange-700">!! {item.specialRequests} !!</p>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  ))}
                  {latest.sessionId && (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setBillingTarget({ sessionId: latest.sessionId, tableId })}
                      className="mt-2 inline-flex min-h-11 w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-emerald-600 px-3 py-2 text-sm font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-emerald-700"
                    >
                      <Receipt size={16} /> Generate Bill &amp; Take Payment
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            )
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      {parcels.length > 0 && (
        <div>
          <h3 className="mb-2 text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">Takeaway Parcels</h3>
          <div className="space-y-2">
            {parcels.slice(0, 12).map((order) => (
              <div key={order.id} className="space-y-2 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-3">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                  <div className="min-w-0">
                    {/* Parcel tokens are their OWN series (P-001) — never a waiter token. */}
                    <p className="font-black text-slate-900">PARCEL {formatOrderToken(order)}</p>
                    <p className="truncate text-xs text-slate-500">{order.items.map((i) => `${i.nameSnapshot}${servingSuffix(i.servingType)} x${i.quantity}`).join(' · ')}</p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2">
                    {(() => {
                      const b = bills.find((bb) => bb.sessionId === order.sessionId)
                      return (
                        <button
                          onClick={() => setBillOrderId(order.id)}
                          className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-bold transition ` + (b?.status === 'PAID' ? 'border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700' : 'bg-linear-to-br from-orange-500 to-amber-500 text-white hover:from-orange-600 hover:to-amber-600')}
                        >
                          <Receipt size={12} /> {b?.status === 'PAID' ? 'Bill ✓' : 'Bill'}
                        </button>
                      )
                    })()}
                    <button
                      onClick={() => openTokenReceipt(order.id)}
                      className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg border border-orange-200 bg-orange-50 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-bold text-orange-700 transition hover:bg-orange-100"
                    >
                      <Printer size={12} /> Token Receipt
                    </button>
                    <span className={`rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold ${chip(order.status)}`}>
                      {order.status.toUpperCase()}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                {order.items.some((i) => i.specialRequests) && (
                  <div className="space-y-0.5">
                    {order.items.filter((i) => i.specialRequests).map((i) => (
                      <p key={`parcel-note-${i.id}`} className="text-[11px] font-bold text-orange-700">!! {i.specialRequests} !!</p>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {showParcel && <AdminParcelModal onClose={() => setShowParcel(false)} onBill={(id) => setBillOrderId(id)} />}
      {billOrderId && <AdminParcelBillModal orderId={billOrderId} onClose={() => setBillOrderId(null)} />}
      {previewJobId && previewJob && <PrintPreview previewJob={previewJob} onCancel={() => { setPreviewJobId(null); setPreviewJob(null) }} />}
      {billingTarget && (
        <AdminSessionBilling
          sessionId={billingTarget.sessionId}
          tableId={billingTarget.tableId}
          viewMode="orders"
          onClose={() => setBillingTarget(null)}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

function AdminParcelModal({ onClose, onBill }: { onClose: () => void; onBill: (orderId: string) => void }) {
  const { menu, categories, orders, createOrder, confirmOrder, printOrderToken, previewOrderToken } = useRestaurant()
  const { user } = useAuth()
  // Each parcel line carries the guest's spice level and any "customer says"
  // note — both travel with the item onto the parcel token receipt.
  // `servingType` keeps Full and Half variants on SEPARATE cart lines so the
  // order records the exact variant + price the guest chose.
  const [cart, setCart] = useState<{ menuItemId: string; name: string; price: number; quantity: number; spice?: string; note?: string; servingType: 'full' | 'half' }[]>([])
  const [optionsFor, setOptionsFor] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [customer, setCustomer] = useState('')
  const [result, setResult] = useState<{ label: string; orderId: string } | null>(null)
  const [previewJobId, setPreviewJobId] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [previewJob, setPreviewJob] = useState<PrintJob | null>(null)
  const [error, setError] = useState('')
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false)
  // Synchronous duplicate-submission guard: React state updates are batched,
  // so two clicks in the same tick could BOTH see `submitting === false`.
  // The ref is checked + flipped synchronously before any await — one parcel
  // can only ever mint one order, one PARCEL token and one print job.
  const submittingRef = useRef(false)
  const [category, setCategory] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [q, setQ] = useState('')
  // Veg / Non-Veg comes from the dish's own menu `foodType` (the SAME helper and
  // the SAME authoritative menu records the waiter menu uses) — never guessed
  // from the dish name and never a second food-type database.
  const [foodTypeFilter, setFoodTypeFilter] = useFoodTypeFilter()
  const availableItems = menu.filter((m) => m.available && m.active)
  const activeCats = categories.filter((c) => c.active)
  const foodTypeCounts = countFoodTypes(availableItems)
  const items = availableItems.filter(
    (m) =>
      (!category || m.categoryId === category) &&
      matchesFoodType(m, foodTypeFilter) &&
      (!q || m.name.toLowerCase().includes(q.toLowerCase())),
  )
  const cartTotal = cart.reduce((s, i) => s + i.price * i.quantity, 0)

  /** A dish offers a half plate only when a valid half price is configured. */
  const halfAvailable = (m: MenuItem) => hasHalfPlatePrice(m.halfPlatePrice)
  /** Price of one serving variant — the configured half price, never half/2. */
  const variantPrice = (m: MenuItem, serving: 'full' | 'half'): number =>
    serving === 'half' && hasHalfPlatePrice(m.halfPlatePrice) ? m.halfPlatePrice : m.price

  // const addItem = (m: MenuItem, serving: 'full' | 'half' = 'full') => {
  //   const servingType: 'full' | 'half' = serving === 'half' && hasHalfPlatePrice(m.halfPlatePrice) ? 'half' : 'full'
  //   const price = variantPrice(m, servingType)
  //   setCart((prev) => {
  //     const ex = prev.find((x) => x.menuItemId === m.id && x.servingType === servingType)
  //     if (ex) return prev.map((x) => (x.menuItemId === m.id && x.servingType === servingType ? { ...x, quantity: x.quantity + 1 } : x))
  //     return [...prev, { menuItemId: m.id, name: m.name, price, quantity: 1, servingType }]
  //   })
  // }

  const addItem = (m: MenuItem, serving: 'full' | 'half' = 'full') => {
    const servingType: 'full' | 'half' =
      serving === 'half' && hasHalfPlatePrice(m.halfPlatePrice) ? 'half' : 'full'
    const price = variantPrice(m, servingType)
    setCart((prev) => {
      // Already in cart for this serving → do not increase quantity.
      // Quantity is managed only from the cart controls below.
      if (prev.some((x) => x.menuItemId === m.id && x.servingType === servingType)) {
        return prev
      }
      return [
        ...prev,
        { menuItemId: m.id, name: m.name, price, quantity: 1, servingType },
      ]
    })
  }
  const setQty = (menuItemId: string, serving: 'full' | 'half', q: number) =>
    setCart((prev) => prev.map((x) => (x.menuItemId === menuItemId && x.servingType === serving ? { ...x, quantity: Math.max(0, q) } : x)).filter((x) => x.quantity > 0))
  const setSpice = (menuItemId: string, serving: 'full' | 'half', spice: string) =>
    setCart((prev) => prev.map((x) => (x.menuItemId === menuItemId && x.servingType === serving ? { ...x, spice: x.spice === spice ? undefined : spice } : x)))
  const setNote = (menuItemId: string, serving: 'full' | 'half', note: string) =>
    setCart((prev) => prev.map((x) => (x.menuItemId === menuItemId && x.servingType === serving ? { ...x, note } : x)))
  /** Quick-pick chips append/remove their wording from the free-text note. */
  const toggleNoteOption = (menuItemId: string, serving: 'full' | 'half', option: string) =>
    setCart((prev) => prev.map((x) => {
      if (x.menuItemId !== menuItemId || x.servingType !== serving) return x
      const parts = (x.note ?? '').split(' · ').map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean)
      const next = parts.includes(option) ? parts.filter((part) => part !== option) : [...parts, option]
      return { ...x, note: next.join(' · ') }
    }))

  const submit = async () => {
    // Hard duplicate-submission guard (ref is synchronous, state drives the UI).
    if (submittingRef.current) return
    setError('')
    if (cart.length === 0) { setError('Add at least one item.'); return }
    submittingRef.current = true
    setSubmitting(true)
    try {
      // Prevent duplicate parcel creation: check if there's already an unconfirmed
      // parcel order for this session/user. This is a UX safeguard; the token
      // allocation via nextTokenNumber() is already atomic via Firestore transactions.
      const existingParcel = orders.find(o =>
        o.orderType === 'parcel' &&
        o.status === 'placed' &&
        o.waiterId === (user?.id ?? 'admin')
      )
      if (existingParcel) {
        throw new Error('A parcel order is already being created. Please confirm it first.')
      }
      const order = await createOrder('parcel', user?.id ?? 'admin', `parcel-${Date.now()}`, cart.map((i) => ({
        menuItemId: i.menuItemId, name: i.name, price: i.price, quantity: i.quantity,
        specialRequests: buildSpecialRequests(i.spice, [], i.note),
        servingType: i.servingType,
      })), 'normal', 'parcel')
      // Confirming a parcel mints a PARCEL token (own series). Queue it
      // immediately so the kitchen never depends on a second button click.
      const confirmed = order?.id ? confirmOrder(order.id) : null
      if (!confirmed?.id) throw new Error('Parcel order could not be confirmed')
      printOrderToken(confirmed.id)
      setResult({ label: `PARCEL ${formatOrderToken(confirmed)}`, orderId: confirmed.id })
      setCart([])
      setOptionsFor(null)
    } catch (err) {
      // Error: release the guard so the operator can retry immediately.
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Could not create parcel order')
    } finally {
      submittingRef.current = false
      setSubmitting(false)
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-start justify-center overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain bg-black/40 p-4 py-6 sm:items-center bh-modal-overlay">
      <div className="flex max-h-[92vh] w-full max-w-3xl flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-3xl bg-white shadow-2xl">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between bg-linear-to-br from-orange-500 to-amber-500 px-5 py-4 text-white">
          <div><p className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-orange-100">Takeaway</p><h3 className="text-2xl font-black">Parcel Order</h3></div>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="rounded-lg p-1.5 text-white/80 hover:bg-white/20" aria-label="Close"><X size={20} /></button>
        </div>

        {result ? (
          <div className="px-5 py-8 text-center">
            <div className="mx-auto mb-3 flex h-16 w-16 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-600"><CheckCircle2 size={30} /></div>
            <p className="text-4xl font-black tracking-wider text-slate-900">{result.label}</p>
            <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">Parcel token receipt sent to the kitchen printer · {customer || 'Walk-in'}</p>
            <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-400">Parcels run on their own token series (P-001 …) — they never share numbers with waiter tokens.</p>
            <div className="mt-5 flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-2">
              <button
                onClick={() => { const job = previewOrderToken(result.orderId); if (job) { setPreviewJob(job); setPreviewJobId(job.id) } }}
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl border border-orange-300 bg-orange-50 px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-orange-700 hover:bg-orange-100"
              >
                <Printer size={16} /> Parcel Token Receipt
              </button>
              {/* Straight to billing: items → Generate Bill → payment → receipt */}
              <button
                onClick={() => { onBill(result.orderId); onClose() }}
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl bg-linear-to-br from-orange-500 to-amber-500 px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-white hover:from-orange-600 hover:to-amber-600"
              >
                <Receipt size={16} /> Bill
              </button>
              <button onClick={onClose} className="rounded-xl bg-orange-500 px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-white hover:bg-orange-600">Done</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="grid flex-1 gap-4 overflow-y-auto p-5 lg:grid-cols-[1fr,300px]">
            <div className="space-y-3">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                <button onClick={() => setCategory(null)} className={`rounded-full px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold transition ${!category ? 'bg-linear-to-br from-orange-500 to-amber-500 text-white' : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 hover:bg-orange-100'}`}>All</button>
                {activeCats.map((c) => (
                  <button key={c.id} onClick={() => setCategory(c.id)} className={`rounded-full px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold transition ${category === c.id ? 'bg-linear-to-br from-orange-500 to-amber-500 text-white' : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 hover:bg-orange-100'}`}>{c.name}</button>
                ))}
              </div>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
                {foodTypeFilters.map((f) => (
                  <button
                    key={f}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setFoodTypeFilter(f)}
                    className={`rounded-full px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold transition ${
                      foodTypeFilter === f
                        ? f === 'veg'
                          ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white'
                          : f === 'non_veg'
                            ? 'bg-red-600 text-white'
                            : 'bg-linear-to-br from-orange-500 to-amber-500 text-white'
                        : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 hover:bg-orange-100'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {f === 'all' ? `All (${foodTypeCounts.all})` : f === 'veg' ? `Veg (${foodTypeCounts.veg})` : `Non-Veg (${foodTypeCounts.non_veg})`}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
              <div className="relative">
                <Search size={14} className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400" />
                <input value={q} onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)} placeholder="Search dishes…" className="w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-200 py-2 pl-8 pr-3 text-sm outline-none focus:border-orange-400" />
              </div>
              {items.length === 0 ? (
                <p className="text-sm text-slate-400">No dishes found.</p>
              ) : (
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
                  {items.map((m) => (
                    <div key={m.id} className="flex overflow-hidden rounded-[20px] border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-sm">
                      {m.imageUrl ? (
                        <img src={m.imageUrl} alt={m.imageAlt || m.name} className="h-full w-24 shrink-0 object-cover" />
                      ) : (
                        <div className="flex h-full w-24 shrink-0 items-center justify-center bg-linear-to-br from-orange-100 to-amber-100"><UtensilsCrossed size={20} className="text-orange-400" /></div>
                      )}
                      <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col p-2.5">
                        <h3 className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm font-bold text-slate-900"><FoodTypeMark foodType={m.foodType} isVeg={m.isVeg} size="sm" withLabel /><span className="truncate">{m.name}</span></h3>
                        {m.description && <p className="mt-0.5 line-clamp-1 text-[11px] text-slate-500">{m.description}</p>}
                        <div className="mt-auto flex items-center justify-between gap-1 pt-1">
                          <div>
                            <p className="text-sm font-black text-[#8a1b1b]">₹{m.price}{halfAvailable(m) && <span className="ml-1 text-[10px] font-bold text-emerald-600">HALF ₹{m.halfPlatePrice}</span>}</p>
                            <p className="flex items-center gap-0.5 text-[10px] text-slate-400"><Clock size={10} /> {m.preparationTime}m</p>
                          </div>
                          {/* {halfAvailable(m) ? (
                            <div className="flex gap-1">
                              <button onClick={() => addItem(m, 'full')} className="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 rounded-lg bg-emerald-600 px-2 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-emerald-700"><Plus size={11} /> FULL</button>
                              <button onClick={() => addItem(m, 'half')} className="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 rounded-lg bg-teal-600 px-2 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-teal-700"><Plus size={11} /> HALF</button>
                            </div>
                          ) : (
